nodes.source: Speed (cars and bikes), go-karting, Formula 1, boats, flying anywhere in anything, especially helicopters. Innovation, gadgets, computers (only Apple), the internet, continuing to beat cancer and helping others do the same.
nodes.text: Hitrost (avtomobili in motorji), karting, formula 1, čolni, letenje kamorkoli in s čimerkoli, zlasti s helikopterji. Inovacije, tehnološke igračke, računalniki (samo Apple), internet, še naprej premagovati raka in pri tem pomagati tudi drugim.

nodes.source: The diagnosis and first chemotherapy
nodes.text: Diagnoza in prva kemoterapija

nodes.source: Personal diary
nodes.text: Osebni dnevnik

nodes.source: About 31 min read
nodes.text: Približno 31 min branja

nodes.source: 6th December 2004 - Monday
nodes.text: 6. decembra 2004 - ponedeljek

nodes.source: Antibiotics course finished and no real change noticed.
nodes.text: Zdravljenje z antibiotiki končano, opazil nisem nobene prave spremembe.

nodes.source: 8th December 2004 - Wednesday
nodes.text: 8. decembra 2004 - sreda

nodes.source: Growing concern, booked another appointment with a different GP at my surgery for Friday 10th at 5pm.
nodes.text: Skrb je vse večja. Naročil sem se pri drugem zdravniku v svoji ambulanti za petek, 10., ob 17.00.

nodes.source: 9th December 2004 - Thursday
nodes.text: 9. decembra 2004 - četrtek

nodes.source: After yet another sweaty night (these had become such a regular occurrence now over the past few weeks) I awoke with what felt like yet another pulled muscle pain in my ribcage area, this time around on my back on the left hand side.
nodes.text: Po še eni prepoteni noči (v zadnjih tednih so postale že nekaj povsem običajnega) sem se zbudil z občutkom še ene nategnjene mišice okoli reber, tokrat na levi strani hrbta.

nodes.source: I was becoming increasingly fed up with my symptoms and decided that the GP would only prolong any further treatment I may need, and a visit to the A&E for a routine check-up and X-ray would be a better option. So, without further delay or cancelling my GP appointment, I paid a visit to West Middlesex Hospital's brand new A&E department.
nodes.text: Svojih simptomov sem imel vedno bolj dovolj in odločil sem se, da bi obisk osebnega zdravnika le podaljšal čakanje na morebitno nadaljnje zdravljenje, zato bi bil obisk urgence za rutinski pregled in rentgensko slikanje boljša izbira. Tako sem brez nadaljnjega odlašanja in ne da bi odpovedal termin pri osebnem zdravniku obiskal povsem nov urgentni oddelek bolnišnice West Middlesex.

nodes.source: I waited just under an hour at A&E to see someone, a brilliant waiting time for an NHS A&E.
nodes.text: Na urgenci sem čakal nekaj manj kot uro, da me je kdo sprejel. Odlična čakalna doba za urgenco NHS.

nodes.source: Some routine checks were carried out and a cautionary X-ray was ordered immediately without any real concerns or suspicion attached.
nodes.text: Opravili so nekaj rutinskih pregledov in takoj naročili previdnostno rentgensko slikanje, brez posebne zaskrbljenosti ali sumov.

nodes.source: I was sent for an X-ray some 20 minutes later. The radiographer asked after zapping me if I had ever had a chest X-ray before, I noticed an air of concern come over her face and I answered candidly "no".
nodes.text: Kakšnih 20 minut pozneje so me poslali na rentgen. Radiološka inženirka me je po slikanju vprašala, ali sem že kdaj imel rentgen prsnega koša. Opazil sem, da jo je prešinila zaskrbljenost, in odkrito odgovoril: »Ne.«

nodes.source: Upon my return to A&E I was given a blood test. I noticed several doctors looking at a computer screen and then looking over at me in amazement. Now I was really starting to sense something wasn't quite right, but kept my cool.
nodes.text: Po vrnitvi na urgenco so mi vzeli kri. Opazil sem več zdravnikov, ki so gledali v računalniški zaslon in nato začudeno pogledovali proti meni. Zdaj sem res začenjal čutiti, da nekaj ni prav, vendar sem ostal miren.

nodes.source: A doctor approached me and led me into a curtained cubicle. He pulled the curtains closed after our entrance; the look on his face told me he had bad news before a single word had passed his lips. "We've found some dark patches on your X-ray" he said cautiously. I asked for a straight explanation and, after an initial shock and a cup of water, the facts started to sink in.
nodes.text: Pristopil je zdravnik in me odpeljal v prostor, ločen z zavesami. Ko sva vstopila, je zagrnil zavese. Še preden je izgovoril eno besedo, mi je izraz na njegovem obrazu povedal, da ima slabo novico. »Na vašem rentgenskem posnetku smo našli nekaj temnih lis,« je previdno dejal. Prosil sem za neposredno razlago in po prvem šoku ter kozarcu vode so se mi dejstva začela počasi usedati v zavest.

nodes.source: It was explained that I had up to 8 or 9 lesions the size of 20p pieces on each of my lungs and the chances of it being an infection was 20% versus the 80% chance of it being CANCER!!!
nodes.text: Pojasnili so mi, da imam v vsakem pljučnem krilu do osem ali devet lezij velikosti kovanca za 20 penijev in da je 20-odstotna možnost, da gre za okužbo, v primerjavi z 80-odstotno možnostjo, da gre za RAKA!!!

nodes.source: I was admitted to West Middlesex Hospital that evening for an overnight stay in the Medical Assessment Unit (MAU), a CT scan and Ultrasound scan scheduled for the morning.
nodes.text: Tisti večer so me sprejeli v bolnišnico West Middlesex za eno noč na enoto za internistično oceno (MAU), zjutraj pa sta bili načrtovani CT-preiskava in ultrazvok.

nodes.source: 10th December 2004 - Friday
nodes.text: 10. decembra 2004 - petek

nodes.source: The morning came and my fears worsened as a plethora of doctors entered my room and each and every one of them looked as worried as the doctor the night before. What was dawning on me was that this was something quite serious. More bad news was given to the effect that if it was a Cancer, as they now suspected, then what was showing on the chest X-ray was not its primary source and was likely to have started somewhere lower in my body, eventually reaching my lungs.
nodes.text: Prišlo je jutro in moji strahovi so se še okrepili, ko je v sobo vstopila množica zdravnikov. Prav vsak je bil videti enako zaskrbljen kot zdravnik prejšnji večer. Začenjalo se mi je svitati, da gre za nekaj precej resnega. Dobil sem še več slabih novic: če gre za raka, kot so zdaj sumili, potem tisto, kar kaže rentgenski posnetek prsnega koša, ni njegov prvotni izvor. Verjetno se je začel nekje nižje v telesu in sčasoma prišel v pljuča.

nodes.source: The CT scan results confirmed that the Cancer was also in my para-aortic lymph nodes located by my abdomen, and gave a much clearer picture of my lungs with depth and clarity to confirm its spread.
nodes.text: Izvid CT-preiskave je potrdil, da je rak tudi v mojih paraaortnih bezgavkah ob trebušni votlini, in je veliko jasneje, globinsko ter natančno prikazal moja pljuča ter potrdil razširjenost bolezni.

nodes.source: A further Ultrasound scan on my testicles also confirmed that the most likely cause and primary location of the Cancer was in my right testicle.
nodes.text: Dodatni ultrazvočni pregled mod je prav tako potrdil, da je najverjetnejši vzrok in prvotno mesto raka v mojem desnem modu.

nodes.source: Something I had suspected some 18 months back!
nodes.text: Nekaj, na kar sem posumil že pred kakšnimi 18 meseci!

nodes.source: I was transferred to Charing Cross Hospital by wheelchair in an ambulance as an emergency case (no blue lights, though!).
nodes.text: Kot nujni primer so me z reševalnim vozilom, v invalidskem vozičku, premestili v bolnišnico Charing Cross (vendar brez modrih luči!).

nodes.source: All this time, I still looked as healthy on the outside as I had before, a young man with a nasty cough and absolutely no other symptoms whatsoever from any single part of my body.
nodes.text: Ves ta čas sem bil na zunaj še vedno videti enako zdrav kot prej. Mlad moški z neprijetnim kašljem in brez prav nobenih drugih simptomov kjerkoli v telesu.

nodes.source: I called my GP's surgery to inform them that I wouldn't be turning up at 5pm!
nodes.text: Poklical sem ambulanto osebnega zdravnika in jim povedal, da me ob 17.00 ne bo!

nodes.source: Once at Charing Cross, I was wheeled in my chair to the 6th floor. There was an immediate difference in newness between West Mid and Charing Cross but comfort was coming from the fact that I was now going to be treated in a Hospital that had years of experience and expertise - over and above any of the other hospitals in the area.
nodes.text: Ko sem prispel v Charing Cross, so me na vozičku odpeljali v šesto nadstropje. Takoj je bilo opaziti razliko med novostjo bolnišnice West Mid in Charing Cross. Vendar me je pomirjalo dejstvo, da me bodo zdaj zdravili v bolnišnici z dolgoletnimi izkušnjami in strokovnim znanjem, boljšim kot v drugih bolnišnicah v okolici.

nodes.source: I waited a while to be seen by my consultant and, to put a 40 minute conversation very briefly, I was told that my prognosis was good, a 4 out of 5 chance of a complete and full recovery from Testicular Cancer. Some 4 months of Chemotherapy in and out of hospital and getting ill to get better lay in wait for me, but it's my only choice.
nodes.text: Nekaj časa sem čakal na pregled pri specialistu. Če 40-minutni pogovor povzamem zelo na kratko: povedali so mi, da je moja prognoza dobra, štiri možnosti od petih za popolno okrevanje od raka mod. Čakajo me kakšni štirje meseci kemoterapije v bolnišnici in zunaj nje in najprej bom moral zboleti, da bom lahko ozdravel, vendar je to moja edina izbira.

nodes.source: I had to ask a final, but obvious, hypothetical question...
nodes.text: Moral sem postaviti še zadnje, a očitno hipotetično vprašanje ...

nodes.source: "As I feel fine and could walk out of here now, what if I didn't want any treatment whatsoever?"
nodes.text: »Ker se počutim dobro in bi lahko zdaj odšel od tod, kaj pa, če sploh ne bi želel nobenega zdravljenja?«

nodes.source: "You'd have less than a year to live"
nodes.text: »Živeli bi manj kot leto dni.«

nodes.source: So that really kicks the facts home I guess, Chemotherapy treatment or die, a simple one to work out!!! So, whatever it takes, however long, and whatever side effects I have to put up with, they pale into insignificance compared to the alternative.
nodes.text: Mislim, da to res jasno postavi dejstva na svoje mesto. Kemoterapija ali smrt, ni težko izbrati!!! Torej, karkoli bo potrebno, kakorkoli dolgo bo trajalo in kakršnekoli stranske učinke bom moral prenašati, so ti povsem nepomembni v primerjavi z drugo možnostjo.

nodes.source: A room was allocated to me and I decided to stay in hospital to try and keep the room as my Chemotherapy treatment would start the following week. Although the consultant was happy for me to retire home until the following week, I felt more comfortable being in this environment, considering the news I was still trying to take in and believe.
nodes.text: Dodelili so mi sobo in odločil sem se ostati v bolnišnici, da bi jo poskusil obdržati, saj bi se kemoterapija začela naslednji teden. Čeprav se je specialist strinjal, da bi se do naslednjega tedna vrnil domov, sem se v tem okolju počutil varneje glede na novice, ki sem jih še vedno poskušal dojeti in jim verjeti.

nodes.source: 11th December 2004 - Saturday
nodes.text: 11. decembra 2004 - sobota

nodes.source: I had to return home to refill my Mum's Parkinson's medication schedule to cover her whilst I was in hospital. Leaving the hospital was all cleared with the powers that be, so I had a shower and a good freshen up and left for Hounslow in order to be back to Hospital for dinner at 6pm. Being out of Hospital after the news I had been given was a weird experience, almost like I shouldn't be out of my comfort zone in case anything was to happen to me, so I felt a little anxious to say the least. Although sorting my Mum out was a priority, I now also had my own welfare to be concerned about.
nodes.text: Moral sem se vrniti domov, da sem mami pripravil zdravila za Parkinsonovo bolezen po urniku za čas, ko bom v bolnišnici. Odhod iz bolnišnice so mi pristojni odobrili, zato sem se oprhal, se dobro osvežil in odšel v Hounslow, da bi bil ob 18.00 spet v bolnišnici na večerji. Biti zunaj bolnišnice po novicah, ki sem jih dobil, je bilo nenavadno, skoraj kot da ne bi smel zapustiti svojega varnega okolja, če bi se mi kaj zgodilo. Bil sem torej, milo rečeno, precej tesnoben. Čeprav je bila ureditev stvari za mamo prednostna naloga, sem moral zdaj skrbeti tudi za lastno dobrobit.

nodes.source: Upon returning to hospital at 6pm I discovered that dinner was served at 5pm so my best friend Ken Clark who, so far, has been through this whole daunting experience with me, popped over to Pizza Express which I can see from my window, to pick up some dinner.
nodes.text: Ko sem se ob 18.00 vrnil v bolnišnico, sem ugotovil, da je bila večerja ob 17.00. Zato je moj najboljši prijatelj Ken Clark, ki je bil doslej z mano skozi vso to zastrašujočo izkušnjo, skočil v Pizza Express, ki ga vidim skozi okno, po nekaj za večerjo.

nodes.source: 12th December 2004 - Sunday
nodes.text: 12. decembra 2004 - nedelja

nodes.source: The day passed with relative calmness although anticipation was building for my Sperm Banking, EDTA and MRI tests over the next couple of days.
nodes.text: Dan je minil razmeroma mirno, čeprav je naraščalo pričakovanje pred shranjevanjem sperme ter preiskavama EDTA in MRI v naslednjih nekaj dneh.

nodes.source: 13th December 2004 - Monday
nodes.text: 13. decembra 2004 - ponedeljek

nodes.source: A visit to Hammersmith Hospital over lunchtime for some Banking (I'm not going into detail here!) and discussions about how, when and who I consent to using it in the future. All consents are far from set in stone and can be changed as and when needed, but if something happened to me and I hadn't changed them, the laws surrounding consents can be very strict and would stick to the last consent I had given.
nodes.text: Okoli kosila sem obiskal bolnišnico Hammersmith za nekaj shranjevanja v banko (tu ne bom šel v podrobnosti!) in pogovore o tem, kako, kdaj in komu dovolim uporabo v prihodnje. Vsa soglasja še zdaleč niso dokončna in jih lahko po potrebi spreminjam. Če pa bi se mi kaj zgodilo in jih prej ne bi spremenil, so lahko predpisi glede soglasij zelo strogi in bi veljalo zadnje soglasje, ki sem ga dal.

nodes.source: 14th December 2004 - Tuesday
nodes.text: 14. decembra 2004 - torek

nodes.source: Down to the 1st floor for my EDTA test at 11am which requires me to be back at 2 hour intervals, 1pm and 3pm which gave me a brief chance to get over to Hammersmith between 1pm and 3pm for another session of Banking! Increasing my future chances of having a family is a nice insurance policy to add to but on the scale of things my recovery comes first.
nodes.text: Ob 11.00 v prvo nadstropje na preiskavo EDTA, pri kateri se moram vračati na dve uri, torej ob 13.00 in 15.00. Tako sem imel kratko priložnost, da sem med 13.00 in 15.00 šel v Hammersmith na še eno shranjevanje v banko! Povečevati prihodnje možnosti za družino je lepo dodatno zavarovanje, a v celotni sliki je moje okrevanje na prvem mestu.

nodes.source: Back to the ward for my dinner at 5pm then a short wait for my first round of Chemotherapy, this was all explained to me in full before treatment began. Due to the lateness of its start, and the schedule of drugs they feed me intravenously, it made for a disturbing night with visits to the loo dragging a machine along with me and getting out of bed to be weighed in the early hours.
nodes.text: Ob 17.00 nazaj na oddelek na večerjo, nato pa kratko čakanje na prvi krog kemoterapije. Pred začetkom zdravljenja so mi vse podrobno pojasnili. Ker se je začelo tako pozno in zaradi razporeda zdravil, ki mi jih dajejo v žilo, je bila noč nemirna: obiski stranišča z napravo, ki sem jo vlekel za sabo, in zgodnje jutranje vstajanje iz postelje zaradi tehtanja.

nodes.source: 15th December 2004 - Wednesday
nodes.text: 15. decembra 2004 - sreda

nodes.source: Chemotherapy didn't finish on time this morning today, so I had to break away from it to rush down for my MRI scan. I was fast asleep and luckily Ken arrived early to wake me and get me down to the 1st floor for the scan, something the nurses should have done!!
nodes.text: Kemoterapija se danes zjutraj ni končala pravočasno, zato sem jo moral prekiniti in pohiteti na MRI. Trdno sem spal in na srečo je Ken prišel zgodaj, me zbudil ter me odpeljal v prvo nadstropje na slikanje. Nekaj, kar bi morale narediti medicinske sestre!!

nodes.source: The MRI was pretty straight forward, a small injection in my arm and into the scanner I slid. I wasn't afraid; it was a little noisy and I stayed as still as possible so the resulting image would be as clear as it could be.
nodes.text: MRI je potekal precej preprosto: majhna injekcija v roko in zdrsnil sem v aparat. Ni me bilo strah; bilo je malo hrupno in poskušal sem biti kar se da pri miru, da bi bila slika čim jasnejša.

nodes.source: Back to the ward for the final blast of Chemotherapy and then I was free for the day. After one night of Chemotherapy I didn't feel much different.
nodes.text: Nazaj na oddelek na zadnji odmerek kemoterapije, nato sem bil za tisti dan prost. Po eni noči kemoterapije se nisem počutil kaj dosti drugače.

nodes.source: The night came quickly and I was soon connected up to the Chemotherapy drip again. They were very busy on my ward and when it came to changing my dosage bag I was left for quite some time with no through flow, this caused quite a bit of discomfort in my hand and a burning sensation.
nodes.text: Večer je hitro prišel in kmalu sem bil spet priključen na kemoterapevtsko infuzijo. Na oddelku so imeli veliko dela in ko je bilo treba zamenjati vrečko z odmerkom, sem kar nekaj časa ostal brez pretoka. To je povzročilo precej nelagodja v roki in pekoč občutek.

nodes.source: Another disturbing night with dosage changes, wee'ing and weighing! I did sleep better though, probably fatigued from the night before.
nodes.text: Še ena nemirna noč z menjavami odmerkov, lulanjem in tehtanjem! Vseeno sem spal bolje, verjetno zaradi utrujenosti od prejšnje noči.

nodes.source: 16th December 2004 - Thursday
nodes.text: 16. decembra 2004 - četrtek

nodes.source: Morning came and the Chemotherapy treatment again finished a little late. Today I was to be free of any lines or taps in my hand, just another blood test, that's all.
nodes.text: Prišlo je jutro in kemoterapija se je spet končala nekoliko pozno. Danes naj bi bil brez vseh cevk in nastavkov v roki, le še ena krvna preiskava, to je vse.

nodes.source: Again I was feeling fine and ate everything that was put in front of me.
nodes.text: Spet sem se počutil dobro in pojedel vse, kar so postavili predme.

nodes.source: I got a look at my X-ray and MRI scans today. Thankfully the MRI was clear - still to be officially confirmed by my consultant - and the X-ray was an obvious indication that this disease was inside me and meaning business.
nodes.text: Danes sem si ogledal rentgenske in MRI-posnetke. Na srečo je bil MRI čist, kar mora specialist še uradno potrditi, rentgenski posnetek pa je jasno pokazal, da je ta bolezen v meni in da misli resno.

nodes.source: The day went swiftly, although I tired towards the end, I still found the energy to set up Milton's (my ward buddy) new iMac G5, which gave him great pleasure. He's now even busier with his crusade to offer a positive approach to dealing with serious diseases like ours.
nodes.text: Dan je hitro minil. Čeprav sem bil proti koncu utrujen, sem še vedno našel energijo, da sem Miltonu, svojemu kolegu z oddelka, nastavil novi iMac G5, kar ga je zelo razveselilo. Zdaj je še bolj zaposlen s svojim poslanstvom, da bi ponudil pozitiven pristop k spoprijemanju z resnimi boleznimi, kot sta najini.

nodes.source: 17th December 2004 - Friday
nodes.text: 17. decembra 2004 - petek

nodes.source: Slept well, albeit a little sweaty during the night.
nodes.text: Dobro sem spal, čeprav sem se ponoči nekoliko potil.

nodes.source: Today a brief chat about my test results with my consultant confirmed that the MRI test was clear, the blood test clear, the kidney test (EDTA) was good and all in order. My X-ray was alarming but the CT showed I still have plenty of lung space to breathe with comfortably and fight this disease.
nodes.text: Danes je kratek pogovor s specialistom o mojih izvidih potrdil, da je MRI čist, krvni izvid v redu, preiskava ledvic (EDTA) dobra in vse tako, kot mora biti. Rentgenski posnetek je bil zaskrbljujoč, vendar je CT pokazal, da imam še vedno dovolj pljučnega prostora za udobno dihanje in boj s to boleznijo.

nodes.source: Discharge day today, home for the weekend. A bit of a wait around for my medication to take home and I was off the ward and home in no time, a surreal experience since going in to A&E over a week ago!
nodes.text: Danes je dan odpusta, za konec tedna domov. Nekaj čakanja na zdravila za domov, potem pa sem bil v hipu z oddelka in doma. Nadrealistična izkušnja, glede na to, da sem pred dobrim tednom šel na urgenco!

nodes.source: 18th December 2004 - Saturday
nodes.text: 18. decembra 2004 - sobota

nodes.source: Slept well in my own bed last night, felt sweaty again during the night.
nodes.text: Sinoči sem dobro spal v svoji postelji, ponoči sem se spet potil.

nodes.source: Ate breakfast, ate lunch, went to see my Mum briefly then back home for dinner.
nodes.text: Pojedel zajtrk, pojedel kosilo, na kratko obiskal mamo, nato pa nazaj domov na večerjo.

nodes.source: I was asked by the doctors to monitor my temperature, matched with how I am feeling whilst at home. I didn't feel any different and my temperature was reasonable at all times (normal should be 36.5 C).
nodes.text: Zdravniki so me prosili, naj doma spremljam temperaturo skupaj s svojim počutjem. Počutil sem se enako kot prej in temperatura je bila ves čas primerna (normalna naj bi bila 36,5 °C).

nodes.source: 19th December 2004 - Sunday
nodes.text: 19. decembra 2004 - nedelja

nodes.source: Slept a bit more awkwardly, woke up wide eyed, sweating, with a slight pain in my left lung during the night and couldn't sleep again for a bit for thinking about all that has gone on so far. Bounced myself off the walls in the dark and found the loo, back to bed and I was asleep in no time.
nodes.text: Spal sem malo bolj nemirno. Ponoči sem se prebudil čisto buden, prepoten, z rahlo bolečino v levem pljučnem krilu, nato pa nekaj časa nisem mogel zaspati, ker sem razmišljal o vsem, kar se je zgodilo do zdaj. V temi sem se zaletaval v stene, našel stranišče, se vrnil v posteljo in takoj zaspal.

nodes.source: This morning I'm OK, had a bit of a lie in (what's new!). The Sun is shining brightly out there today.
nodes.text: Danes zjutraj sem v redu, malo sem dlje poležal (kaj je tu novega!). Zunaj danes močno sije sonce.

nodes.source: Relaxed all day at home, away from all the Xmas bustle outside that I keep hearing about from my friends that have phoned or visited.
nodes.text: Ves dan sem se sproščal doma, daleč od zunanjega božičnega vrveža, o katerem mi pripovedujejo prijatelji, ki so me poklicali ali obiskali.

nodes.source: Back to hospital tomorrow. I'll be in for a while for my first phase of full blown BEP Chemotherapy. Getting a bit nervous.
nodes.text: Jutri nazaj v bolnišnico. Nekaj časa bom tam zaradi prve faze polne kemoterapije BEP. Postajam malo živčen.

nodes.source: 20th December 2004 - Monday
nodes.text: 20. decembra 2004 - ponedeljek

nodes.source: Slept really well although doing the usual sweating thing.
nodes.text: Res dobro sem spal, čeprav sem se kot običajno potil.

nodes.source: It's hospital day today, not so daunting as I think the reason I'm going in today is just for NHS bed logistics, either that or 2 days away is all they are going to give me, considering the condition inside my body.
nodes.text: Danes je dan za bolnišnico. Ni tako zastrašujoče, saj mislim, da se vračam danes predvsem zaradi razporejanja postelj NHS. Ali pa mi glede na stanje v mojem telesu dovolijo le dva dneva odsotnosti.

nodes.source: I almost don't want to go back to hospital, but know that I have no choice.
nodes.text: Skoraj se nočem vrniti v bolnišnico, vendar vem, da nimam izbire.

nodes.source: Back at hospital now, a new Ward (6 West, F7). Nervous at first, but now settled, oh and of course they had to give me a blood test didn't they!!
nodes.text: Zdaj sem spet v bolnišnici, na novem oddelku (6 West, F7). Sprva živčen, zdaj pa sem se že namestil. Aja, seveda so mi morali spet vzeti kri, kajne!!

nodes.source: Big day tomorrow, as far as I know. See you then.
nodes.text: Jutri je velik dan, kolikor vem. Se vidimo takrat.

nodes.source: 21st December 2004 - Tuesday
nodes.text: 21. decembra 2004 - torek

nodes.source: Slept well although didn't go to bed until 3am as I was chilling out with Milton. This new ward I'm on doesn't even bring you breakfast, cheek!
nodes.text: Dobro sem spal, čeprav sem šel spat šele ob 3.00 zjutraj, ker sva se sproščala z Miltonom. Na tem novem oddelku, kjer sem zdaj, ti še zajtrka ne prinesejo, kakšna predrznost!

nodes.source: My 2 registrars (Dr's) came round to see me (they are under supervision by my consultant, the only one from whom I will take medical orders/instructions). They seemed pretty upbeat and happy to see me, and my initial blood results from yesterday all looked good. It seems my body is as ready as it's going to be for this Chemotherapy and they are preparing to give it to me this afternoon. They reiterated that it would be a much bigger dosage than I was given last week. Let's hope I can tough the effects out, I'm going to have a bloody good go.
nodes.text: Obiskala sta me moja dva specializanta (zdravnika), ki delata pod nadzorom mojega specialista, edinega, od katerega sprejemam zdravstvena navodila. Videti sta bila precej optimistična in vesela, da me vidita, tudi moji prvi včerajšnji krvni izvidi so bili dobri. Zdi se, da je moje telo tako pripravljeno na kemoterapijo, kot je sploh lahko, in pripravljajo vse, da jo bom dobil danes popoldne. Ponovno sta poudarila, da bo odmerek precej večji kot prejšnji teden. Upajmo, da bom učinke zmogel prenesti, prekleto dobro se bom potrudil.

nodes.source: Breakfast done and they are taking my blood again, although the experience is becoming easier as my new Dr's assistant/phlebotomist (blood sucker), Sylvia, is a master at taking blood and does a sterling job with me - 'the big baby' when it comes to needles.
nodes.text: Zajtrk je za mano in spet mi jemljejo kri. Izkušnja je sicer vse lažja, saj je nova zdravniška pomočnica oziroma oseba za odvzem krvi (krvoses), Sylvia, prava mojstrica odvzemanja krvi in se odlično znajde z mano, »velikim dojenčkom«, ko gre za igle.

nodes.source: Another blood test this afternoon, what are these people after? My life and soul? I must admit I might be getting used to these now, either that or my mind and body has given up worrying about it so much.
nodes.text: Popoldne še ena krvna preiskava. Kaj ti ljudje hočejo? Moje življenje in dušo? Priznati moram, da se jih morda že privajam, ali pa sta moja glava in telo preprosto nehala toliko skrbeti zaradi njih.

nodes.source: Chemotherapy time is fast approaching and the nasty experience of having a Cannula fitted to my arm has to be overcome first.
nodes.text: Čas kemoterapije se hitro bliža, najprej pa moram prestati neprijetno vstavljanje kanile v roko.

nodes.source: Well it took them 3 goes to get the big Cannula needle in my arm; I hated this experience. Now I'm connected up and have a full 15 hours of intravenous drip Chemotherapy ahead, this will take me well into the morning tomorrow.
nodes.text: No, potrebovali so tri poskuse, da so mi veliko iglo s kanilo spravili v roko; to izkušnjo sem sovražil. Zdaj sem priključen in pred mano je celih 15 ur kemoterapije po intravenski infuziji, kar bo trajalo še globoko v jutrišnje jutro.

nodes.source: Had a few visitors tonight, been sitting in the TV room relaxing and chatting. Chemotherapy still going strong and making me wee a lot!!
nodes.text: Nocoj sem imel nekaj obiskov, sedel sem v televizijski sobi, se sproščal in klepetal. Kemoterapija še kar teče in zaradi nje veliko lulam!!

nodes.source: Off to bed soon, catch up with you all again tomorrow.
nodes.text: Kmalu grem spat, jutri se spet oglasim vsem.

nodes.source: 22nd December 2004 - Wednesday
nodes.text: 22. decembra 2004 - sreda

nodes.source: Slept quite well considering 15 hours of Concorde fuel has been pumped in to me (thanks Rog). I'm awake and feeling fine, just waiting to be disconnected so I can go for yet another pee and get myself some breakfast.
nodes.text: Kar dobro sem spal glede na to, da so mi 15 ur črpali gorivo za Concorda (hvala, Rog). Buden sem in se dobro počutim, samo čakam, da me odklopijo, da bom šel spet lulat in si priskrbel zajtrk.

nodes.source: Breaking news... I'm potentially moving wards today - I pulled some strings ;) - back to South ward where I started all this. I think they miss me!! I'm 33 years and 4 months old today, exactly. Yup, it makes you think about your age too!
nodes.text: Izredna novica ... danes se bom morda preselil na drug oddelek - malo sem potegnil za zveze ;) - nazaj na oddelek South, kjer se je vse začelo. Mislim, da me pogrešajo!! Danes sem star natanko 33 let in štiri mesece. Ja, zaradi tega začneš razmišljati tudi o svoji starosti!

nodes.source: Getting some great inspirational emails from you all, even from people I have never met, from the furthest corners of the earth, saying it's making them go get themselves checked out. What a surprise that my site is not only being used by those of you that wish to keep up to date with me, but also by people who may benefit from my experience.
nodes.text: Od vseh vas dobivam čudovita spodbudna e-sporočila, tudi od ljudi, ki jih nikoli nisem srečal, iz najbolj oddaljenih koncev sveta. Pišejo, da jih to spodbuja, da gredo na pregled. Kakšno presenečenje, da mojega spletnega mesta ne uporabljate le tisti, ki želite spremljati, kako sem, temveč tudi ljudje, ki jim lahko moja izkušnja koristi.

nodes.source: Moved wards now, back to the original place where everyone knows me. Although I might be annoying at times, I think they like me!
nodes.text: Zdaj sem se preselil, nazaj na prvotno mesto, kjer me vsi poznajo. Čeprav znam biti včasih nadležen, mislim, da me imajo radi!

nodes.source: Back on the Chemotherapy now, another 9 hours dragging an IV machine about, but feeling fine. Hearing more and more of people's Cancer stories is quite frightening, especially people who have a similar Cancer to myself. My only consolation is that EVERYBODY IS DIFFERENT and I have to keep saying that to myself to stay positive. Good test results are a good indication too, I'm chasing after some blood test results at the moment, tell you all about it later...
nodes.text: Zdaj sem spet na kemoterapiji, še devet ur bom vlačil infuzijsko napravo naokoli, ampak počutim se dobro. Ko slišim vedno več zgodb drugih ljudi o raku, je to precej strašljivo, še posebno pri ljudeh, ki imajo podobnega raka kot jaz. Moja edina tolažba je, da JE VSAK ČLOVEK DRUGAČEN, in to si moram ponavljati, da ostanem pozitiven. Tudi dobri izvidi so dober znak. Trenutno poizvedujem za nekaterimi krvnimi izvidi, več vam povem pozneje ...

nodes.source: The Consultant, with both his Registrars, found me loitering on the ward. They asked if I could follow them in to a quiet room (you know the feeling I was getting now, one of anticipation and worry). Sat me down and asked all about this website, which they'll be looking at soon. Also, mentioning the results of my HCG blood test almost in passing, a test they will be taking regularly throughout my treatment cycles. The HCG markers in my blood are an indication of my Cancer and its current level. When I first came in to the Charing Cross Hospital before any treatment, the reading was 3,900. It has now lowered itself to 3,300 which suggests an improvement and my body's positive reaction to the treatment so far. Although the Consultant would have been equally happy if these figures had mildly risen, although at a slow rate. No parties yet, however much it is good news; these levels can go up as well as down.
nodes.text: Specialist z obema specializantoma me je našel, ko sem se potikal po oddelku. Vprašali so, ali grem z njimi v mirno sobo (saj veste, kakšen občutek me je zdaj prevzel, pričakovanje in skrb). Posedli so me in spraševali o tem spletnem mestu, ki si ga bodo kmalu ogledali. Skoraj mimogrede so omenili tudi izvide krvne preiskave HCG, ki jo bodo redno opravljali med mojimi cikli zdravljenja. Označevalci HCG v moji krvi kažejo na raka in njegovo trenutno raven. Ko sem prvič prišel v bolnišnico Charing Cross, še pred zdravljenjem, je bila vrednost 3900. Zdaj se je znižala na 3300, kar kaže na izboljšanje in pozitiven odziv mojega telesa na dosedanje zdravljenje. Čeprav bi bil specialist enako zadovoljen tudi, če bi se te številke malo dvignile, vendar počasi. Še nobenih zabav, pa čeprav je to dobra novica; te ravni lahko gredo tako navzgor kot navzdol.

nodes.source: Originally I was told that 80 to 90 percent of the Cancer in my body should be an easy conquest, it's the last 10 percent that is the hard part to eradicate. So, all in all, so far we are heading in the right direction.
nodes.text: Prvotno so mi povedali, da naj bi 80 do 90 odstotkov raka v mojem telesu zlahka premagali, zadnjih deset odstotkov pa je najtežje izkoreniniti. Tako da gre vse skupaj za zdaj v pravo smer.

nodes.source: Ate double dinner tonight, one hospital meal and then a takeaway Pizza from Pizza Express across the road, appetite not gone yet, in-fact it's a little more furious at times.
nodes.text: Nocoj sem pojedel dvojno večerjo, en bolnišnični obrok in nato še pico za s seboj iz Pizza Expressa čez cesto. Apetit mi še ni izginil, pravzaprav je včasih še malo bolj silovit.

nodes.source: Feeling a little more fatigued tonight, especially in the legs, possibly an indication of some Chemotherapy side effects. Still on the Chemotherapy now, should be finished by midnight and then I can get an unrestricted night's sleep.
nodes.text: Nocoj se počutim nekoliko bolj utrujenega, zlasti v nogah, kar je morda znak stranskih učinkov kemoterapije. Še vedno jo prejemam, končana naj bi bila do polnoči, potem pa bom lahko spal brez omejitev.

nodes.source: 23rd December 2004 - Thursday
nodes.text: 23. decembra 2004 - četrtek

nodes.source: Awoke early today at 6am to have my blood pressure checked etc. Usual routine but I awoke with a startle and nearly karate chopped (like Inspector Clueso) the nurse. I warned her to be a little kinder when waking me or her life might be on the line!
nodes.text: Danes sem se zbudil zgodaj, ob 6.00, da so mi izmerili krvni tlak in podobno. Običajna rutina, vendar sem se prestrašen zdramil in skoraj s karate udarcem (kot inšpektor Clouseau) mahnil medicinsko sestro. Opozoril sem jo, naj me zbudi malo nežneje, sicer bo morda njeno življenje na kocki!

nodes.source: Got back to sleep for a bit, despite a lot of activity on my ward. Breakfast out the way now, I usually have 2 Weetabix with warm milk. Got my Christmas dinner menu today, hospital Christmas dinner whoopee! The doctors and nurses really pity you when then hear that you are in for the Xmas period, I'm so not bothered they cannot believe it. Honestly, when faced with something like this, nothing else should matter but your recovery (I was never really an Xmas person anyway, I'll save all my Xmas joy for the day when and if I'm given the chance to have my own family).
nodes.text: Kljub velikemu dogajanju na oddelku sem še malo zaspal. Zajtrk je zdaj za mano, običajno pojem dva Weetabixa s toplim mlekom. Danes sem dobil jedilnik za božično večerjo. Bolnišnična božična večerja, juhu! Zdravniki in medicinske sestre te res pomilujejo, ko slišijo, da boš tukaj za božič. Sploh me ne moti in tega ne morejo verjeti. Iskreno, ko se soočaš z nečim takim, ne bi smelo biti pomembno nič razen okrevanja (tudi sicer nikoli nisem bil velik božični navdušenec, vse svoje božično veselje bom prihranil za dan, ko in če bom dobil priložnost za lastno družino).

nodes.source: Third day of Chemotherapy today, another 9 hours connected to a drip machine. That should be around 2pm I guess so making the most of my unattached freedom is a must.
nodes.text: Danes je tretji dan kemoterapije, še devet ur priključen na infuzijsko napravo. Mislim, da se bo začelo okoli 14.00, zato moram čim bolj izkoristiti svobodo brez cevk.

nodes.source: Ahh, I saw the blood test trolley come round just now and yes they wanted some... I must be getting used to these now as it went OK although I still didn't look!
nodes.text: Ah, ravnokar sem videl voziček za odvzem krvi in ja, hoteli so je nekaj ... Očitno se res že privajam, ker je šlo v redu, čeprav še vedno nisem gledal!

nodes.source: The Registrars came through to have a quick word, nothing major just a friendly 'how you feeling' and I think they can see I'm doing just fine so far.
nodes.text: Specializanti so prišli na kratko poklepetat, nič posebnega, le prijazen »Kako se počutite?«. Mislim, da vidijo, da mi gre za zdaj povsem dobro.

nodes.source: Lunch out the way, a quick bath, shave and dressed to impress. I'm on top form for another 9 hour round with the Chemotherapy IV machine.
nodes.text: Kosilo za mano, hitro kopanje, britje in oblečen, da naredim vtis. V vrhunski formi sem za še en deveturni krog z infuzijsko napravo za kemoterapijo.

nodes.source: Today marks 2 weeks since I was first diagnosed with Cancer. How about that?
nodes.text: Danes sta minila dva tedna, odkar so mi prvič diagnosticirali raka. Kaj pravite na to?

nodes.source: I've just witnessed the inception of Milton's Xmas single which should be available on his site for download tomorrow or Xmas day. Please support him and go get yourself a copy from his site. He's a fine musician indeed.
nodes.text: Pravkar sem bil priča nastanku Miltonovega božičnega singla, ki naj bi bil jutri ali na božič na voljo za prenos z njegovega spletnega mesta. Prosim, podprite ga in si priskrbite izvod z njegovega spletnega mesta. Res je odličen glasbenik.

nodes.source: Ken went out for Kebab Kid for us all tonight (another 4th meal, appetite is still good). I've really fancied one since being here and being not so far away from my favourite kebab shop (very unlike your traditional drunken kebab shop, this has been voted one of the best in London by Time Out). Regular takeaway food is not advisable while on Chemotherapy but I would say KK passes the tests! It certainly went down fast enough with a bag of chips to follow.
nodes.text: Ken je nocoj za vse nas šel po hrano v Kebab Kid (še četrti obrok, apetit je še vedno dober). Odkar sem tukaj, si ga res želim, saj nisem daleč od svoje najljubše prodajalne kebaba (prav nič ni podobna običajni kebabni postojanki po pijančevanju; Time Out jo je uvrstil med najboljše v Londonu). Običajna hrana za s seboj med kemoterapijo ni priporočljiva, vendar bi rekel, da KK prestane preizkus! Vsekakor je izginil dovolj hitro, za njim pa še vrečka krompirčka.

nodes.source: A friend  is here taking pictures of Milton and I, for our web-sites (providing his Kebab with chillies stops repeating on him!); they'll be up on the website soon.
nodes.text: Prijatelj je tukaj in fotografira Miltona in mene za najini spletni mesti (če mu bo njegov kebab s čilijem le nehal povzročati spahovanje!); fotografije bodo kmalu na spletnem mestu.

nodes.source: Only a few hours of Chemotherapy to go tonight; running a bit behind and should be finished tonight by 1am. I'm sure I'll be suitably tired by then.
nodes.text: Nocoj je ostalo le še nekaj ur kemoterapije. Malo zamujamo in končala naj bi se ob 1.00 zjutraj. Prepričan sem, da bom takrat že primerno utrujen.

nodes.source: Signing off for now... until tomorrow...
nodes.text: Za zdaj se odjavljam ... do jutri ...

nodes.source: 24th December 2004 - Friday (Xmas Eve)
nodes.text: 24. december 2004 - petek (božični večer)

nodes.source: Chemotherapy day 4 today, should start around 2pm'ish!
nodes.text: Danes je četrti dan kemoterapije, začela naj bi se nekje okoli 14.00!

nodes.source: Didn't sleep brilliantly last night, not for want of it though! Bleeps and beeps from other patients' machines kept me in a light sleep and also a few visits to the loo. I keep mentioning my visits to the loo because it's actually a good sign that my kidneys are flushing correctly and quickly, especially with all this Chemotherapy I am having, it's all fluid given by IV and if I retained it all I'd probably drown!!
nodes.text: Sinoči nisem spal najbolje, čeprav sem si to želel! Piskanje naprav drugih bolnikov me je zadrževalo v rahlem spanju, pa tudi nekaj obiskov stranišča. Te obiske stalno omenjam, ker so pravzaprav dober znak, da moje ledvice pravilno in hitro izpirajo telo, še posebno ob vsej kemoterapiji, ki jo dobivam. Vse je tekočina, dana v žilo, in če bi jo zadržal, bi se verjetno utopil!!

nodes.source: Breakfast all done, I had the usual. Just going to relax a bit and reply to a few more of the many supportive emails I've received from you all.
nodes.text: Zajtrk je za mano, imel sem običajno. Zdaj se bom malo sprostil in odgovoril še na nekaj številnih spodbudnih e-sporočil, ki sem jih prejel od vseh vas.

nodes.source: One of the nurses was humming "Here comes the Sun" by George Harrison whilst making my bed, a song close to my heart. It was like a little message to me as I've always come across it at emotional or special times in my life. I'm guessing she heard it in Milton's room earlier and now I cannot get it out of my head (I'm not really trying to either!).
nodes.text: Ena od medicinskih sester si je med postiljanjem moje postelje brundala pesem »Here Comes the Sun« Georgea Harrisona, ki mi je zelo pri srcu. Bilo je kot majhno sporočilo zame, saj me je ta pesem vedno srečala v čustvenih ali posebnih trenutkih življenja. Predvidevam, da jo je prej slišala v Miltonovi sobi, zdaj pa mi ne gre iz glave (pravzaprav se je niti ne trudim spraviti iz nje!).

nodes.source: I hope you enjoy the new images section (thanks Ken), I'll be adding to them frequently now, mainly throughout each phase of my Intense Chemotherapy. IF there's a change in the way I look over time, which there may well be, then I don't want you to become alarmed - it's all part of the healing process, I'm suitably informed (or at least the side effects of Chemotherapy). Mind you, for those of you that don't know me, I'm not that good looking anyway ;-) !!!
nodes.text: Upam, da vam je všeč novi oddelek s slikami (hvala, Ken). Zdaj jih bom redno dodajal, predvsem med vsako fazo intenzivne kemoterapije. ČE se bo moj videz sčasoma spremenil, kar je prav mogoče, nočem, da vas zaskrbi. Vse je del procesa zdravljenja, kot so mi ustrezno pojasnili (ali vsaj stranskih učinkov kemoterapije). Sicer pa za tiste, ki me ne poznate: tako ali tako nisem tako lep ;-) !!!

nodes.source: Had a visit from my consultant and one of his registrars again. They're still happy with my progress and will be taking another blood test today! I also have to have an injection whilst at home called a G-CSF which should help me stay healthy over and above any side effects of Chemotherapy. Can you see me injecting myself, I don't think so! Any volunteers, a nice nurse perhaps?
nodes.text: Spet sta me obiskala specialist in eden njegovih specializantov. Še vedno sta zadovoljna z mojim napredkom in danes mi bodo spet vzeli kri! Tudi doma bom moral dobivati injekcijo, imenovano G-CSF, ki naj bi mi pomagala ostati zdrav kljub stranskim učinkom kemoterapije. Si me predstavljate, da se sam zbadam? Jaz ne! Kak prostovoljec, morda prijazna medicinska sestra?

nodes.source: I've just completed a massive update in the Links section of my site for those of you that are interested to read more detail about some of the tests and medical names I have mentioned.
nodes.text: Pravkar sem močno posodobil razdelek s povezavami na svojem spletnem mestu za vse, ki vas zanima več podrobnosti o nekaterih preiskavah in medicinskih izrazih, ki sem jih omenil.

nodes.source: Blood test done, I'm definitely getting used to these or I have found the best nurse there is at doing them; I want to give her a hug.
nodes.text: Krvni odvzem opravljen. Zagotovo se jih privajam ali pa sem našel najboljšo medicinsko sestro za odvzem krvi; kar objel bi jo.

nodes.source: Finally back on the Chemotherapy, it's been manic here this afternoon with patients being discharged and new patients arriving. They just haven't had time to get to me, so I had to go and beg them at the ward reception for my treatment to start. 4pm start time means I will not be free of the IV machine until just before 2am tonight, another late night!
nodes.text: Končno spet na kemoterapiji. Danes popoldne je bila tukaj prava norišnica z odpuščanjem bolnikov in prihodom novih. Preprosto niso imeli časa zame, zato sem jih moral na sprejemnem pultu oddelka prositi, naj se zdravljenje začne. Začetek ob 16.00 pomeni, da bom infuzijske naprave prost šele malo pred 2.00 zjutraj. Še ena pozna noč!

nodes.source: Some of the patients around me are in quite a bad way, a permanent reminder that Cancer is a potential killer and not to be ignored in our lives. A vicar has visited the patient opposite me, it really opens your eyes when it comes to that.
nodes.text: Nekateri bolniki okoli mene so v precej slabem stanju, kar je nenehen opomin, da je rak lahko morilec in ga v življenju ne smemo prezreti. Bolnika nasproti mene je obiskal duhovnik. Ko pride do tega, se ti res odprejo oči.

nodes.source: Chemotherapy schedule gone a bit haywire tonight, I'm still waiting for my final 4 hour bag at 22.45 which means I will not finish until 3am now. Another disturbed night, I'll not be rested well for Santa. Couldn't resist a Pizza Express blow-out tonight so Ken went down to get the takeaway order for us all.
nodes.text: Razpored kemoterapije se je nocoj malo podrl. Ob 22.45 še vedno čakam zadnjo štiriurno vrečko, kar pomeni, da bom končal šele ob 3.00 zjutraj. Še ena prekinjana noč, za Božička ne bom dobro spočit. Nocoj se nisem mogel upreti razkošni večerji iz Pizza Expressa, zato je Ken šel po naročilo za vse nas.

nodes.source: Definitely tiring for bed now and not looking forward to my noisy and delirious neighbour (a new addition to the ward), been seriously thinking about sleeping in the TV room under the Xmas tree!
nodes.text: Zdaj sem že res utrujen in bi šel spat. Nič se ne veselim svojega hrupnega in zmedenega soseda, ki je nov na oddelku. Resno razmišljam, da bi spal v televizijski sobi pod božičnim drevescem!

nodes.source: I hope that tonight Santa brings you all you wished for.
nodes.text: Upam, da vam Božiček nocoj prinese vse, kar ste si zaželeli.

nodes.source: 25th December 2004 - Saturday (Xmas Day)
nodes.text: 25. december 2004 - sobota (božič)

nodes.source: Merry Christmas to all of you. I don't expect many of you will be checking in on me today with all your presents and festivities. Not so much for me, as I'm doing just fine and Xmas doesn't bother me, but please spare a thought for those who are less fortunate than yourselves today. After all, Xmas is a time of giving, so a little kind thought wouldn't do you any harm! As I haven't had much time to organise Xmas cards for you all, Ken has kindly decorated my site for your Xmas enjoyment! What a cheapskate I am, one Xmas card for you all!!!
nodes.text: Vesel božič vsem. Ne pričakujem, da vas bo danes veliko preverjalo, kako sem, ob vseh darilih in praznovanju. Ne toliko zaradi mene, saj mi gre povsem dobro in me božič ne moti, vendar prosim danes pomislite tudi na tiste, ki imajo manj sreče kot vi. Navsezadnje je božič čas obdarovanja, zato vam kakšna prijazna misel ne bi škodila! Ker nisem imel veliko časa, da bi za vse organiziral božične voščilnice, je Ken prijazno okrasil moje spletno mesto za vaše božično veselje! Kakšen skopuh sem, ena voščilnica za vse!!!

nodes.source: Well I did manage a couple of hours on the sofa in the TV room whilst my Chemotherapy drip finished which, as I suspected, finished around 3am, the bleeper alarm woke me up. This also gave ample time for some medication to take effect on the delirious and noisy man that had moved next to me in my ward. I had to ask the nurses to do something; although I did feel sorry for him, I needed my sleep time too!!
nodes.text: No, medtem ko se je kemoterapevtska infuzija iztekala, sem uspel nekaj ur spati na kavču v televizijski sobi. Kot sem domneval, se je končala okoli 3.00 zjutraj in alarm me je zbudil. To je dalo tudi dovolj časa, da so zdravila prijela pri zmedenem in hrupnem moškem, ki se je preselil na posteljo ob meni. Medicinske sestre sem moral prositi, naj kaj ukrenejo. Čeprav se mi je smilil, sem tudi jaz potreboval svoj spanec!!

nodes.source: They've moved my noisy neighbour just now and the chap on the other side is not doing so well, in-fact he's just been sick so I'm putting off my breakfast until I get up to go get it, I'm having a cup of tea for now. This morning I feel rested but I hope to get an early night again tonight.
nodes.text: Mojega hrupnega soseda so zdaj premestili, moškemu na drugi strani pa ne gre najbolje. Pravkar je bruhal, zato bom z zajtrkom počakal, dokler ne vstanem in si ga grem iskat. Za zdaj pijem skodelico čaja. Danes zjutraj se počutim spočitega, a upam, da bom nocoj lahko šel zgodaj spat.

nodes.source: Waiting for my friend Ken to arrive before I open any of my presents, I expect something Xmas related will be going on in the ward today. Humbug!
nodes.text: Preden odprem katerokoli darilo, čakam, da pride moj prijatelj Ken. Predvidevam, da se bo danes na oddelku dogajalo kaj božičnega. Bah!

nodes.source: Noisy neighbour is back. I'm going to have to spend the day away from my bed, not such a bad thing I guess.
nodes.text: Hrupni sosed je nazaj. Dan bom moral preživeti stran od svoje postelje, kar pravzaprav morda niti ni tako slabo.

nodes.source: My consultant popped round to say hello, although not dressed in a Santa outfit... he's very happy with my progress so far!
nodes.text: Specialist me je prišel pozdravit, čeprav ni bil oblečen v Božička ... z mojim dosedanjim napredkom je zelo zadovoljen!

nodes.source: Xmas lunch out the way (in-fact they brought me two by mistake, the first one wasn't mine but by the time they realised I had eaten it and then they gave me another!). Chemotherapy is due to start again soon, it looks like it'll be another late one tonight. Milton has launched his alternative Christmas Single today "That's Christmas". Produced in 2.5 days from his hospital room whilst undergoing Chemotherapy, the (alternative) Christmas Single is all about what's crap about Christmas but great about people!
nodes.text: Božično kosilo je za mano (pravzaprav so mi po pomoti prinesli dve. Prvo ni bilo moje, a ko so to ugotovili, sem ga že pojedel, potem pa so mi dali še drugo!). Kemoterapija se bo kmalu spet začela. Videti je, da bo nocoj spet dolga noč. Milton je danes izdal svoj alternativni božični singel »That's Christmas«. Ustvaril ga je v dveh dneh in pol v bolnišnični sobi med kemoterapijo. Ta alternativni božični singel govori o tem, kaj je pri božiču zanič in kaj je pri ljudeh čudovito!

nodes.source: At last Chemotherapy has restarted at 15.50, which means approximately another 9 hours on before I'm finished tonight. The nurses bought me a gift of some shower scrub but no nurse to go along with it! The main present I really wanted for Xmas was my Chemotherapy; after all that's why I'm here, for treatment, let's get this whole thing in to focus again!
nodes.text: Končno se je kemoterapija spet začela ob 15.50, kar pomeni približno še devet ur, preden bom nocoj končal. Medicinske sestre so mi podarile piling za prhanje, vendar brez medicinske sestre zraven! Glavno darilo, ki sem si ga res želel za božič, je bila kemoterapija. Navsezadnje sem tukaj zaradi zdravljenja, postavimo vse skupaj spet v pravo perspektivo!

nodes.source: On the final 4 hour stint of my first major phase of Chemotherapy now, managed to get ahead of schedule, looks like I'll be finished by 2am. Hopefully they will have suitably calmed my neighbour so I can get to bed and get some decent shuteye.
nodes.text: Zdaj sem na zadnjem štiriurnem delu prve velike faze kemoterapije. Uspelo nam je malo prehiteti urnik in videti je, da bom končal do 2.00 zjutraj. Upam, da bodo soseda ustrezno pomirili, da bom lahko šel v posteljo in se pošteno naspal.

nodes.source: Still eating more, I've enjoyed a Hamper full of goodies tonight that one of my friends kindly brought over for me. There's been talk of me being discharged tomorrow, we'll see what that brings, I really don't mind either way, it depends on how I feel and how a new set of blood test results look in the morning.
nodes.text: Še vedno jem. Nocoj sem užival v košari, polni dobrot, ki mi jo je prijazno prinesel prijatelj. Govorili so o tem, da bi me jutri odpustili. Bomo videli, kaj bo. Pravzaprav mi je vseeno, odvisno je od počutja in od tega, kakšni bodo zjutraj novi krvni izvidi.

nodes.source: Sleep well with all your Xmas tummies!!
nodes.text: Dobro spite z vsemi svojimi božično polnimi trebuhi!!

nodes.source: 26th December 2004 - Sunday (Boxing Day)
nodes.text: 26. december 2004 - nedelja (drugi božični dan)

nodes.source: So much for the sleep, although what I did manage to get was reasonable, managed the 2am bedtime and went off to sleep almost immediately, only to be woken be the moans and screams of the man next to me at around 6.45am. I pressed my nurse call button to get him some attention but I think that there is nothing more they can do for him, he is delirious, confused, rambling and most of all sounds scared that he will be left alone to die.
nodes.text: Toliko o spanju. Kar sem ga uspel dobiti, je bilo sicer v redu. Ob 2.00 zjutraj sem šel v posteljo in skoraj takoj zaspal, nato pa me je okoli 6.45 zbudilo stokanje in kričanje moškega ob meni. Pritisnil sem gumb za klic medicinske sestre, da bi se mu kdo posvetil, a mislim, da zanj ne morejo storiti nič več. Je deliranten, zmeden, nepovezano govori in predvsem zveni prestrašen, da ga bodo pustili samega umreti.

nodes.source: It may sound harsh but I cannot do anything for him apart from call the nurse, I have detached myself from the situation now and have taken up residence in the TV room to spend the rest of my early morning in the peace and quiet of my own company (and a little TV!). It hurts quite a bit when I see others suffering around me, mainly terminal in my section of the ward. I must stay positive about my own condition, so some isolation in this room by myself was my only option.
nodes.text: Morda zveni kruto, vendar zanj ne morem storiti nič drugega kot poklicati medicinsko sestro. Zdaj sem se odmaknil od dogajanja in se naselil v televizijski sobi, da bom preostanek zgodnjega jutra preživel v miru in tišini svoje družbe (in malo televizije!). Precej me boli, ko vidim druge okoli sebe trpeti. Na mojem delu oddelka so večinoma neozdravljivo bolni. Glede svojega stanja moram ostati pozitiven, zato je bilo nekaj samote v tej sobi moja edina možnost.

nodes.source: It's starting to get busy now out in the corridors, it'll be breakfast time soon.
nodes.text: Na hodnikih je zdaj vse bolj živahno, kmalu bo zajtrk.

nodes.source: The usual breakfast out the way and it turns out I did need some more sleep as I dozed off on the sofa in the TV room. Woke up about an hour later.
nodes.text: Običajen zajtrk je za mano in izkazalo se je, da sem potreboval še malo spanja, saj sem zadremal na kavču v televizijski sobi. Zbudil sem se kakšno uro pozneje.

nodes.source: Just had a Blood Test, definitely easier to cope with but I'm still not watching! The result of which will determine both my requirement for the HCG injections and my current HCG counts.
nodes.text: Pravkar so mi vzeli kri. Vsekakor jo lažje prenašam, vendar še vedno ne gledam! Izvid bo določil tako, ali potrebujem injekcije HCG, kot moje trenutne vrednosti HCG.

nodes.source: Lunch approaching and I'm getting hungry, methinks it'll be quite a wait today before they give me their decision on my discharge and or injection schedule.
nodes.text: Bliža se kosilo in postajam lačen. Zdi se mi, da bom danes kar dolgo čakal, preden mi sporočijo odločitev o odpustu in/ali razporedu injekcij.

nodes.source: Discharged at 15.45 without the need for an immune boost (HCG) as my blood test results have shown that I tolerated the first phase of Chemotherapy very well. My body is still able to fight off infections by itself, although possibly mildly dampened, so I have to be careful of my exposure to germs etc.
nodes.text: Odpuščen ob 15.45 brez potrebe po spodbuditvi imunskega sistema (HCG), saj so krvni izvidi pokazali, da sem prvo fazo kemoterapije zelo dobro prenašal. Moje telo se še vedno lahko samo bori proti okužbam, čeprav je njegova obramba morda nekoliko zmanjšana, zato moram paziti na izpostavljenost klicam in podobnemu.

nodes.source: So this ends phase 1 of my particular Chemotherapy regime. I'm not sure if the strength of the Chemotherapy in the following 3 major phases will be increased in strength (this entry is going to serve as a reminder to me to get this answer as soon as possible). I will need more power and strength to overcome greater doses.
nodes.text: S tem se torej končuje prva faza mojega posebnega režima kemoterapije. Ne vem, ali bodo v naslednjih treh velikih fazah povečali jakost kemoterapije (ta zapis me bo spomnil, da moram čim prej dobiti odgovor). Za večje odmerke bom potreboval več moči in vzdržljivosti.

nodes.source: At the beginning of each major phase, I will be X-rayed to have some visual results as to the increase,
nodes.text: Na začetku vsake velike faze me bodo rentgensko slikali, da bi dobili vidno potrditev povečanja,

nodes.source: or more positively, and what I will be hoping for the most...
nodes.text: ali, bolj pozitivno in tisto, kar si bom najbolj želel ...

nodes.source: the demise of the Cancer that is showing on my lungs.
nodes.text: izginjanja raka, ki je viden v mojih pljučih.

nodes.source: Home for dinner and an undisturbed night's sleep.
nodes.text: Domov na večerjo in neprekinjen spanec.

nodes.source: 27th December 2004 - Monday
nodes.text: 27. decembra 2004 - ponedeljek

nodes.source: Good morning! I managed 8 hours of good sleep, I don't want to overdo the lie in as I still need to stick to a regular eating regime, so I'm about to go have my Weetabix but this time at home!
nodes.text: Dobro jutro! Uspelo mi je dobiti osem ur dobrega spanca. Nočem pretiravati s poležavanjem, ker se moram še naprej držati rednega prehranjevanja, zato grem zdaj pojest svoj Weetabix, tokrat doma!

nodes.source: It occurred to me last night that my consultant and doctors may be occasionally looking in on this diary, so not only is it acting as a means of communication for me and a means of awareness for others but also as a kind of Bio Monitor for my doctors, as they can just check in to see how I'm feeling!!
nodes.text: Sinoči sem pomislil, da moj specialist in zdravniki morda občasno pogledajo v ta dnevnik. Tako ni le moje sredstvo sporazumevanja in sredstvo ozaveščanja za druge, temveč tudi nekakšen biološki monitor za moje zdravnike, saj lahko samo pogledajo, kako se počutim!!

nodes.source: Well this morning I feel fine, apart from a little bit of a throat (probably from snoring after my comfortable sleep) and a snotty nose, can't explain that! I'll stick to my given tablet regime 1 Allopurinol 100mg in the morning along with 2 Domperidome 10mg 3 times a day. I also have a mouth wash to keep any nasty germs at bay, although my immune system result was good and I should be able fight off infection myself, I'll try not give it too much work to do. No feeling of sickness at all.
nodes.text: No, danes zjutraj se počutim dobro, razen malo bolečega grla (verjetno zaradi smrčanja po udobnem spancu) in smrkavega nosu, tega ne znam razložiti! Držal se bom predpisanega režima tablet: en alopurinol 100 mg zjutraj ter dve tableti domperidona po 10 mg trikrat na dan. Imam tudi ustno vodico za odganjanje nadležnih klic. Čeprav je bil izvid imunskega sistema dober in naj bi okužbe zmogel premagovati sam, mu bom poskusil prihraniti čim več dela. Nobenega občutka slabosti.

nodes.source: Wouldn't it be a good idea for temporarily discharged patients to wear a bio monitor to analyse statistics, the results of which would be available securely online to the doctors, and if anything went wildly wrong alarms would be raised etc. They put curfew monitors on prisoners these days, why not use similar technology? I'll shut up before I get carried away.
nodes.text: Ali ne bi bila dobra ideja, da bi začasno odpuščeni bolniki nosili biološki monitor za analizo podatkov, rezultati pa bi bili zdravnikom varno dostopni po spletu? Če bi šlo kaj močno narobe, bi se sprožili alarmi in podobno. Danes zapornikom nameščajo nadzorne zapestnice, zakaj ne bi uporabili podobne tehnologije? Utihnil bom, preden me zanese.

nodes.source: Been keeping myself busy all day; healthy eating and drinking very well indeed!
nodes.text: Ves dan sem se zaposloval; jedel zdravo in res dobro pil!

nodes.source: Tiring now, ready for another good night's sleep!
nodes.text: Zdaj postajam utrujen, pripravljen na še en dober nočni spanec!

nodes.source: 28th December 2004 - Tuesday
nodes.text: 28. decembra 2004 - torek

nodes.source: Another good night's sleep, although the 3 litres of water I drank during the course of yesterday had me up a few times! I didn't wake up until 11am this morning.
nodes.text: Še ena dobro prespana noč, čeprav sem zaradi treh litrov vode, ki sem jih spil čez včerajšnji dan, nekajkrat vstal! Danes zjutraj sem se zbudil šele ob 11.00.

nodes.source: Anticipation is building for my hospital visit tomorrow. I have my Emla cream (which numbs an area of skin like a local anaesthetic) at the ready to make the Cannulation (don't look at that link if you are squeamish) experience a little easier for me.
nodes.text: Pričakovanje jutrišnjega obiska bolnišnice narašča. Pripravljeno imam kremo Emla, ki omrtviči predel kože kot lokalni anestetik, da bo vstavljanje kanile malo lažje zame (ne odpirajte te povezave, če ste občutljivi).

nodes.source: Busy all day again, not eaten as well as other days, not through want of trying!!
nodes.text: Spet zaposlen ves dan, nisem jedel tako dobro kot druge dni, ne da se ne bi trudil!!

nodes.source: Today I have noticed a slight noise in my ears, more of a very high pitched tone than a ringing (which could be a chemo side effect), I thought I heard it yesterday but ignored it, the same happened today so I'm letting you know! Changes are afoot inside me, there's a full scale war going on and
nodes.text: Danes sem v ušesih opazil rahel zvok, bolj zelo visok ton kot zvonjenje (kar bi lahko bil stranski učinek kemoterapije). Zdi se mi, da sem ga slišal že včeraj, pa sem ga prezrl. Danes se je ponovilo, zato vam povem! V meni se dogajajo spremembe, poteka prava vojna in

nodes.source: I AM GOING TO WIN.
nodes.text: JAZ BOM ZMAGAL.

nodes.source: Not so sleepy tonight, may be the anticipation of tomorrow's events, plus I have to be up early in the morning, back to hospital regimes.
nodes.text: Nocoj nisem tako zaspan. Morda zaradi pričakovanja jutrišnjih dogodkov, pa še zgodaj moram vstati, spet bolnišnični režim.

nodes.source: 29th December 2004 - Wednesday
nodes.text: 29. decembra 2004 - sreda

nodes.source: Not much sleep last night, managed about 5 hours and awoke with a terrible cramp in the calf muscle of my right leg. I've never suffered from cramp apart from in my feet on a couple of rare occasions.
nodes.text: Sinoči nisem veliko spal, uspelo mi je kakšnih pet ur, zbudil pa sem se s hudim krčem v mečni mišici desne noge. Krčev nikoli nisem imel, razen nekaj redkih primerov v stopalih.

nodes.source: Got to the Hospital on time and checked in with South 6 to find out where I am to go for my outpatient treatment. Outpatient Chemotherapy is given on the same floor in the East wing of Charing Cross Hospital.
nodes.text: V bolnišnico sem prišel pravočasno in se oglasil na South 6, da izvem, kam moram na ambulantno zdravljenje. Ambulantno kemoterapijo dajejo v istem nadstropju vzhodnega krila bolnišnice Charing Cross.

nodes.source: Had my blood test taken, I didn't like this much today. My Chemotherapy has arrived in a special drug case and I'm due to start very soon.
nodes.text: Vzeli so mi kri, danes mi to ni bilo preveč všeč. Moja kemoterapija je prispela v posebnem kovčku za zdravila in kmalu naj bi se začela.

nodes.source: I had the Emla cream applied to my right arm at the time of my blood test in readiness for the Cannulation which I am still not looking forward to.
nodes.text: Ob odvzemu krvi so mi na desno roko nanesli kremo Emla kot pripravo na vstavljanje kanile, ki se ga še vedno ne veselim.

nodes.source: Briefly spoke with the doctor and he's confirmed that the dosages of Chemotherapy are to stay the same throughout my treatment, so here's hoping that I can tolerate the rest of this as well as I have so far.
nodes.text: Na kratko sem govoril z zdravnikom in potrdil je, da bodo odmerki kemoterapije med celotnim zdravljenjem ostali enaki. Upam torej, da bom preostanek prenašal tako dobro kot doslej.

nodes.source: Well what can I say, the Cannulation experience was a revelation, I didn't feel a thing. Not wanting to speak too soon, I might feel a sting when the effect wears off, but by far that must be the lesser of the two evils. The Emla cream worked a miracle and will now in future be my saviour.
nodes.text: No, kaj naj rečem, vstavljanje kanile je bilo pravo razodetje, ničesar nisem čutil. Nočem govoriti prezgodaj, morda bo zapeklo, ko učinek popusti, a to je zagotovo manjše od dveh zlov. Krema Emla je naredila čudež in bo od zdaj naprej moja rešiteljica.

nodes.source: Chemotherapy started at 11am, that means I should be finished at 5pm tonight. They will not let me move from this ward so I am a prisoner for 6 hours! I can see me watching quite a few DVDs on the laptop over the next few months of my outpatient visits.
nodes.text: Kemoterapija se je začela ob 11.00, kar pomeni, da naj bi danes končal ob 17.00. Ne pustijo mi zapustiti tega oddelka, zato bom šest ur zapornik! Predvidevam, da si bom v prihodnjih mesecih med ambulantnimi obiski na prenosniku ogledal kar precej DVD-jev.

nodes.source: Ok I've watched Collateral with Tom Cruise on my laptop, it's over and I'm bored. Feeling a little run down like I'm catching a cold; this is to be expected I'm told.
nodes.text: V redu, na prenosniku sem si ogledal Stranske učinke s Tomom Cruisom, film je končan in dolgčas mi je. Počutim se malo zdelanega, kot da se me loteva prehlad; pravijo mi, da je to pričakovano.

nodes.source: Looking forward to going home soon and relaxing.
nodes.text: Veselim se skorajšnjega odhoda domov in sprostitve.

nodes.source: Once home, I started feeling a chill and slightly feverish. Checked my temperature and it was just within limits, a bit of cramp in my feet this time and I got myself off to sleep on the sofa for a couple of hours.
nodes.text: Ko sem prišel domov, me je začelo zebsti in malo kuhati. Preveril sem temperaturo, ki je bila še ravno znotraj meja. Tokrat me je malo grabljalo v stopalih, nato pa sem za nekaj ur zaspal na kavču.

nodes.source: Couldn't eat my dinner tonight, just didn't feel hungry.
nodes.text: Nocoj nisem mogel pojesti večerje, preprosto nisem bil lačen.

nodes.source: I've woken up now and feel a little better.
nodes.text: Zdaj sem se zbudil in počutim se malo bolje.

nodes.source: A good night's sleep is ahead.
nodes.text: Pred mano je dober nočni spanec.

nodes.source: 30th December 2004 - Thursday
nodes.text: 30. decembra 2004 - četrtek

nodes.source: A solid sleep, interrupted by a few visits to the loo. I normally sleep right through, so I can only imagine this increased water works activity is due to the extra fluid I have taken on during Chemotherapy.
nodes.text: Trden spanec, prekinjen z nekaj obiski stranišča. Običajno prespim vso noč, zato si predstavljam, da je to povečano delovanje vodovoda posledica dodatne tekočine, ki sem jo dobil med kemoterapijo.

nodes.source: I've had a lazy morning, didn't get up until 10.30am and certainly feel a whole load better than I did last night. So far last night was the worst I have felt in a long while. No sickness, but lost my appetite completely and had a fever/chill.
nodes.text: Imel sem lenobno jutro, vstal sem šele ob 10.30 in zagotovo se počutim veliko bolje kot sinoči. Sinoči sem se doslej počutil najslabše po dolgem času. Ni mi bilo slabo, vendar sem povsem izgubil apetit in imel vročino oziroma mrzlico.

nodes.source: Hopefully back on track today after a light breakfast and some orange juice.
nodes.text: Upam, da bom po lahkem zajtrku in malo pomarančnega soka danes spet na pravi poti.

nodes.source: I will definitely be taking it very easy today.
nodes.text: Danes bom zagotovo vse počel zelo počasi.

nodes.source: I've driven a few places in my car, mainly for shopping, the first time I've been out properly now for almost 3 weeks. I'm now rubbing my tummy ready for dinner!!
nodes.text: Z avtom sem se odpeljal na nekaj krajev, predvsem po nakupih. Prvič sem bil zares zunaj po skoraj treh tednih. Zdaj se že trepljam po trebuhu v pričakovanju večerje!!

nodes.source: Eaten loads tonight, all healthy I might add! Not feeling too tired but will try to get my head down soon.
nodes.text: Nocoj sem veliko pojedel, vse zdravo, naj dodam! Nisem preveč utrujen, vendar bom poskusil kmalu zaspati.

nodes.source: Goodnight everybody!
nodes.text: Lahko noč vsem!

nodes.source: 31st December 2004 - Friday
nodes.text: 31. decembra 2004 - petek

nodes.source: Good morning. I didn't sleep much, probably went off about 03.00 and I've woken up at 08.30, not through want of trying but I just wasn't that tired for some reason. I'll try to get a little snooze during today, but I'm not too good at daytime napping. I haven't mentioned my night time sweats for a while, but they are still ongoing, every single night, they are a better experience in my own bed over the hospital beds as they are water proofed underneath.
nodes.text: Dobro jutro. Nisem veliko spal, verjetno sem zaspal okoli 3.00 in se zbudil ob 8.30. Ne da se ne bi trudil, ampak iz nekega razloga preprosto nisem bil tako utrujen. Danes bom poskusil malo zadremati, vendar mi dnevno dremanje ne gre najbolje. Nočnega potenja že nekaj časa nisem omenil, a se še vedno nadaljuje, prav vsako noč. V lastni postelji je prijetneje kot v bolnišnični, ki ima spodaj nepremočljivo zaščito.

nodes.source: It's not contagious, just not very attractive! Besides there isn't any girlfriend in my life at the moment so I'm not bothering anyone!! I'm hoping as I get better inside the sweats will subside; the doctor did explain that it was due to increased hormone levels due to the Cancer. Did I tell you all that if I took a pregnancy test at the moment it would show up positive? Weird; I'm so tempted to try!!
nodes.text: Ni nalezljivo, samo ni posebno privlačno! Pa tudi dekleta trenutno nimam, zato ne motim nikogar!! Upam, da se bo potenje umirilo, ko mi bo šlo v telesu bolje. Zdravnik je pojasnil, da je posledica povišanih ravni hormonov zaradi raka. Sem vam že povedal, da bi bil moj test nosečnosti trenutno pozitiven? Čudno; kar mika me, da bi poskusil!!

nodes.source: Well it's the last day of a horrible year and a bit for me (see thoughts section). I hope to put it all to rest tonight and look forward to a thriving and healthy future for us all, starting tomorrow!!
nodes.text: No, zame je zadnji dan grozljivega leta in še malo (glejte razdelek z razmišljanji). Upam, da bom nocoj vse pustil za sabo in se veselil uspešne in zdrave prihodnosti za vse nas, ki se začne jutri!!

nodes.source: I'm thinking of going out to celebrate the New Year tonight,
nodes.text: Razmišljam, da bi nocoj šel praznovat novo leto,

nodes.source: strictly
nodes.text: strogo

nodes.source: no alcohol but I don't see what harm one night out will do. I'm a little worried about my energy level and lungs breathing in a lot of smoke, it's why I popped in to a pub yesterday for a trial run. I just don't want to give my body too much extra work to do at the moment. Although so far I have been fine out, have plenty of energy and my breathing seems totally normal. As you can see, I am concerned about the idea, but think I will regret it if I don't go to my second home in Richmond (most of you know where I go, part of the furniture, it wouldn't be the same without me).
nodes.text: brez alkohola, a ne vidim, kakšno škodo bi naredil en večer zunaj. Malo me skrbijo raven energije in pljuča, ki bi vdihovala veliko dima; zato sem včeraj za poskus zavil v pub. Trenutno telesu preprosto nočem naložiti preveč dodatnega dela. Do zdaj sem bil zunaj sicer v redu, imel veliko energije in dihanje je povsem normalno. Kot vidite, me zamisel skrbi, a mislim, da mi bo žal, če ne grem v svoj drugi dom v Richmondu (večina vas ve, kam hodim, sem del inventarja in brez mene ne bi bilo enako).

nodes.source: Ate a big breakfast and a hearty lunch, now in need of a snooze.
nodes.text: Pojedel sem velik zajtrk in obilno kosilo, zdaj potrebujem dremež.

nodes.source: A few of my 'friends' have changed their minds with regard to the tentative plans they had made with me earlier this week and I was so looking forward to having a few buddies around me tonight to see the New Year in. Now I will make other plans for tonight, I might even just go to bed!
nodes.text: Nekaj mojih »prijateljev« si je premislilo glede okvirnih načrtov, ki so jih z mano naredili v začetku tedna. Tako zelo sem se veselil, da bom imel nocoj ob sebi nekaj prijateljev ob vstopu v novo leto. Zdaj bom naredil druge načrte, morda bom šel celo kar spat!

nodes.source: Cheers...
nodes.text: Na zdravje ...

nodes.source: Managed to get out and enjoy my New Year! Although not with my usual gang I had a good time (I was glad of the company) and was happy to act as cabby, I know from many years first hand experience what a nightmare it can be to get home on New Year's Eve. Obviously I stuck to the
nodes.text: Uspelo mi je iti ven in uživati v novem letu! Čeprav nisem bil s svojo običajno družbo, sem se imel lepo (vesel sem bil družbe) in z veseljem igral taksista. Iz dolgoletnih osebnih izkušenj vem, kakšna nočna mora je lahko priti domov na silvestrovo. Seveda sem se držal

nodes.source: strictly
nodes.text: strogo

nodes.source: no alcohol regime I have put myself on.
nodes.text: režima brez alkohola, ki sem si ga zadal.

nodes.source: Now I'm peckish, so will have a night cap (food) and retire for a nice long new year's sleep!!
nodes.text: Zdaj sem malo lačen, zato bom imel še nočni prigrizek (hrano) in se odpravil na lep dolg novoletni spanec!!

nodes.source: This is my personal experience, not medical advice.
nodes.text: To je moja osebna izkušnja, ne zdravstveni nasvet.
