nodes.text: Kontrolne preiskave in ozaveščanje

nodes.source: Personal diary
nodes.text: Osebni dnevnik

nodes.source: About 4 min read
nodes.text: Približno 4 min branja

nodes.source: 5th August 2005 - Friday
nodes.text: 5. avgusta 2005 - petek

nodes.source: Routine blood test and meeting with my Consultant today at Charing Cross Hospital.
nodes.text: Danes v bolnišnici Charing Cross rutinski krvni test in sestanek z mojim specialistom.

nodes.source: Everything looking good so far, my markers remain at normal and full blood count results now fall within the normal values although still at the bottom end of the spectrum.
nodes.text: Za zdaj je vse videti dobro. Moji označevalci ostajajo normalni in tudi rezultati celotne krvne slike zdaj sodijo med normalne vrednosti, čeprav so še vedno na spodnjem koncu razpona.

nodes.source: Physical examination carried out, all good.
nodes.text: Opravljen telesni pregled, vse v redu.

nodes.source: After the meeting I was sent for an additional blood test to check my testosterone levels, this is a new one for me. I told the Phlebotomist to be careful with the tube of blood he took as it may blow the testing machine up if they are not careful. I haven't noticed any of the low testosterone symptoms as yet, if anything I'm worse than before!
nodes.text: Po sestanku so me poslali na dodaten krvni test za preverjanje ravni testosterona, to je zame nekaj novega. Osebi, ki mi je vzela kri, sem rekel, naj bo z epruveto previdna, saj bi lahko razneslo aparat za analizo, če ne bodo pazili. Doslej nisem opazil nobenih simptomov nizkega testosterona, če že kaj, sem hujši kot prej!

nodes.source: Have you noticed I don't mention the endless needle worries anymore, I have mentally got used to them and the sites used for taking blood from me have become immune to needle pricks. Either that or I haven't had a bad experience recently!!
nodes.text: Ste opazili, da ne omenjam več neskončnih skrbi zaradi igel? V glavi sem se jih že navadil in mesta, kjer mi jemljejo kri, so postala imuna na vbode. Ali pa samo zadnje čase nisem imel slabe izkušnje!!

nodes.source: 9th August 2005 - Tuesday
nodes.text: 9. avgusta 2005 - torek

nodes.source: 8 months since initial diagnosis today. It passed without me thinking of it at all, I rarely think of the diagnosis anniversaries anymore.
nodes.text: Danes je 8 mesecev od prvotne diagnoze. Dan je minil, ne da bi sploh pomislil na to, saj o obletnicah diagnoze le še redko razmišljam.

nodes.source: Talking of anniversaries I'm going to make it to another birthday very soon, on the 22nd August 2005 I will be another year older. In the past -like many of you out there I'm sure- I didn't like to think of getting another year older, but now at each birthday I'll be grateful I've been given the opportunity to live another year! Let's face it, luckily I'm a survivor and hopefully many, many more birthdays will now pass me by!
nodes.text: Ko že govorim o obletnicah, zelo kmalu bom dočakal še en rojstni dan. 22. avgusta 2005 bom še eno leto starejši. Včasih - prepričan sem, da tako kot mnogi med vami - nisem rad razmišljal o tem, da bom še eno leto starejši, zdaj pa bom ob vsakem rojstnem dnevu hvaležen, da sem dobil priložnost živeti še eno leto! Priznajmo, na srečo sem preživel in upam, da bom zdaj dočakal še mnogo, mnogo rojstnih dni!

nodes.source: Strangely, on this day today, fell a talk on Testicular Cancer at an Army base not too far from where I live. Given by the inimitable checkemlads.com crew, Mick Riley and Phil Morris (new pictures in my gallery) to a large audience of first year recruits, a perfect target audience. I was introduced and applauded for all that I had been through, something I'm sure no soldier however 'hard' would like to confront.
nodes.text: Po nenavadnem naključju je bilo prav danes v vojašnici nedaleč od mojega doma predavanje o raku mod. Pred veliko skupino nabornikov prvega letnika, idealnim ciljnim občinstvom, sta ga vodila neponovljiva člana ekipe checkemlads.com Mick Riley in Phil Morris (nove fotografije v moji galeriji). Predstavili so me in zaploskali za vse, kar sem prestal, za nekaj, s čimer se, prepričan sem, ne bi rad spoprijel noben vojak, pa naj bo še tako 'trd'.

nodes.source: I've also committed myself to a tandem sky dive with an Army team, on the 2nd of September 2005 with Mick and hopefully Phil. Jumping out of a plane at 13,000 feet was not something I had in mind to do in my life, but now I jump at every opportunity given to me (pardon the pun).
nodes.text: Obljubil sem tudi, da bom 2. septembra 2005 z Mickom in upam tudi s Philom skočil s padalom v tandemu z vojaško ekipo. Skok iz letala na višini 13.000 čevljev ni bil nekaj, kar bi si v življenju nameraval privoščiti, zdaj pa zagrabim oziroma skočim v vsako ponujeno priložnost (oprostite besedni igri).

nodes.source: 12th August 2005 - Friday
nodes.text: 12. avgusta 2005 - petek

nodes.source: Blood test day today, popped in to my local hospital for it. Again the department was a ghost town, I caught the nurse in charge and was soon given my test.
nodes.text: Danes je dan krvnega testa, zato sem skočil v krajevno bolnišnico. Oddelek je bil spet kot mesto duhov. Ujel sem odgovorno sestro in kmalu so mi opravili test.

nodes.source: Each time I go along to these tests at another hospital I have a special letter and dispatch sticker to hand over. This makes sure that my blood tubes reach the right place.
nodes.text: Vsakič, ko grem na te teste v drugo bolnišnico, jim izročim posebno pismo in nalepko za pošiljanje. To zagotovi, da moje epruvete s krvjo pridejo na pravo mesto.

nodes.source: Only 10 days to go and I'll make it to being another year older!
nodes.text: Še samo 10 dni in bom dočakal še eno leto več!

nodes.source: 26th August 2005 - Friday
nodes.text: 26. avgusta 2005 - petek

nodes.source: Blood test day today, popped in to my local hospital for it. This time the department was full with people. I had to wait an hour before I was seen and tested, even then the nurse (a REED temp) did not know what to do with my paperwork, I had to explain how to take my blood, how much to take and what to do with the letter and sticker that I had brought for him.
nodes.text: Danes je dan krvnega testa, zato sem skočil v krajevno bolnišnico. Tokrat je bil oddelek poln ljudi. Preden sem prišel na vrsto in so mi vzeli kri, sem moral čakati eno uro, pa še takrat zdravstveni tehnik (začasni delavec agencije REED) ni vedel, kaj storiti z mojo dokumentacijo. Moral sem mu razložiti, kako naj mi vzame kri, koliko je potrebuje ter kaj naj naredi s pismom in nalepko, ki sem mu ju prinesel.

nodes.source: Quite easily the worst experience of a blood test I have had to date, short of dragging me around the room whilst holding a needle which was stuck in my arm, the test was very uncomfortable indeed and it took 2 attempts at getting anything out of me. I was glad to get out of there! Still suffering with a few of those lasting Chemotherapy symptoms, which could possibly go on for a long time to come.
nodes.text: Zlahka najslabša izkušnja z odvzemom krvi doslej. Manjkalo je samo še to, da bi me z iglo, zabodeno v roko, vlekel po sobi; odvzem je bil res zelo neprijeten in šele v 2 poskusih je uspel kaj spraviti iz mene. Vesel sem bil, ko sem odšel! Še vedno me pesti nekaj tistih dolgotrajnih simptomov zaradi kemoterapije, ki bi lahko trajali še dolgo.

nodes.source: Here's an update...
nodes.text: Tu so najnovejše informacije...

nodes.source: Tiredness
nodes.text: Utrujenost

nodes.source: (occasional)
nodes.text: (občasno)

nodes.source: Peripheral Neuropathy
nodes.text: Periferna nevropatija

nodes.source: (less apparent)
nodes.text: (manj opazno)

nodes.source: Tinnitus
nodes.text: Tinitus

nodes.source: (apparent at all times, got used to it)
nodes.text: (ves čas opazno, navadil sem se)

nodes.source: Tiger stripes on skin
nodes.text: Tigraste proge na koži

nodes.source: (still apparent, should fade with time)
nodes.text: (še vedno opazno, sčasoma bi moralo zbledeti)

nodes.source: Lung twinges/pains
nodes.text: Zbadanje/bolečine v pljučih

nodes.source: (occasional) I have noticed that on the day after having had a few too many alcoholic beverages, the above symptoms are far more apparent. Think I'll go steady on the juice for a while!
nodes.text: (občasno) Opazil sem, da so dan po tem, ko spijem nekaj alkoholnih pijač preveč, zgornji simptomi veliko izrazitejši. Mislim, da bom s pijačo nekaj časa bolj previden!

nodes.source: My birthday passed relatively quietly, I had many well wishers and a few cards/presents to boot. All in all and in my case especially I suppose I kind of hoped for a big surprise on the auspicious day, making it another year alive was most certainly the celebration. Perhaps I'll have to pull my finger out and organise my 'Ball'. Still, I'm running hard away from a 6-8 month hole in my finances, which is catching up with me and hurting bad.
nodes.text: Moj rojstni dan je minil razmeroma mirno. Dobil sem veliko dobrih želja in za povrh še nekaj voščilnic ter daril. Glede na vse in še posebej v mojem primeru sem na ta slovesni dan menda nekako upal na veliko presenečenje, zagotovo pa je bilo praznovanje že to, da sem dočakal še eno leto življenja. Morda se bom moral spraviti k stvari in organizirati svoj 'Ball'. Še vedno pa skušam na vso moč ubežati 6-8-mesečni luknji v financah, ki me dohiteva in zelo boli.

nodes.source: This is my personal experience, not medical advice.
nodes.text: To je moja osebna izkušnja, ne zdravstveni nasvet.
