nodes.source: I cooked a big dinner and stuffed myself full of goodness, yogurt and fruit for dessert. Watched the box for most of the evening, now off to bed. Night.
nodes.text: Skuhal sem veliko večerjo in se napolnil z dobrimi stvarmi, za sladico pa jogurt in sadje. Večino večera sem gledal televizijo, zdaj pa grem spat. Lahko noč.

nodes.source: 23rd January 2005 - Sunday
nodes.text: 23. januarja 2005 - nedelja

nodes.source: Woke up quite early for a Sunday. Got a bit of an upset stomach today, probably something I ate yesterday.
nodes.text: Zbudil sem se kar zgodaj za nedeljo. Danes me malo muči želodec, verjetno zaradi nečesa, kar sem včeraj pojedel.

nodes.source: I will make an effort and get out somewhere today, perhaps some shopping or just a drive over to my Mums house.
nodes.text: Danes se bom potrudil in nekam šel, morda po nakupih ali le na vožnjo do mamine hiše.

nodes.source: Scratch the shopping, amazingly I've spent all day asleep, only having just woken up at 17.00! Not sure why I've been so tired. I'm up now and am off to see my Mum.
nodes.text: Pozabite na nakupe, neverjetno, ves dan sem prespal in se zbudil šele ob 17.00! Ne vem, zakaj sem tako utrujen. Zdaj sem vstal in grem pogledat mamo.

nodes.source: Spent the evening with Mum and returned home for a late dinner. I hope it settles better in my stomach this time. Going to let it digest and then hit the sack.
nodes.text: Večer sem preživel z mamo in se vrnil domov na pozno večerjo. Upam, da jo bo želodec tokrat bolje sprejel. Pustil bom, da se prebavi, potem pa v posteljo.

nodes.source: 24th January 2005 - Monday
nodes.text: 24. januarja 2005 - ponedeljek

nodes.source: Woke up early again, must force myself to stay awake today for an early night tonight. It's hospital day tomorrow and I have to be there by 09.30 to get things started on time.
nodes.text: Spet sem se zgodaj zbudil, danes se moram prisiliti, da ostanem buden in grem nocoj zgodaj spat. Jutri je bolnišnični dan in tam moram biti do 9.30, da se vse začne pravočasno.

nodes.source: Stayed awake so far, it's been raining heavy outside, one of those really dark overcast downfalls, so a bit depressing. I'm going to venture out soon, once it brightens. Got to buy some more food and go wander around the local DIY shop for something to do.
nodes.text: Doslej sem ostal buden. Zunaj močno dežuje, eden tistih res temnih, oblačnih nalivov, zato je malo turobno. Kmalu se bom podal ven, ko se zjasni. Kupiti moram še hrano in se za kratkočasje sprehoditi po lokalni trgovini za domače mojstre.

nodes.source: This 'burnt' vein on my left hand still bothers me, I must get it looked at. Looking back through my diary it happened back on the 15th December 2004! I will try and get a picture up on here soon so you can see it.
nodes.text: Ta »opečena« žila na levi roki me še vedno moti, moram jo dati pregledati. Ko gledam nazaj po dnevniku, vidim, da se je to zgodilo že 15. decembra 2004! Kmalu bom poskusil objaviti fotografijo, da jo boste videli.

nodes.source: Had a simple but filling three course dinner tonight, still home alone. Getting anxious about my hospital visit tomorrow. Been in touch with Milton this evening and like me he's experiencing a wait for his treatment to begin, a simple course to a heavy schedule a lot like my last week in hospital.
nodes.text: Nocoj sem imel preprosto, a nasitno večerjo s tremi hodi, še vedno sam doma. Zaradi jutrišnjega obiska bolnišnice postajam zaskrbljen. Zvečer sem govoril z Miltonom in tudi on čaka na začetek zdravljenja, preprostega zdravljenja po napornem urniku, zelo podobno kot moj zadnji bolnišnični teden.

nodes.source: This is where I take a deep breath, close my eyes and hope tomorrow is over and done with quickly. Perhaps someone could arrange it such that I don't wake up tomorrow, receive my needed treatment and wake up on Wednesday morning instead, alas I think not.
nodes.text: Tu globoko vdihnem, zaprem oči in upam, da bo jutri hitro za mano. Morda bi kdo lahko uredil tako, da se jutri ne zbudim, dobim potrebno zdravljenje in se prebudim šele v sredo zjutraj. Žal mislim, da ne.

nodes.source: Night.
nodes.text: Lahko noč.

nodes.source: 25th January 2005 - Tuesday
nodes.text: 25. januarja 2005 - torek

nodes.source: Apologies for the lack of updates today. I had to rush out this morning to be at the hospital on time and I've had some trouble updating from the hospital today.
nodes.text: Oprostite, ker danes ni bilo novic. Zjutraj sem moral pohiteti, da sem bil pravočasno v bolnišnici, od tam pa sem imel danes nekaj težav s posodabljanjem.

nodes.source: Had a quick breakfast and was off to the hospital. Bloods taken as always before chemotherapy can be started. Once the results came back my neutrophil reading was quite low (0.8) and something that hasn't really been mentioned before, my platelet reading was low (52,000). So not only am I prone to infection, I'm also now low on the materials (associated with blood coagulation) needed to fight an infection. This is to be expected on chemotherapy but has to be monitored very carefully, even simple infections or a nosebleed could be a danger to me. A further blood test is booked for Thursday of this week.
nodes.text: Na hitro sem zajtrkoval in odšel v bolnišnico. Kot vedno so mi pred začetkom kemoterapije vzeli kri. Ko so prišli izvidi, je bila raven nevtrofilcev precej nizka (0,8), pa še nekaj, kar doslej ni bilo posebej omenjeno: malo je bilo tudi trombocitov (52.000). Torej nisem le dovzeten za okužbe, ampak imam zdaj tudi manj snovi, povezanih s strjevanjem krvi, potrebnih za boj proti okužbi. Med kemoterapijo je to pričakovano, vendar je treba zelo skrbno spremljati; še preprosta okužba ali krvavitev iz nosu bi bila lahko zame nevarna. Naslednji odvzem krvi je naročen za ta četrtek.

nodes.source: chemotherapy was initiated despite the low readings and the cannulation went well, my trusty Emla cream saw to that.
nodes.text: Kemoterapija se je kljub nizkim vrednostim začela in vstavljanje kanile je šlo dobro; moja zvesta krema Emla je poskrbela za to.

nodes.source: Had a brief visit from my registrar whom I discussed my ailments with, I've been given a prescription for a different mouthwash. He checked my burnt vein which I have been complaining about and assured me that although it will take time it will eventually repair itself.
nodes.text: Na kratko me je obiskal specializant, s katerim sem se pogovoril o težavah. Dobil sem recept za drugo ustno vodico. Pregledal je opečeno žilo, zaradi katere se pritožujem, in mi zagotovil, da bo sicer trajalo, vendar se bo sčasoma sama popravila.

nodes.source: Outpatients ward very busy today, a lot of comings and goings. I gave up my seat and moved out in to the reception area with my IV machine to continue treatment, this suited me as there are actually and unbelievably more electrical outlets here than in the outpatient ward!
nodes.text: Na ambulantnem oddelku je danes velika gneča, ljudje neprestano prihajajo in odhajajo. Prepustil sem svoj sedež in se z infuzijsko napravo preselil v sprejemni prostor, kjer sem nadaljeval zdravljenje. To mi je ustrezalo, saj je tukaj dejansko in neverjetno več električnih vtičnic kot na ambulantnem oddelku!

nodes.source: Shortly after moving my cannulation went wrong! It did something called 'tissue'ing', where the vein leaks the chemotherapy in to the local tissue for any number of reasons. Dangerous with certain chemotherapy drugs, but fortunately for me the Bleomycin isn't to bad an irritant and didn't seem to have much effect on surrounding tissue. 99 percent of the time this means relocating the cannulation, this time without my Emla to protect me, I had to go through the full experience.
nodes.text: Kmalu po selitvi je šlo nekaj narobe s kanilo! Zgodilo se je nekaj, čemur rečejo »prehajanje v tkivo«, ko kemoterapija iz različnih razlogov iz žile izteka v okoliško tkivo. Pri nekaterih zdravilih za kemoterapijo je to nevarno, a na mojo srečo bleomicin ni tako močno dražilen in očitno ni imel večjega učinka na okoliško tkivo. V 99 odstotkih primerov to pomeni novo mesto za kanilo, tokrat brez moje Emle za zaščito. Prestati sem moral vso izkušnjo.

nodes.source: Nearly finished now, feeling quite tired and looking forward to getting home.
nodes.text: Zdaj skoraj konec, precej sem utrujen in veselim se odhoda domov.

nodes.source: Paid a visit to some fellow patients before I left the hospital (i felt like a doctor on his rounds). This tired me even more and Ken promptly drove me home.
nodes.text: Pred odhodom iz bolnišnice sem obiskal nekaj sobolnikov (počutil sem se kot zdravnik na viziti). To me je še bolj utrudilo in Ken me je takoj odpeljal domov.

nodes.source: By this time I was starting to feel the effects of my Bleomycin chemotherapy, exhausted and shivering.
nodes.text: Takrat sem začenjal čutiti učinke kemoterapije z bleomicinom, bil sem izčrpan in me je treslo.

nodes.source: Had a very light dinner of soup and bread, watched the box for a bit and then had a long hot bath. Straight to bed and I was asleep within minutes.
nodes.text: Imel sem zelo lahko večerjo, juho in kruh, nekaj časa gledal televizijo, nato pa dolgo vročo kopel. Naravnost v posteljo in v nekaj minutah sem spal.

nodes.source: 26th January 2005 - Wednesday
nodes.text: 26. januarja 2005 - sreda

nodes.source: Woke up at 09.00 this morning. Feeling rotten, got a headache and feeling drowsy. I've slept a bit more this morning hence the late diary entry. Cant manage much more than this at the moment, I'll get back to you all with a better update later...
nodes.text: Danes zjutraj sem se zbudil ob 9.00. Počutim se zanič, boli me glava in sem omotičen. Dopoldne sem še malo spal, zato pozen dnevniški zapis. Trenutno ne zmorem kaj dosti več, pozneje se oglasim z boljšimi novicami ...

nodes.source: Feeling much better now, I really wasn't up to much this morning and well in to the afternoon. Now I'm up, showered and dressed. I've had some breakfast and feel alive again! I'm not going to over do it, will eat well and may pop out this evening.
nodes.text: Zdaj se počutim veliko bolje. Dopoldne in še precej popoldne res nisem bil za kaj. Zdaj sem vstal, oprhan in oblečen. Nekaj sem zajtrkoval in se spet počutim živega! Ne bom pretiraval, dobro bom jedel in morda šel zvečer malo ven.

nodes.source: I mentioned yesterday that I was prescribed another stronger mouthwash for my Oral Thrush, well I was so out of it I hadn't realised this prescription was actually tablets. I still have the usual Corsodyl mouthwash which I am using regularly. I also now have a course of Fluconazole tablets to take, which I will start this evening.
nodes.text: Včeraj sem omenil, da so mi za ustno kandidozo predpisali drugo, močnejšo ustno vodico. No, bil sem tako odsoten, da nisem opazil, da so na receptu pravzaprav tablete. Še vedno imam običajni Corsodyl, ki ga redno uporabljam. Zdaj imam tudi tablete flukonazola za celoten cikel, ki ga bom začel nocoj.

nodes.source: I think I will rattle soon with the amount of medication I am taking, most of this is to overcome side effects of chemotherapy! Here's a quick recap...
nodes.text: Mislim, da bom zaradi količine zdravil kmalu rožljal. Večina je namenjena premagovanju stranskih učinkov kemoterapije! Tu je kratek pregled ...

nodes.source: Domperidome 2 tablets 3 times a day for the foreseen future, for anti-sickness.
nodes.text: Domperidon, dve tableti trikrat na dan do nadaljnjega, proti slabosti.

nodes.source: Granisetron given by IV before chemotherapy and taken in tablet form each day of chemotherapy and for 2 days after, for anti-sickness.
nodes.text: Granisetron, intravensko pred kemoterapijo in nato v tabletah vsak dan kemoterapije ter še dva dni po njej, proti slabosti.

nodes.source: Fluconazole 1 tablet daily for 5 days, for Oral Thrush.
nodes.text: Flukonazol, ena tableta dnevno pet dni, za ustno kandidozo.

nodes.source: Corsodyl mouthwash twice daily, for Oral Thrush.
nodes.text: Ustna vodica Corsodyl dvakrat dnevno, za ustno kandidozo.

nodes.source: Preparation H for piles which have been caused by constipation, a side effect of the anti sickness drugs!
nodes.text: Preparation H za hemoroide, ki jih je povzročilo zaprtje, stranski učinek zdravil proti slabosti!

nodes.source: Paracetamol when required, for pain, headaches etc
nodes.text: Paracetamol po potrebi, za bolečine, glavobole in podobno.

nodes.source: A very nice dinner and I popped out to meet up with the other members of my Masonic Lodge. They were surprised to see me, I'll be seeing most of them again this Saturday at a supper meeting.
nodes.text: Zelo lepa večerja, nato pa sem šel na srečanje z drugimi člani svoje prostozidarske lože. Presenečeni so bili, da me vidijo. Večino bom spet srečal to soboto na večernem srečanju.

nodes.source: A new symptom tonight, pain in my groin on the right side. I wonder if this is associated with my Testicular Cancer, being in a similar area I wouldn't be surprised if it is. Hopefully I'll bump in to the Doctor tomorrow to bring this up.
nodes.text: Nocoj nov simptom, bolečina v desnih dimljah. Sprašujem se, ali je povezana z rakom mod. Ker je na podobnem mestu, me to ne bi presenetilo. Upam, da bom jutri srečal zdravnika in to omenil.

nodes.source: Feeling OK but tired now, so off to bed for a full and recuperative nights sleep.
nodes.text: Počutim se v redu, vendar sem zdaj utrujen, zato grem v posteljo na dolg in obnovitven spanec.

nodes.source: 27th January 2005 - Thursday
nodes.text: 27. januarja 2005 - četrtek

nodes.source: Awake and feeling OK today, going to wait for my Dad to arrive, then I'll set off for my surveillance blood test at Charing Cross.
nodes.text: Buden in danes se počutim v redu. Počakal bom, da pride oče, potem pa se odpravil na kontrolni odvzem krvi v Charing Cross.

nodes.source: Relaxed for a bit then Ken drove me to Charing Cross for my blood test. Test went fine and had to wait a while for my results to come back.
nodes.text: Nekaj časa sem se sproščal, nato me je Ken odpeljal v Charing Cross na odvzem krvi. Preiskava je šla dobro in moral sem malo počakati, da so prišli izvidi.

nodes.source: Platelet reading at 68,000 now, which is very slightly better but still not quite enough! Neutrophil reading at 0.8 which is still low and the same as it was on Tuesday morning.
nodes.text: Trombociti so zdaj pri 68.000, kar je malo bolje, a še vedno ne dovolj! Nevtrofilci so 0,8, kar je še vedno nizko in enako kot v torek zjutraj.

nodes.source: Cleared to have two G-CSF injections, one tonight and one tomorrow.
nodes.text: Dovolili so mi dve injekciji G-CSF, eno nocoj in eno jutri.

nodes.source: I've also finally managed to get a new HCG reading, which will mean the chart will be updated soon. It's now at a measly 10, very good indeed, however the battle isn't over yet!
nodes.text: Končno mi je uspelo dobiti tudi novo vrednost HCG, kar pomeni, da bo graf kmalu posodobljen. Zdaj je pri pičlih 10, res zelo dobro, a bitka še ni končana!

nodes.source: Collected the G-CSF injections from the hospital pharmacy and left for home, popped in via Mum's house to drop off some things.
nodes.text: V bolnišnični lekarni sem prevzel injekcije G-CSF in odšel proti domu. Spotoma sem pri mami odložil nekaj stvari.

nodes.source: Now I'm home, starving hungry and ready for a big dinner.
nodes.text: Zdaj sem doma, sestradan in pripravljen na veliko večerjo.

nodes.source: Dinner and a stack of prunes with ice cream for afters. Gave myself a bit of digestion time whilst watching the box and headed for a hot bath and bed.
nodes.text: Večerja in kup suhih sliv s sladoledom za posladek. Med gledanjem televizije sem si dal nekaj časa za prebavo, nato pa na vročo kopel in v posteljo.

nodes.source: 28th January 2005 - Friday
nodes.text: 28. januarja 2005 - petek

nodes.source: Slept for a good 10 hours, feeling good today. No plans, just relaxing.
nodes.text: Spal sem dobrih deset ur in danes se dobro počutim. Nobenih načrtov, samo sproščanje.

nodes.source: New pictures in the image gallery for you to look at and the HCG results chart has been updated.
nodes.text: V galeriji so nove fotografije za ogled in graf izvidov HCG je posodobljen.

nodes.source: Big decision made today, I've decided to book flights to Leeds and go to a show in Manchester during my treatment. I have spoken with my Consultant about this and he didn't see any problem in doing it providing it didn't get in the way of my treatment schedule, which if all goes to plan I will be free that weekend.
nodes.text: Danes sem sprejel veliko odločitev. Rezerviral bom let v Leeds in šel med zdravljenjem na predstavo v Manchester. O tem sem govoril s specialistom in ni videl težave, če le ne bo motilo urnika zdravljenja. Če bo vse po načrtih, bom tisti konec tedna prost.

nodes.source: I'm going to fly up and visit some friends in Leeds, stay with them at their house and they will look after me and accompany me to the show; Cirque Du Soleil's - Saltimbanco.
nodes.text: Odletel bom obiskat prijatelje v Leeds, bival pri njih doma, oni pa bodo skrbeli zame in me spremljali na predstavo Saltimbanco skupine Cirque du Soleil.

nodes.source: I spoke to British Midland and they will refund the full cost of my ticket if I have an official Doctors letter regarding my treatment so it wasn't too big a financial gamble and gives me something to really look forward to in the coming month.
nodes.text: Govoril sem z British Midlandom, kjer mi bodo v celoti povrnili ceno vozovnice, če priložim uradno zdravniško potrdilo o zdravljenju. Zato to ni bila prevelika finančna igra na srečo, hkrati pa imam v prihajajočem mesecu nekaj, česar se lahko res veselim.

nodes.source: I am a big Cirque Du Soleil fan and what better show to attend than Saltimbanco, a celebration of life!
nodes.text: Velik oboževalec skupine Cirque du Soleil sem in katera predstava bi bila primernejša od Saltimbanca, praznovanja življenja!

nodes.source: Now I'm quite excited about going to see my friends whom I haven't seen for ages and the show. It could also be a good opportunity for some of my family that live that way, a chance to visit me whilst I'm there for the weekend. If all goes to plan I will arrive the evening of Thursday 10th Feb, see the show on the night of Saturday 12th Feb and return to Heathrow the evening of the 13th Feb.
nodes.text: Zdaj sem kar navdušen, da bom videl prijatelje, ki jih že celo večnost nisem, in predstavo. To bi bila lahko tudi dobra priložnost za del družine, ki živi tam, da me obišče med mojim koncem tedna. Če bo vse po načrtu, bom prispel v četrtek zvečer, 10. februarja, predstavo si ogledal v soboto zvečer, 12. februarja, in se 13. februarja zvečer vrnil na Heathrow.

nodes.source: I have really been chilling out today, I can honestly say I haven't done anything at all apart from drink and eat of course! I must try and motivate a little this evening.
nodes.text: Danes sem se res sproščal. Iskreno lahko rečem, da nisem počel prav ničesar razen seveda pil in jedel! Nocoj moram poskusiti najti malo motivacije.

nodes.source: Ate some dinner but didn't really feel to good this evening, a mild stomach ache and tiredness. Watched the box until quite late and retired for the night. I didn't even bother to get dressed today!
nodes.text: Nekaj sem večerjal, vendar se nocoj nisem najbolje počutil. Malo me boli trebuh in sem utrujen. Do precej pozno sem gledal televizijo in šel spat. Danes se mi ni dalo niti obleči!

nodes.source: 29th January 2005 - Saturday
nodes.text: 29. januarja 2005 - sobota

nodes.source: Woke up feeling quite good this morning, well much better than last night.
nodes.text: Zjutraj sem se zbudil precej dobro, no, precej bolje kot sinoči.

nodes.source: I've had a bath and a shower, now for a big breakfast.
nodes.text: Okopal in oprhal sem se, zdaj pa velik zajtrk.

nodes.source: I have a busy day ahead. After today, only one more day of freedom left, then I become just a patient number, not a free man!
nodes.text: Pred mano je naporen dan. Po današnjem ostaja le še en dan svobode, nato postanem le številka bolnika, ne svoboden človek!

nodes.source: Relaxed for the afternoon, tiredness still catching up with me. Went out to pick up my suit, got changed and went to my Masonic Lodge supper meeting. Made it home quite early, got changed again and relaxed in front of the TV.
nodes.text: Popoldne sem se sproščal, utrujenost me še vedno dohiteva. Šel sem po obleko, se preoblekel in odšel na večerno srečanje svoje prostozidarske lože. Domov sem prišel precej zgodaj, se spet preoblekel in se sproščal pred televizijo.

nodes.source: Ahhhh, I sat up really late again tonight and promised myself I would try to get to bed early. Goodnight.
nodes.text: Ah, nocoj sem bil spet res dolgo pokonci, pa sem si obljubil, da bom poskusil zgodaj v posteljo. Lahko noč.

nodes.source: 30th January 2005 - Sunday
nodes.text: 30. januarja 2005 - nedelja

nodes.source: Slept well despite getting to bed quite late indeed.
nodes.text: Dobro sem spal, čeprav sem šel res precej pozno v posteljo.

nodes.source: Had breakfast at a reasonable time and trying my best to get in shape for next weeks chemo battering.
nodes.text: Zajtrkoval sem ob primerni uri in se po najboljših močeh trudim pripraviti na kemoterapevtsko pretepanje prihodnji teden.

nodes.source: Off to my Mums for a bit and then to a friends house for dinner. Only saw my Mum briefly today, although I would have liked to spend more time, I couldn't bare to see her lying in bed, stiff with Parkinson's and depressed with nothing much to look forward to. At the start of all this, I asked my Brother kindly to spend a little more time with her as he only lives 10 minutes away. His visits have really been only for necessity and few and far between. I asked her if she knew when he would be next visiting and she had no idea. Another stress I could do without, especially when I'm back in to hospital tomorrow for the week.
nodes.text: Za malo k mami, nato pa k prijateljem na večerjo. Danes sem mamo videl le na kratko. Čeprav bi rad preživel več časa z njo, nisem mogel prenašati pogleda nanjo v postelji, togo zaradi Parkinsonove bolezni in potrto, brez veliko stvari, ki bi se jih veselila. Na začetku vsega tega sem brata prijazno prosil, naj z njo preživi malo več časa, saj živi le deset minut stran. Njegovi obiski so bili res le iz nuje, redki in daleč narazen. Vprašal sem jo, ali ve, kdaj bo naslednjič prišel, in ni imela pojma. Še en stres, brez katerega bi mi bilo lažje, še posebno ker se jutri za teden dni vračam v bolnišnico.

nodes.source: Had a really nice meal and a chat at my friends house and headed off home to get ready for tomorrow.
nodes.text: Pri prijateljih sem imel res lepo večerjo in pogovor, nato pa sem odšel domov, da se pripravim na jutri.

nodes.source: Developed a bit of a headache this evening, going to get that much needed sleep now. Night.
nodes.text: Nocoj me je začela malo boleti glava, zdaj grem po nujno potreben spanec. Lahko noč.

nodes.source: 31st January 2005 - Monday
nodes.text: 31. januarja 2005 - ponedeljek

nodes.source: Another month almost over! Slept well.
nodes.text: Še en mesec je skoraj mimo! Dobro sem spal.

nodes.source: Getting all my stuff together for my week in hospital, I doubt very much they will be ready for me in any way whatsoever. Once I arrive I should have a blood test, X-ray and then start my chemotherapy.
nodes.text: Zbiram vse stvari za bolnišnični teden. Zelo dvomim, da bodo kakorkoli pripravljeni name. Ko prispem, naj bi mi vzeli kri, naredili rentgen in nato začeli kemoterapijo.

nodes.source: Arrived at the Hospital, bed allocated immediately (6th Floor, West, F4) and bloods taken. Hopefully going for an X-ray soon, then getting ready for first round of chemotherapy (15 hours).
nodes.text: Prispel sem v bolnišnico, takoj so mi dodelili posteljo (šesto nadstropje, West, F4) in vzeli kri. Upam, da bom kmalu šel na rentgen, nato pa priprave na prvi krog kemoterapije (15 ur).

nodes.source: Had my X-ray, I got a look but will not comment until the Consultant has seen it. Now the long wait for chemotherapy drugs to arrive, everyone on my ward is waiting for their chemotherapy to start, it'll be a mad dash when they bring it.
nodes.text: Rentgen je opravljen, pogledal sem posnetek, a ga ne bom komentiral, dokler ga ne vidi specialist. Zdaj dolgo čakanje na prihod zdravil za kemoterapijo. Vsi na oddelku čakajo začetek kemoterapije, ko jo bodo prinesli, bo prava norija.

nodes.source: chemotherapy started at 19.20 so all being well it will finish at around 12.00 tomorrow, allowing for bag changes and nursing/staff levels. Cannulation experience was fine (thanks Emla cream and nurse Auxilia) although I'm running out of veins for them to feed me, this time its located around the back of my left forearm.
nodes.text: Kemoterapija se je začela ob 19.20. Če bo vse v redu, se bo končala jutri okoli 12.00, ob upoštevanju menjav vrečk in števila sester oziroma osebja. Vstavljanje kanile je bilo v redu (hvala kremi Emla in sestri Auxilii), čeprav mi zmanjkuje žil za dovajanje zdravil. Tokrat je kanila zadaj na levi podlakti.

nodes.source: Consultant has been round to see me and has passed comments on my X-ray. I am now half way through my overall treatment schedule and embarking on the second half this week. My recent X-ray is better but still showing some small evidence of Cancerous lesions, hopefully with the second half of my treatment they will clear and with the figures heading the way they have been there is no reason why they shouldn't (along with a lot of positive thinking on my behalf and all your good wishes I'll beat this Cancer in to non existence).
nodes.text: Specialist me je obiskal in komentiral rentgenski posnetek. Zdaj sem na polovici celotnega urnika zdravljenja in ta teden začenjam drugo polovico. Zadnji rentgenski posnetek je boljši, vendar še vedno kaže nekaj majhnih rakavih lezij. Upam, da bodo z drugo polovico zdravljenja izginile. Glede na smer, v katero gredo številke, ni razloga, da ne bi (z veliko pozitivnega razmišljanja z moje strani in vsemi vašimi dobrimi željami bom tega raka premagal do neobstoja).

nodes.source: IF
nodes.text: ČE

nodes.source: it doesn't clear from my lungs, there is a chance that I may have to be operated on, not only on my testicle but possibly my abdomen and my lungs!! A daunting thought indeed.
nodes.text: ne izgine iz pljuč, obstaja možnost, da me bodo morali operirati, ne le na modu, temveč morda tudi v trebuhu in pljučih!! Res zastrašujoča misel.

nodes.source: The testicle operation is expected and for definite, the others based on my recovery. So I'll keep positive and hope that I have enough of you out there keeping everything crossed for me!
nodes.text: Operacija moda je pričakovana in gotova, druge so odvisne od okrevanja. Zato bom ostal pozitiven in upal, da vas je dovolj, ki zame držite vse pesti!

nodes.source: Feeling fine tonight, had a few unexpected visitors which was very nice indeed. I'll say goodnight for tonight and be thinking of you all tucked up asleep whilst I am being pumped full of chemo through the night.
nodes.text: Nocoj se dobro počutim, prišlo je nekaj nepričakovanih obiskovalcev, kar je bilo res lepo. Za nocoj vam bom zaželel lahko noč in mislil na vas, udobno zavite v spanec, medtem ko bodo mene vso noč polnili s kemoterapijo.

nodes.source: As I said this morning, the month is now over, time to embark on another, my time of recovery and freedom from this disease draws closer and closer all the time.
nodes.text: Kot sem rekel zjutraj, je mesec zdaj mimo in čas je za naslednjega. Čas mojega okrevanja in svobode od te bolezni se ves čas bolj bliža.

nodes.source: This is my personal experience, not medical advice.
nodes.text: To je moja osebna izkušnja, ne zdravstveni nasvet.

nodes.source: Check-ups and getting on with life
nodes.text: Kontrolni pregledi in nadaljevanje življenja

nodes.source: Personal diary
nodes.text: Osebni dnevnik

nodes.source: About 5 min read
nodes.text: Približno 5 min branja

nodes.source: Arrived at the hospital very much on time this morning, the traffic was a breeze.
nodes.text: Danes zjutraj sem v bolnišnico prispel povsem pravočasno, promet je tekel brez težav.

nodes.source: As instructed by phone earlier in the week I went straight to Clinic 8 for my X-Ray form and then to the MRI reception to register my attendance in good time for the MRI scan.
nodes.text: Kot so mi v začetku tedna naročili po telefonu, sem šel naravnost v ambulanto 8 po napotnico za rentgen, nato pa na sprejem za magnetno resonanco, da sem svoj prihod prijavil dovolj zgodaj pred preiskavo.

nodes.source: After registering at the MRI reception I went for my X-Ray. A very jolly bunch of nurses were operating the X-Ray machine today, I had a bit of a laugh and showed them my website. Although a serious condition I am monitoring with all of these X-Rays and tests, it's nice to have a bit of a laugh, normally at my expense... just to keep the spirits high, which is just as they should be!
nodes.text: Po prijavi na sprejemu za magnetno resonanco sem šel na rentgen. Danes je rentgenski aparat upravljala zelo vesela skupina sester. Malo smo se nasmejali in pokazal sem jim svoje spletno mesto. Čeprav z vsemi temi slikanji in testi spremljam resno bolezen, se je lepo malo nasmejati, navadno na svoj račun... da ohranjamo dobro voljo, kakršna tudi mora biti!

nodes.source: Straight after the X-Ray I went through for my MRI scan. My second MRI ever and I had the pleasure of putting a new scanner through its paces. I took a photo of the scanner (check the gallery soon), apparently it's worth 750,000 pounds sterling! I could certainly think of a few things to buy with that amount of money! However in this instance I think it's probably money well spent!
nodes.text: Takoj po rentgenu sem šel na magnetno resonanco. To je bila moja druga magnetna resonanca sploh in imel sem veselje preizkusiti nov aparat. Fotografiral sem ga (kmalu poglejte v galerijo), menda je vreden 750.000 britanskih funtov! Za toliko denarja bi si vsekakor znal zamisliti nekaj nakupov! Vendar mislim, da je v tem primeru denar verjetno dobro porabljen!

nodes.source: The X-Ray was to check up on my lungs and the MRI was a followup from my report to the Doctor that my hips/legs were giving off a creaking sensation which comes and goes at no particular time.
nodes.text: Rentgen je bil namenjen pregledu mojih pljuč, magnetna resonanca pa je sledila temu, ko sem zdravniku povedal, da v kolkih in nogah čutim škripanje, ki se pojavlja in izginja brez posebnega reda.

nodes.source: After my thorough zapping this morning it was off to Clinic 8 for my regular blood tests. This was quite quick and relatively painless (I am really getting used to these).
nodes.text: Po temeljitem jutranjem obsevanju sem se odpravil v ambulanto 8 na redne krvne teste. To je šlo kar hitro in razmeroma neboleče (res se jih že privajam).

nodes.source: Following a short wait I was seen by my Consultant, Dr. Savage. He had by that time had a chance to go over the scans from earlier today and was pleased to announce that they were all in order. Whatever they had suspected might be up with me as a serious Chemotherapy side effect was not the case and everything looked normal. I'll just have to put up with the creaking sensation and hope that it goes away sooner rather than later. Just as with the other side effects I have accepted and am dealing with on a daily basis.
nodes.text: Po kratkem čakanju me je sprejel moj specialist dr. Savage. Do takrat je že imel priložnost pregledati današnje posnetke in je z veseljem povedal, da so vsi v redu. Kar koli so že sumili, da bi lahko bil resen stranski učinek kemoterapije, se ni potrdilo in vse je bilo videti normalno. Pač bom moral živeti z občutkom škripanja in upati, da čim prej izgine. Tako kot z drugimi stranskimi učinki, ki sem jih sprejel in se z njimi spopadam vsak dan.

nodes.source: The X-Ray was also as clear as expected, there is damage to my lungs which is more apparent on a CT scan, however nothing nasty shows and in time they will hopefully get a lot better. I cannot really say that I notice any difference but then I haven't put any great amount of pressure on them yet. Just a couple of mountain bike rides out along the river which I seem to cope with very well, perhaps even better than before... but back then I suppose I was riding with developing tumours in my lungs that I didn't even realise I had!
nodes.text: Tudi rentgenska slika je bila čista, kot je bilo pričakovano. Moja pljuča so poškodovana, kar je bolj očitno na CT-posnetku, vendar ni videti ničesar nevarnega in upam, da se bodo sčasoma še precej izboljšala. Ne morem ravno reči, da opažam kakšno razliko, vendar jih še nisem posebej obremenil. Samo nekaj voženj z gorskim kolesom ob reki, ki jih očitno zelo dobro prenesem, morda celo bolje kot prej... ampak takrat sem verjetno kolesaril s tumorji, ki so rasli v pljučih, pa sploh nisem vedel, da jih imam!

nodes.source: I then paid a quick visit to the various wards that I have been treated in over the past months. It's nice to see the people who have treated me and give them a healthy smile, it makes them happy to know that 'the person' or 'the number' they treated is well again as quite often the case is that they hardly ever get to see patients again whatever the outcome. It also gives me good vibes to see them so happy that I am better and looking so much more healthy again.
nodes.text: Nato sem na kratko obiskal različne oddelke, kjer so me zdravili v zadnjih mesecih. Lepo je videti ljudi, ki so me zdravili, in jim nameniti zdrav nasmeh. Veseli so, ko vedo, da je 'oseba' ali 'številka', ki so jo zdravili, spet zdrava, saj se pogosto zgodi, da bolnikov skoraj nikoli več ne vidijo, ne glede na izid. Tudi sam se dobro počutim, ko vidim, kako veseli so, da sem bolje in da sem spet videti toliko bolj zdrav.

nodes.source: All in all quite a busy day at the hospital today. A small error in my blood test schedules has been rectified and I am now on a fortnightly regime as you will see from my updated schedule. Soon it will switch to monthly.
nodes.text: Skratka, danes kar pester dan v bolnišnici. Manjšo napako v razporedu mojih krvnih testov so odpravili in zdaj jih imam na dva tedna, kot boste videli v posodobljenem urniku. Kmalu bodo postali mesečni.

nodes.source: Unless anything exciting happens, I'll be back again on the 12th to report on my findings with the surgeon's team.
nodes.text: Če se ne zgodi kaj razburljivega, se spet vrnem 12., da poročam, kaj bom izvedel pri kirurgovi ekipi.

nodes.source: In the meantime I'll be making some changes and updates to the site so watch this space.
nodes.text: Medtem bom na spletnem mestu naredil nekaj sprememb in posodobitev, zato spremljajte to stran.

nodes.source: 12th July 2005 - Tuesday
nodes.text: 12. julija 2005 - torek

nodes.source: I came in to the hospital today for a pre arranged meeting with one of the Surgeon's team. Something that I had arranged for once, to clear up some outstanding queries.
nodes.text: Danes sem prišel v bolnišnico na vnaprej dogovorjen sestanek z enim od članov kirurgove ekipe. Za spremembo sem ga uredil sam, da bi razjasnil nekaj še odprtih vprašanj.

nodes.source: The scars are healing well although it'll be sometime indeed before they fade from the red lines that currently show. I have some numbness around and below my groin scar site (the Orchiectomy scar), this is totally normal and to be expected.
nodes.text: Brazgotine se lepo celijo, čeprav bo trajalo še kar nekaj časa, preden zdaj vidne rdeče črte zbledijo. Okoli in pod brazgotino v dimljah (brazgotino po orhiektomiji) imam nekoliko omrtvičen predel, kar je povsem normalno in pričakovano.

nodes.source: The clips... well this is something that I feel has still not been put to bed properly. For one thing I was told I cannot physically have one (just so I can show you all and for a reference as to what I have inside me). The other and more important factor is that there are no notes on exactly how many of these clips were used or their locations within my body.
nodes.text: Sponke... no, glede tega imam občutek, da zadeva še vedno ni ustrezno zaključena. Najprej so mi povedali, da mi ene ne morejo dati (samo zato, da bi jo lahko pokazal vsem vam in za predstavo o tem, kaj imam v sebi). Druga in pomembnejša stvar pa je, da ni zapiskov o tem, koliko natanko teh sponk so uporabili in kje v mojem telesu so.

nodes.source: In fact and according to the doctor I saw today, there are no notes on my surgery or the procedure whatsoever, I find this odd.
nodes.text: Pravzaprav po besedah zdravnika, s katerim sem govoril danes, sploh ni nobenih zapiskov o moji operaciji ali posegu, kar se mi zdi čudno.

nodes.source: I did manage to find out that the clips are made of a type of plastic called Silastic with titanium hinges, but even then the doctor was vague about this.
nodes.text: Uspelo mi je izvedeti, da so sponke izdelane iz vrste plastike, imenovane Silastic, s titanovimi tečaji, a tudi glede tega je bil zdravnik precej nedoločen.

nodes.source: 15th July 2005 - Friday
nodes.text: 15. julija 2005 - petek

nodes.source: My first blood test in another hospital.
nodes.text: Moj prvi krvni test v drugi bolnišnici.

nodes.source: I had a meeting today at the Mulberry Centre so I thought it best to get my routine blood test carried out at West Middlesex Hospital as it is right next door and very local to where I live!
nodes.text: Danes sem imel sestanek v centru Mulberry, zato se mi je zdelo najbolje rutinski krvni test opraviti v bolnišnici West Middlesex, saj je tik zraven in zelo blizu mojega doma!

nodes.source: An all new environment to me so I asked at main reception where the outpatients blood test department was. I was swiftly and accurately directed.
nodes.text: Zame povsem novo okolje, zato sem na glavnem sprejemu vprašal, kje je oddelek za ambulantni odvzem krvi. Hitro in natančno so mi pokazali pot.

nodes.source: Most of West Middlesex Hospital is now relatively new buildings and the blood test department appeared clean and new. The nurses were chatty, they were so quiet I had to knock on the door and butt in on their gossip in order to get my blood test done.
nodes.text: Večina bolnišnice West Middlesex je zdaj v razmeroma novih stavbah in oddelek za odvzem krvi je bil videti čist in nov. Sestre so bile zgovorne. Bilo je tako malo dela, da sem moral potrkati na vrata in prekiniti njihov klepet, da so mi vzeli kri.

nodes.source: All in all a nice experience in what was a foreign environment for me. I'll be coming back for more blood tests here in the future!
nodes.text: Skratka, prijetna izkušnja v okolju, ki mi je bilo tuje. V prihodnje bom še prihajal sem na krvne teste!

nodes.source: This is my personal experience, not medical advice.
nodes.text: To je moja osebna izkušnja, ne zdravstveni nasvet.

nodes.source: June 2005
nodes.text: junij 2005

nodes.source: A milestone and a new chapter
nodes.text: Mejnik in novo poglavje

nodes.source: Personal diary
nodes.text: Osebni dnevnik

nodes.source: About 8 min read
nodes.text: Približno 8 min branja

nodes.source: 2nd June 2005 - Thursday
nodes.text: 2. junija 2005 - četrtek

nodes.source: I had been given the news by phone yesterday but essentially today was the final hurdle as far as my Cancer was concerned. Very nearly 6 months to the day from my diagnosis, which was on the 9th December 2004. This Cancer had been inside my body and spreading for quite sometime before that, there is no knowing exactly for how long either. With my symptoms and lead up in mind, possibly up to almost 2 years before I was diagnosed!!
nodes.text: Novico so mi včeraj povedali po telefonu, a v bistvu je bil današnji dan zadnja ovira, kar zadeva mojega raka. Skoraj natanko 6 mesecev od diagnoze, ki sem jo dobil 9. decembra 2004. Rak je bil v mojem telesu in se širil že kar nekaj časa pred tem, nihče pa ne more vedeti natanko, kako dolgo. Glede na simptome in dogajanje pred diagnozo morda celo skoraj 2 leti, preden so mi postavili diagnozo!!

nodes.source: I set off for the Hospital a little behind time today and even though it's a school holiday this week the traffic was horrendous. It seems that everyone visiting Clinic 8 today had suffered the same traffic fate as me, the place was empty.
nodes.text: Danes sem se v bolnišnico odpravil malo pozno in čeprav so ta teden šolske počitnice, je bil promet grozen. Očitno je vse, ki so danes prihajali v ambulanto 8, doletela ista prometna usoda kot mene, saj je bilo tam prazno.

nodes.source: Luckily I was seen to very swiftly and my bloods (Full Blood Count, U&E's & Tumour Markers) were taken almost immediately as I walked through the door.
nodes.text: Na srečo sem na vrsto prišel zelo hitro in kri (za celotno krvno sliko, U&E in tumorske označevalce) so mi vzeli skoraj takoj, ko sem stopil skozi vrata.

nodes.source: It wasn't long before I was seen to by my Consultant Dr. Savage.
nodes.text: Ni trajalo dolgo, preden me je sprejel moj specialist dr. Savage.

nodes.source: We went over my recent CT Scans and compared them to the previous ones taken almost 2 months earlier. A marked improvement was obvious and my lungs appear to be clearing up, although it's a slow process, it's exactly the progress that I could have hoped and wished for...
nodes.text: Pregledala sva moje nedavne CT-posnetke in jih primerjala s prejšnjimi, posnetimi skoraj 2 meseca prej. Očitno je bilo izrazito izboljšanje in videti je, da se moja pljuča čistijo. Čeprav gre počasi, je to natanko tak napredek, kot sem si ga lahko želel in nanj upal...

nodes.source: EXCELLENT !!
nodes.text: ODLIČNO!!

nodes.source: All that remains now are regular monthly blood tests, physical examinations and alternate chest X-Ray's which will become more and more spaced out as the years go by... yes years! I will be blood tested and checked up for the rest of my life, hopefully in about 5 years from now I will be given the 'ALL CLEAR' and then further blood tests will be taken annually for the rest of my life.
nodes.text: Zdaj ostanejo le še redni mesečni krvni testi, telesni pregledi in izmenična rentgenska slikanja prsnega koša, med katerimi bo z minevanjem let vse več časa... da, let! Kri mi bodo jemali in me pregledovali do konca življenja. Upam, da mi bodo čez približno 5 let rekli, da sem 'POVSEM ZDRAV', nato pa mi bodo do konca življenja enkrat na leto še naprej opravljali krvne teste.

nodes.source: I'm off the production line now and handed over to quality control!
nodes.text: Zdaj sem končal na proizvodni liniji in so me predali nadzoru kakovosti!

nodes.source: Amongst discussions about side effects that I have been suffering from, I reported a creaking sensation that I've recently noticed in my lower back, hips and legs. I haven't had any pain or discomfort, just this weird sensation like a creaking. My Doctor seemed to be a little worried about this and said it may be something of nothing, certainly not related to Cancer, more a side effect of chemotherapy and it would be best for me to go and have a Pelvis X-Ray immediately. The results of which would be discussed at the next patient meeting when the Doctors get together (most likely this coming Monday).
nodes.text: Med pogovorom o stranskih učinkih, ki me pestijo, sem omenil občutek škripanja, ki sem ga nedavno opazil v spodnjem delu hrbta, kolkih in nogah. Nimam bolečin ali neprijetnih občutkov, samo ta čudni občutek, kot da nekaj škripa. Moj zdravnik je bil zaradi tega videti malo zaskrbljen in je rekel, da morda ni nič posebnega, vsekakor ni povezano z rakom, prej gre za stranski učinek kemoterapije, in da bi bilo najbolje, če grem takoj na rentgensko slikanje medenice. O rezultatih bi se pogovorili na naslednjem sestanku o bolnikih, ko se zdravniki zberejo skupaj (najverjetneje ta ponedeljek).

nodes.source: I'm not too worried and hope the sensation will pass given time. Hold that thought!
nodes.text: Nisem preveč zaskrbljen in upam, da bo občutek sčasoma minil. Držimo se te misli!

nodes.source: Also whilst looking over my CT Scans my Doctor spotted some 'clips' that showed up. It did make me wonder but his mention of them was very cursory.
nodes.text: Med pregledovanjem mojih CT-posnetkov je zdravnik opazil tudi neke 'sponke', ki so bile vidne na njih. Res sem se zamislil, vendar jih je omenil samo mimogrede.

nodes.source: We said our good-byes and off I went for my Pelvis X-Ray. Again I was seen to very quickly and was X-Rayed within minutes of arriving at the reception. I asked very nicely if I could see the final images on screen, which the Radiographer kindly agreed to. Again there was mention of these 'clips' and that's not what the X-Ray was for!
nodes.text: Poslovila sva se in odpravil sem se na rentgensko slikanje medenice. Spet sem bil na vrsti zelo hitro in slikali so me že nekaj minut po prihodu na sprejem. Zelo prijazno sem vprašal, ali si lahko ogledam končne slike na zaslonu, in radiološki inženir mi je prijazno ustregel. Spet so bile omenjene te 'sponke', čeprav slikanje sploh ni bilo namenjeno njim!

nodes.source: Now it was getting me thinking, the Radiographer couldn't really shed any light on it for me so I set off to find out some more.
nodes.text: Zdaj mi to ni več dalo miru. Radiološki inženir mi ni znal zares pojasniti zadeve, zato sem se odpravil po dodatne informacije.

nodes.source: Essentially and at first I was quite mad/worried as nobody I asked seemed to know anything. There I was, left thinking that some foreign objects had been left in my body for no apparent reason and further surgery may be required to remove them, what do I know I'm not a surgical expert!
nodes.text: Sprva sem bil pravzaprav precej jezen oziroma zaskrbljen, saj se je zdelo, da nihče, ki sem ga vprašal, ne ve ničesar. Tako sem ostal z mislijo, da so v mojem telesu brez očitnega razloga pustili neke tujke in da bo morda potrebna še ena operacija, da jih odstranijo. Kaj pa jaz vem, saj nisem strokovnjak za kirurgijo!

nodes.source: At no point do I remember being told that metal 'clips' would be left inside me and now it has got me wondering how many of them there are, where they all are and exactly why are they there.
nodes.text: Ne spomnim se, da bi mi kadar koli povedali, da bodo v meni ostale kovinske 'sponke'. Zdaj pa se sprašujem, koliko jih je, kje vse so in zakaj natanko so tam.

nodes.source: I haven't really been given a detailed answer as yet but it seems common practise to have these clips left inside you after some surgical procedures. I would have loved to have been told this before hand, wouldn't you?
nodes.text: Podrobnega odgovora pravzaprav še nisem dobil, vendar se zdi, da je po nekaterih kirurških posegih običajno pustiti te sponke v telesu. Zelo bi bil vesel, če bi mi to povedali vnaprej, mar ne bi bili tudi vi?

nodes.source: Surgery is scary enough being out of your control. I think it would be nice to be put in the picture much more before you are cut open, especially when it is planned surgery!
nodes.text: Operacija je že tako dovolj strašljiva, ker nad njo nimaš nadzora. Mislim, da bi bilo lepo, če bi te precej bolje seznanili z vsem, preden te razrežejo, še posebej pri načrtovani operaciji!

nodes.source: Hmmm, not exactly sure what I am going to do about this but I need to find out more to put my mind at rest.
nodes.text: Hmm, nisem povsem prepričan, kaj bom storil glede tega, vendar moram izvedeti več, da bom lahko pomirjen.

nodes.source: That's all I can think of for now. I'll be back in a few days time to have a natter about the following...
nodes.text: To je za zdaj vse, česar se lahko spomnim. Čez nekaj dni bom spet tukaj, da malo poklepetam o naslednjem...

nodes.source: Note to watch TV... 21.00 on the 9th June 2005 on CH4 UK.
nodes.text: Opomnik za ogled televizije... 9. junija 2005 ob 21.00 na CH4 UK.

nodes.source: There is a documentary called "Bollocks to Cancer", I'll be very interested to see how close this documentary depicts itself to my individual experience.
nodes.text: Na sporedu je dokumentarec z naslovom 'Bollocks to Cancer'. Zelo me bo zanimalo, kako blizu mojim osebnim izkušnjam bo njegova upodobitev.

nodes.source: Apart from the above I am in good health and rapidly returning to full strength. I've been out and about filling my lungs with fresh air and eating well, watch out I could be knocking on your door soon for dinner!!
nodes.text: Razen zgoraj navedenega sem dobrega zdravja in se mi hitro vrača vsa moč. Hodim naokoli, polnim pljuča s svežim zrakom in dobro jem. Pazite se, lahko da bom kmalu potrkal na vaša vrata in prišel na večerjo!!

nodes.source: For those of you who are avid readers out there, you'll have made it this far with me and I thank you tremendously for that. Unless anything exciting happens now, entries will be very few and far between, although I do plan to keep the site well updated for the foreseeable future. There are new reference features coming to the site very soon and a few more pictures to boot.
nodes.text: Tisti, ki me zavzeto berete, ste prišli z mano vse do sem in za to se vam neizmerno zahvaljujem. Če se zdaj ne zgodi kaj vznemirljivega, bodo zapisi zelo redki, čeprav nameravam spletno mesto v dogledni prihodnosti redno posodabljati. Zelo kmalu bodo na njem nove informativne vsebine in za povrh še nekaj fotografij.

nodes.source: I am also going to be planning a party... aptly named "Tim's Ball" primarily for us all to celebrate the life we have been granted however difficult at times, please email if your interested in coming along! I haven't come up with a venue or any dates yet, I'm thinking August 2005 sometime to coincide with my birthday!
nodes.text: Načrtoval bom tudi zabavo... s primernim imenom 'Tim's Ball', predvsem zato, da vsi skupaj proslavimo življenje, ki nam je bilo dano, pa naj bo včasih še tako težko. Če bi radi prišli, mi pošljite e-pošto! Kraja in datumov še nisem izbral, razmišljam o enkrat v avgustu 2005, da bi sovpadalo z mojim rojstnim dnem!

nodes.source: 7th June 2005 - Tuesday
nodes.text: 7. junija 2005 - torek

nodes.source: Currently I'm attending a Cancer Support Group and my second meeting was this morning. Essentially we talk about our experiences with Cancer and how we and all around us have/are dealing with it.
nodes.text: Trenutno obiskujem podporno skupino za bolnike z rakom in danes dopoldne je bilo moje drugo srečanje. V bistvu govorimo o svojih izkušnjah z rakom ter o tem, kako smo se mi in vsi okoli nas z njim spopadali oziroma se še spopadamo.

nodes.source: Mostly what is discussed is pretty private stuff and individual to that sufferer, most of what I say is already here for you all to see! One of the subjects that was brought up today was the constant hurdles that face you during treatment, it's just one thing after another...
nodes.text: Večina tega, o čemer se pogovarjamo, je precej zasebna in značilna za posameznega bolnika. Večina tega, kar povem jaz, pa je že tukaj na ogled vsem vam! Ena od tem, ki smo jih odprli danes, so bile nenehne ovire, s katerimi se srečuješ med zdravljenjem, kar ena za drugo prihajajo...

nodes.source: Which brings me to some new information I have been given today. My recent Pelvis X-Ray results are in. All appears fine so far but my Doctors (whatever they are looking for) have been advised by the Radiologist that an MRI scan would be more suitable.
nodes.text: To me pripelje do novih informacij, ki sem jih dobil danes. Rezultati nedavnega rentgenskega slikanja medenice so prispeli. Za zdaj je vse videti v redu, vendar je radiolog mojim zdravnikom (kar koli že iščejo) svetoval, da bi bila magnetna resonanca primernejša.

nodes.source: I am now awaiting my appointment to come through the post, apparently it will be quite quick and I will have a follow up meeting to discuss the results.
nodes.text: Zdaj čakam, da po pošti dobim termin. Menda bo to kar hitro in potem bom imel še sestanek, na katerem se bomo pogovorili o rezultatih.

nodes.source: Now I'm a little nervous as to what this could be.
nodes.text: Zdaj sem malo živčen, kaj bi to lahko bilo.

nodes.source: Still no concrete information on the 'clips' that are inside me. I have had some very comforting emails from fellow patients who also have them so it's a little less worrying. Still I would like to know how many of them there are, where they all are and exactly why are they there! After all it sounds very much like they are there to stay and although I don't think I can notice them it would be nice to know exactly what I'm carrying about inside my body!
nodes.text: Še vedno nimam konkretnih informacij o 'sponkah' v mojem telesu. Dobil sem nekaj zelo pomirjujočih e-sporočil drugih bolnikov, ki jih imajo tudi sami, zato me zdaj malo manj skrbi. Še vedno pa bi rad vedel, koliko jih je, kje vse so in zakaj natanko so tam! Navsezadnje je slišati, da bodo tam tudi ostale, in čeprav se mi zdi, da jih ne čutim, bi bilo lepo vedeti, kaj natanko nosim v svojem telesu!

nodes.source: Ok I'm going to creak off in to life as best as I can make it, back on Thursday.
nodes.text: Prav, zdaj bom odškripal naprej v življenje in iz njega naredil največ, kar lahko. Vrnem se v četrtek.

nodes.source: 9th June 2005 - Thursday
nodes.text: 9. junija 2005 - četrtek

nodes.source: 23.30... Today is 6 months to the day since I was diagnosed with my Cancer, a disease that had spread throughout my body unbeknown to me apart from a niggling cough.
nodes.text: 23.30... Danes mineva natanko 6 mesecev, odkar so mi diagnosticirali raka, bolezen, ki se je nevede razširila po vsem mojem telesu, če odmislimo nadležen kašelj.

nodes.source: This time on the 9th of December 2004 I was lying in a medical assessment unit in West Middlesex Hospital, riddled with disease. My friends had gone home and I was left to wonder, alone in my room, what the future would hold for me.
nodes.text: Ob tej uri 9. decembra 2004 sem ležal na oddelku za medicinsko oceno v bolnišnici West Middlesex, prepreden z boleznijo. Prijatelji so odšli domov in ostal sem sam v sobi ter razmišljal, kaj mi prinaša prihodnost.

nodes.source: So, half a year later, I have been through 4 cycles of extensive BEP chemotherapy followed by major surgery and today I'm in remission from a Cancer that almost killed me. My story has been told and you've all been here to share it with me.
nodes.text: Torej sem pol leta pozneje prestal 4 cikle obsežne kemoterapije BEP, ki jim je sledila velika operacija, in danes sem v remisiji raka, ki me je skoraj ubil. Moja zgodba je bila povedana in vsi vi ste bili tukaj, da ste jo delili z menoj.

nodes.source: Strangely on this anniversary, a documentary was aired this evening called "Bollocks to Cancer". A documentary about a young Testicular Cancer sufferer and survivor. Although a different person and a short production to pack a lot of experience in to, it really brought back some vivid memories and experiences for me.
nodes.text: Po nenavadnem naključju so prav na to obletnico nocoj predvajali dokumentarec z naslovom 'Bollocks to Cancer'. Dokumentarec o mladem moškem, ki je zbolel za rakom mod in ga preživel. Čeprav gre za drugo osebo in kratko oddajo, v katero je bilo treba stlačiti veliko izkušenj, mi je obudila nekaj res živih spominov in doživetij.

nodes.source: It certainly did a good job of portraying what it's like to lie in hospital on BEP chemotherapy, the thought processes and feelings. My treatment was the exactly the same, I had an extra cycle. The wards were similar in layout although I did not have other Testicular Cancer sufferers around me. At the beginning, in one of my earlier male ward stays, all five of my fellow patients died. That was tough.
nodes.text: Vsekakor je dobro prikazal, kako je ležati v bolnišnici na kemoterapiji BEP, pa misli in občutke ob tem. Moje zdravljenje je bilo povsem enako, le en cikel več sem imel. Oddelki so bili podobno razporejeni, čeprav okoli mene ni bilo drugih bolnikov z rakom mod. Na začetku, med enim mojih prvih bivanj na moškem oddelku, je umrlo vseh pet mojih sobolnikov. To je bilo težko.

nodes.source: I have a different perspective on life now and have learnt a great lesson in mortality. A gift if you like, but not exactly the best way to receive it. It's difficult to describe the feeling, you have to experience it in one way or another for yourself, something which I do not wish on anyone.
nodes.text: Zdaj na življenje gledam drugače in sem dobil veliko lekcijo o umrljivosti. Lahko ji rečete darilo, vendar način, kako sem ga prejel, ni bil ravno najboljši. Občutek je težko opisati, na tak ali drugačen način ga moraš doživeti sam, česar pa ne privoščim nikomur.

nodes.source: My website lives on, as I do. I will be back soon with more information on further scans and tests that I am to have.
nodes.text: Moje spletno mesto živi naprej, tako kot jaz. Kmalu se vrnem z več informacijami o nadaljnjih slikanjih in preiskavah, ki me čakajo.

nodes.source: This is my personal experience, not medical advice.
nodes.text: To je moja osebna izkušnja, ne zdravstveni nasvet.

nodes.text: Slikovne preiskave, okrevanje in naslednje odločitve

nodes.source: Personal diary
nodes.text: Osebni dnevnik

nodes.source: About 24 min read
nodes.text: Približno 24 min branja

nodes.source: 1st March 2005 - Tuesday
nodes.text: 1. marca 2005 - torek

nodes.source: Got to Charing X about an hour late for my blood test. My Dad accompanied me to the hospital and joined me for a chat with my Doctor. Routine discussions; my treatment has progressed well, now it's recovery time for my body before any operations are carried out.
nodes.text: Na odvzem krvi v Charing X sem prišel približno eno uro prepozno. Oče me je spremljal v bolnišnico in se mi pridružil pri pogovoru z zdravnikom. Običajen pogovor: zdravljenje dobro napreduje, zdaj pa mora telo okrevati, preden se lotijo kakršne koli operacije.

nodes.source: Spent a considerable amount of time wandering about on the 6th floor catching up with Milton and the staff while waiting for my blood test results. Once they were finally through, I managed to grab the registrar on the 6th floor to discuss them.
nodes.text: Kar precej časa sem se potikal po 6. nadstropju, klepetal z Miltonom in osebjem ter čakal na krvne izvide. Ko so končno prispeli, sem uspel ujeti zdravnika specializanta v 6. nadstropju, da sva se pogovorila o njih.

nodes.source: My blood health is low but that is to be expected. I wasn't planning on doing anything apart from recovering at home, so the registrar didn't recommend any further medication or injections and gave me a cautionary chat about looking after myself and allowed me to go home.
nodes.text: Moja krvna slika je slaba, vendar je bilo to pričakovano. Nisem nameraval početi nič drugega kot okrevati doma, zato mi specializant ni priporočil dodatnih zdravil ali injekcij. Opozoril me je, kako moram paziti nase, in me pustil domov.

nodes.source: A quick visit to the local DIY store en route home.
nodes.text: Na poti domov sva na hitro obiskala lokalno trgovino z materialom za domača popravila.

nodes.source: Once home, managed a little dinner and relaxed in front of the TV before hitting the sack.
nodes.text: Ko sem prišel domov, sem uspel pojesti malo večerje in se sprostil pred televizijo, preden sem zlezel v posteljo.

nodes.source: 2nd March 2005 - Wednesday
nodes.text: 2. marca 2005 - sreda

nodes.source: Woke up not really feeling refreshed at all. Managed to get myself up and dressed but not much more. A little breakfast and I hit the sofa for the rest of the day.
nodes.text: Zbudil sem se, ne da bi se počutil kaj prida spočitega. Uspel sem vstati in se obleči, kaj dosti več pa ne. Po malo zajtrka sem se do konca dneva preselil na kavč.

nodes.source: Often snoozing, I found that if I tried to motivate myself to do anything I would just get out of breath and my heart would beat faster and harder.
nodes.text: Pogosto sem dremal. Če sem se skušal pripraviti do kakršnega koli opravila, sem takoj ostal brez sape, srce pa mi je začelo biti hitreje in močneje.

nodes.source: If I were to mark my health and how I feel out of 10, I'd say I was at about a 6.
nodes.text: Če bi moral svoje zdravje in počutje oceniti na lestvici do 10, bi rekel, da sem nekje pri 6.

nodes.source: 3rd March 2005 - Thursday
nodes.text: 3. marca 2005 - četrtek

nodes.source: Much the same as yesterday; spent the day on the sofa. My little health marker I've made up in my head is still at about a 6.
nodes.text: Približno tako kot včeraj, dan sem preživel na kavču. Moj mali kazalnik zdravja, ki sem si ga izmislil v glavi, je še vedno nekje pri 6.

nodes.source: 4th March 2005 - Friday
nodes.text: 4. marca 2005 - petek

nodes.source: Still much the same, spent the day on the sofa feeling very lethargic indeed. My little health marker now at about 5.
nodes.text: Še vedno približno enako. Dan sem preživel na kavču in se počutil res zelo brezvoljnega in izčrpanega. Moj mali kazalnik zdravja je zdaj približno 5.

nodes.source: 5th March 2005 - Saturday
nodes.text: 5. marca 2005 - sobota

nodes.source: Still much the same, spent the day on the sofa. Sleeping lots and getting tired very quickly, even if I attempt to move about too much on the sofa. My little health marker still at about a 5.
nodes.text: Še vedno približno enako, dan sem preživel na kavču. Veliko spim in se zelo hitro utrudim, tudi če se poskušam samo malo bolj premikati po kavču. Moj mali kazalnik zdravja je še vedno približno 5.

nodes.source: 6th March 2005 - Sunday
nodes.text: 6. marca 2005 - nedelja

nodes.source: Still much the same, spent the day on the sofa. Sleeping lots and getting tired very quickly, even if I attempt to move about too much on the sofa.
nodes.text: Še vedno približno enako, dan sem preživel na kavču. Veliko spim in se zelo hitro utrudim, tudi če se poskušam samo malo bolj premikati po kavču.

nodes.source: Very frustrating indeed, there's so much I want to achieve and even the smallest things seem like too much of a chore.
nodes.text: To je res zelo frustrirajoče. Toliko stvari bi rad naredil, pa se mi še najmanjša opravila zdijo prevelik zalogaj.

nodes.source: One thing I really wanted to do was get to see my Mum today, being Mother's Day. It just wasn't going to happen; I could not muster the energy to even lift myself from the sofa. This made me quite disappointed indeed.
nodes.text: Danes sem si res želel obiskati mamo, saj je materinski dan. Preprosto ni šlo. Nisem mogel zbrati niti toliko energije, da bi se dvignil s kavča. Zaradi tega sem bil kar precej razočaran.

nodes.source: I have been eating, but sporadically, and there really hasn't been much I've particularly fancied at all. Still, my Dad has persevered and managed to get me to eat a decent meal each night.
nodes.text: Jedel sem, vendar neredno, in pravzaprav mi ni posebej dišalo skoraj nič. Oče je vseeno vztrajal in me vsak večer uspel pripraviti do spodobnega obroka.

nodes.source: My little health marker now at about a 4. I reckon I'm most certainly due for a blood transfusion this coming week and said as much to my Dad.
nodes.text: Moj mali kazalnik zdravja je zdaj približno 4. Mislim, da bom prihodnji teden zagotovo potreboval transfuzijo krvi, in to sem tudi povedal očetu.

nodes.source: 7th March 2005 - Monday
nodes.text: 7. marca 2005 - ponedeljek

nodes.source: My Dad left early this morning for his home, after spending the whole of last week looking after me. Also fitting in quite a bit of DIY that needed doing too!
nodes.text: Oče je danes zgodaj zjutraj odšel domov, potem ko je ves prejšnji teden skrbel zame. Vmes je uspel postoriti tudi kar nekaj domačih popravil, ki so bila potrebna!

nodes.source: I rested and slept on the sofa for the rest of the day.
nodes.text: Preostanek dneva sem počival in spal na kavču.

nodes.source: I reckon health marker probably at a 3 by now!
nodes.text: Mislim, da je moj kazalnik zdravja zdaj verjetno že pri 3!

nodes.source: 8th March 2005 - Tuesday
nodes.text: 8. marca 2005 - torek

nodes.source: Got myself moving this morning, I really don't know where I found the energy from. Drove myself in to Charing Cross for my blood test.
nodes.text: Zjutraj sem se spravil v pogon. Res ne vem, od kod sem vzel energijo. Sam sem se odpeljal v Charing Cross na krvni test.

nodes.source: Spoke with the registrar immediately after bloods were taken and nipped up to the 6th floor to see who was about while waiting for my results.
nodes.text: Takoj po odvzemu krvi sem govoril s specializantom, nato pa skočil v 6. nadstropje pogledat, kdo je tam, medtem ko sem čakal na izvide.

nodes.source: I knew I wasn't feeling well but once I returned for my results at Clinic 8, I was told that I wasn't going home and was to be admitted - to an isolation room!!!
nodes.text: Vedel sem, da se ne počutim dobro, toda ko sem se vrnil po izvide v ambulanto 8, so mi povedali, da ne grem domov, ampak me bodo sprejeli v bolnišnico. In to v izolacijsko sobo!!!

nodes.source: My blood health was so poor I was in quite a bit of danger. Black outs, internal bleeding, serious infections; to mention some of the possible things that could have happened to me if my blood and I were left alone to get any worse!
nodes.text: Moja krvna slika je bila tako slaba, da sem bil v precejšnji nevarnosti. Izguba zavesti, notranje krvavitve, resne okužbe: če naštejem le nekaj stvari, ki bi se mi lahko zgodile, če bi mene in mojo kri pustili pri miru, da bi se stanje še poslabšalo!

nodes.source: It seems the cumulative effects of my chemotherapy had really kicked in and my bone marrow was simply not functioning correctly enough to produce goodness for my blood.
nodes.text: Kaže, da so se nakopičeni učinki kemoterapije zares pokazali in moj kostni mozeg preprosto ni deloval dovolj dobro, da bi proizvajal vse potrebno za kri.

nodes.source: After waiting 6 hours for my room to be allocated (a friend had arrived to keep me company) I was moved up to the familiar 6th floor, this time on the North wing in to a room of my very own.
nodes.text: Po 6 urah čakanja, da mi dodelijo sobo, med katerimi mi je prišel delat družbo prijatelj, so me preselili v znano 6. nadstropje. Tokrat v severno krilo, v čisto svojo sobo.

nodes.source: 1 GCSF injection and immediately on Antibiotics (Amoxicillin 500mg).
nodes.text: 1 injekcija GCSF in takoj antibiotiki, Amoxicillin 500 mg.

nodes.source: Cannulated twice, the first time failed, eventually the first unit of blood to be transfused was begun. Following which I was transfused 1 pool of platelets and then a following further 2 units of blood. All this would go through the night and my observations were carried out at very close intervals due to the feverish side effects both blood and platelets can give you. No sleep for me!
nodes.text: Dvakrat so mi poskusili vstaviti kanilo, prvi poskus ni uspel. Končno so začeli transfuzijo prve enote krvi. Nato sem dobil 1 odmerek združenega pripravka trombocitov, zatem pa še 2 enoti krvi. Vse skupaj je trajalo vso noč. Moje stanje so preverjali zelo pogosto, saj lahko tako kri kot trombociti povzročijo vročino. Zame torej nič spanja!

nodes.source: Together with some friends, I managed to get some clothes and my usual hospital gear brought to me this evening. Remember I only drove in for a blood test earlier and was not expecting to be admitted!
nodes.text: S pomočjo nekaj prijateljev mi je uspelo urediti, da so mi danes zvečer prinesli oblačila in moje običajne bolnišnične potrebščine. Ne pozabite, da sem se dopoldne pripeljal samo na krvni test in sploh nisem pričakoval sprejema!

nodes.source: I was sick this evening. Not sure why, may have been the stress of coming back in unexpectedly or simply just the ongoing effects of my poor state of health.
nodes.text: Zvečer sem bruhal. Ne vem, zakaj. Morda zaradi stresa ob nepričakovani vrnitvi v bolnišnico ali pa preprosto zaradi nadaljnjih posledic mojega slabega zdravstvenega stanja.

nodes.source: Being in isolation meant strict hygiene and contact with others was at a minimum.
nodes.text: Izolacija je pomenila strogo higieno in kar najmanj stika z drugimi.

nodes.source: 9th March 2005 - Wednesday
nodes.text: 9. marca 2005 - sreda

nodes.source: Three months since diagnosis today. It passed without me noticing.
nodes.text: Danes so minili trije meseci od diagnoze. Šlo je mimo, ne da bi sploh opazil.

nodes.source: I slept for a fair bit today. Someone came over to visit, I doubt I was much company.
nodes.text: Danes sem kar precej spal. Nekdo me je prišel obiskat, a dvomim, da sem bil dobra družba.

nodes.source: They took another blood test, a very slight improvement. Another 1 unit of blood was required, managed to get this in during the evening and was left alone for a good night's sleep.
nodes.text: Spet so mi vzeli kri, izvid je bil čisto malo boljši. Potreboval sem še 1 enoto krvi. Uspelo jim jo je dati zvečer, potem pa so me pustili pri miru, da sem se lahko dobro naspal.

nodes.source: 10th March 2005 - Thursday
nodes.text: 10. marca 2005 - četrtek

nodes.source: Slept really well. Observation day today, if no improvement is found in the level of my platelets today, another pool of platelets will be required.
nodes.text: Res dobro sem spal. Danes je dan za opazovanje. Če se raven trombocitov ne izboljša, bom potreboval še en odmerek združenega pripravka trombocitov.

nodes.source: Fortunately my bloods had recovered suitably well enough for me to just be observed for the day.
nodes.text: Na srečo so se krvni izvidi dovolj popravili, da so me danes lahko samo opazovali.

nodes.source: My health had certainly picked up a lot more today and spent most of it in bed watching daytime TV!
nodes.text: Danes sem bil vsekakor precej boljšega zdravja. Večino dneva sem preživel v postelji in gledal dnevni televizijski program!

nodes.source: No need for isolation hygiene requirements anymore. I was free to leave the room and take more visitors. A few visitors came over this evening after which I got myself another brilliant and undisturbed night's sleep.
nodes.text: Higienski ukrepi zaradi izolacije niso bili več potrebni. Lahko sem zapustil sobo in sprejel več obiskovalcev. Zvečer jih je nekaj prišlo, nato pa sem spet odlično in nemoteno prespal noč.

nodes.source: 11th March 2005 - Friday
nodes.text: 11. marca 2005 - petek

nodes.source: Slept really well again and felt so much better.
nodes.text: Spet sem res dobro spal in se počutil veliko bolje.

nodes.source: Stuck the daytime TV on, observations taken. I eagerly awaited my blood test today as the results would determine whether I was to be discharged.
nodes.text: Prižgal sem dnevni televizijski program, medtem ko so preverjali moje stanje. Nestrpno sem čakal današnji krvni test, saj bo od izvidov odvisno, ali me bodo odpustili.

nodes.source: I waited some time for my blood test to be taken. The ward was quite busy today as I think they had a very poorly patient whom I had seen them rushing an emergency crash cart to. During my short stay this week I had seen many distressed relatives. Death is something which you become almost oblivious to, especially spending time on a Cancer ward, you know it's happening but shield yourself from the suffering.
nodes.text: Kar nekaj časa sem čakal na odvzem krvi. Na oddelku so imeli danes veliko dela. Mislim, da je bil eden od bolnikov zelo slab, saj sem videl, kako so k njemu hiteli z vozičkom za oživljanje. V tem kratkem bivanju v bolnišnici ta teden sem videl veliko pretresenih svojcev. Za smrt postaneš skoraj neobčutljiv, zlasti če preživljaš čas na onkološkem oddelku. Veš, da se dogaja, vendar se skušaš zaščititi pred trpljenjem.

nodes.source: I waited patiently and carried on with my new daytime TV addiction.
nodes.text: Potrpežljivo sem čakal in se še naprej predajal svoji novi odvisnosti od dnevne televizije.

nodes.source: Finally the registrar decided to do the blood test, as I had not been seen to for ages. They were marked urgent and I awaited the results.
nodes.text: Nazadnje se je specializant odločil, da mi bo sam vzel kri, ker se že tako dolgo nihče ni utegnil ukvarjati z mano. Vzorce so označili kot nujne, jaz pa sem čakal izvide.

nodes.source: Everything apart from my Magnesium levels had returned to reasonable levels and I was to be discharged as soon as my cannulation was removed and my TTA (To Take Away) medications allocated. Apparently the TTA's were already ready but due to how busy the ward was today, I waited a further 5 hours to be discharged (I think they had thought I'd already left or had forgotten about me. Instead I was happily laying in bed watching the box and chatting to a friend who had been with me for the whole day).
nodes.text: Vse razen magnezija se je vrnilo na sprejemljive ravni. Odpustili naj bi me, takoj ko mi odstranijo kanilo in pripravijo zdravila za domov, tako imenovana TTA, To Take Away. Očitno so bila zdravila že pripravljena, a ker so imeli na oddelku toliko dela, sem na odpust čakal še 5 ur. Mislim, da so menili, da sem že odšel, ali pa so pozabili name. Jaz pa sem zadovoljno ležal v postelji, gledal televizijo in klepetal s prijateljem, ki je bil z mano ves dan.

nodes.source: My Magnesium deficiency is down to the damage that the Cisplatin or the 'P' of BEP chemotherapy has done to my body. This is something that will now have to be monitored carefully during each of my blood tests although the doctors do not seem to be overly concerned. There is so much, outside of killing cancer, that chemotherapy does to your body. Killing cancer cells is the desired result, the rest just has to be dealt with as and when it becomes apparent.
nodes.text: Magnezija mi primanjkuje zaradi škode, ki jo je mojemu telesu povzročil Cisplatin, torej črka 'P' v kemoterapiji BEP. Od zdaj bodo morali to skrbno spremljati pri vsakem krvnem testu, čeprav zdravniki niso videti pretirano zaskrbljeni. Kemoterapija poleg ubijanja raka v telesu naredi še toliko drugega. Uničenje rakavih celic je želeni rezultat, z vsem ostalim pa se je treba spoprijeti takrat, ko se pokaže.

nodes.source: I left the hospital at exactly the time I thought I would, right in the thick of the rush hour on a Friday night heading out of London. It was not good.
nodes.text: Iz bolnišnice sem odšel natanko takrat, kot sem pričakoval: sredi petkove večerne prometne konice, v smeri iz Londona. Ni bilo prijetno.

nodes.source: Once home, I relaxed in front of the TV, ate a huge 2 helpings of chicken and pasta for dinner which someone kindly prepared for me and soon retired for the evening.
nodes.text: Doma sem se sprostil pred televizijo. Za večerjo sem pojedel 2 ogromni porciji piščanca s testeninami, ki mi ju je nekdo prijazno pripravil, nato pa sem se kmalu odpravil počivat.

nodes.source: 12th March 2005 - Saturday
nodes.text: 12. marca 2005 - sobota

nodes.source: No entries for today.
nodes.text: Za danes ni zapisov.

nodes.source: 13th March 2005 - Sunday
nodes.text: 13. marca 2005 - nedelja

nodes.source: No entries for today.

nodes.text: 14. marca 2005 - ponedeljek
