Moje telo je prestalo veliko in samo čas bo pokazal, ali se bom znebil nekaterih dolgotrajnih simptomov... brazgotine bodo z menoj za vedno.

nodes.source: 21st April 2006 - Friday
nodes.text: 21. aprila 2006 - petek

nodes.source: Routine blood tests and meeting with my Consultant today at Charing Cross Hospital.
nodes.text: Danes v bolnišnici Charing Cross rutinske krvne preiskave in srečanje z mojim specialistom.

nodes.source: I watched my blood test again, every detail, I'm getting used to this now! 4 test tubes of blood taken. One and most importantly for my tumour markers (HCG), two to monitor my general health (U&E's & FBC) and finally one for my testosterone levels.
nodes.text: Spet sem opazoval odvzem krvi, prav vsako podrobnost, zdaj se tega že privajam! Vzeli so mi 4 epruvete krvi. Eno, najpomembnejšo, za tumorske označevalce (HCG), dve za spremljanje splošnega zdravja (U&E in FBC) in zadnjo za raven testosterona.

nodes.source: My Consultant diagnosed something new for me today! It was mentioned briefly and has most likely been with me all of my life. The diagnosis is made most often following routine screening blood tests which unmask 'hyperbilirubinemia'. It's named Gilbert's Syndrome and affects between 3 to 7% of the population, with males predominating over females. I'll have to do some more research but this may tick a lot of boxes for me and answer a lot of health related issues. If I wasn't already trying to live a healthier life, I'm going to have to try even harder now!
nodes.text: Moj specialist mi je danes postavil novo diagnozo! Omenil jo je na kratko in najverjetneje jo imam že vse življenje. Diagnozo največkrat postavijo po rutinskih presejalnih krvnih testih, ki razkrijejo 'hiperbilirubinemijo'. Imenuje se Gilbertov sindrom in prizadene od 3 do 7 % prebivalstva, pogosteje moške kot ženske. Moral bom še malo raziskati, vendar bi to pri meni lahko pojasnilo veliko stvari in odgovorilo na številna zdravstvena vprašanja. Če se ne bi že trudil živeti bolj zdravo, se bom moral zdaj še bolj!

nodes.source: My lungs are still looking good, X-Ray results show scarring and gristle left in my lungs from the Cancer's demise, some of which may stay with me for the rest of my life. There were some pretty big tumours in my lungs, some the size of apples! Got the routine physical examination out of the way and off I went!
nodes.text: Moja pljuča so še vedno videti dobro. Rentgenski izvidi kažejo brazgotine in vezivno tkivo, ki je po odmrtju raka ostalo v pljučih in bo deloma morda ostalo z menoj do konca življenja. V pljučih sem imel nekaj kar velikih tumorjev, nekatere velike kot jabolka! Opravil sem rutinski telesni pregled in odšel!

nodes.source: 22nd April 2006 - Saturday
nodes.text: 22. aprila 2006 - sobota

nodes.source: Today I had my Willow Foundation special day. A fantastic day out, driving exotic sports cars! A small group of us (Ken, my Dad and me) went down to a track in Oxfordshire and all had a go, courtesy of Willow. They even gave us some money to have snacks and a dinner afterwards. It was also nice to see Wendy Gough (Testicular Cancer Awareness campaigner extraordinaire) who had kindly written to the Willow Foundation some time back in order for me to be granted this special day. Sponsor the Willow Foundation... they provide fantastic and very special days for young adults who are going through horrible experiences with their health. Having something special to look forward to in the light of serious illness can make the world of difference. A VERY honourable cause.
nodes.text: Danes sem imel svoj posebni dan fundacije Willow. Fantastičen izlet z vožnjo eksotičnih športnih avtomobilov! Majhna skupina nas (Ken, moj oče in jaz) se je odpravila na dirkališče v Oxfordshiru in vsi smo se preizkusili v vožnji, po zaslugi fundacije Willow. Dali so nam celo nekaj denarja za prigrizke in večerjo po dogodku. Lepo je bilo videti tudi Wendy Gough (izjemno borko za ozaveščanje o raku mod), ki je pred časom prijazno pisala fundaciji Willow, da so mi omogočili ta posebni dan. Podprite fundacijo Willow... mladim odraslim, ki zaradi svojega zdravja preživljajo grozne izkušnje, omogočajo fantastične in zelo posebne dneve. Če se ob hudi bolezni lahko veseliš nečesa posebnega, lahko to spremeni vse. ZELO plemenit namen.

nodes.source: June 2006
nodes.text: junij 2006

nodes.source: 23rd June 2006 - Friday
nodes.text: 23. junija 2006 - petek

nodes.source: Routine blood tests and X-Ray today at Charing Cross Hospital.
nodes.text: Danes rutinski krvni testi in rentgen v bolnišnici Charing Cross.

nodes.source: I watched my blood test again, every detail, I'm an old hand at this! 3 test tubes of blood taken. One test is for my tumour markers (HCG), two to monitor my general health (U&E's & FBC) and finally one for my testosterone levels. The Phlebotomist forgot to take a 4th tube today so instead of sticking me with a needle again he said he would split one of the tubes of blood in to two!
nodes.text: Spet sem opazoval odvzem krvi, prav vsako podrobnost, zdaj sem že star maček! Vzeli so mi 3 epruvete krvi. Ena preiskava je za tumorske označevalce (HCG), dve za spremljanje splošnega zdravja (U&E in FBC) in zadnja za raven testosterona. Danes je izvajalec odvzema pozabil vzeti 4. epruveto, zato je rekel, da bo namesto ponovnega vboda z iglo eno od epruvet krvi razdelil na dve!

nodes.source: I saw my Consultants understudy today, a Registrar, usual routine, all looks OK so far and the physical examination went OK. The Registrars change from time to time it seems like they do around 6 months stints at different hospitals. My Consultant Dr. Savage still had time to say hello which is always nice, I much prefer to see him over a stranger who really hasn't had anything to do with my case. When you mention something to a new Registrar they scrabble through your file unwittingly to find the answers!
nodes.text: Danes me je sprejel namestnik mojega specialista, zdravnik specializant. Običajna rutina, za zdaj je vse videti v redu in tudi telesni pregled je bil v redu. Zdravniki specializanti se občasno zamenjajo, zdi se, da v različnih bolnišnicah delajo po približno 6 mesecev. Moj specialist dr. Savage je še vedno našel čas, da me pozdravi, kar je vedno prijetno. Veliko raje vidim njega kot tujca, ki z mojim primerom pravzaprav ni imel ničesar. Ko novemu zdravniku specializantu kaj omeniš, začne brez prave predstave brskati po tvoji kartoteki in iskati odgovore!

nodes.source: I managed a look at my X-Ray, it's a daunting thought each time I have an X-Ray, waiting for the image to appear on screen and hoping that it looks -in my limited capacity as a patient- almost clear.
nodes.text: Uspelo mi je pogledati rentgenski posnetek. Vsakič, ko grem na rentgen, me navdaja strah, ko čakam, da se slika pokaže na zaslonu, in upam, da je - kolikor lahko presodim kot bolnik - skoraj čista.

nodes.source: Here's an update of recent symptoms...
nodes.text: Tu je pregled zadnjih simptomov...

nodes.source: Tiredness
nodes.text: Utrujenost

nodes.source: (stamina back to normal now)
nodes.text: (vzdržljivost je zdaj spet normalna)

nodes.source: Peripheral Neuropathy
nodes.text: Periferna nevropatija

nodes.source: (gone)
nodes.text: (izginilo)

nodes.source: Tinnitus
nodes.text: Tinitus

nodes.source: (apparent at all times, got used to it)
nodes.text: (ves čas opazno, navadil sem se)

nodes.source: Tiger stripes on skin
nodes.text: Tigraste proge na koži

nodes.source: (still apparent, fading)
nodes.text: (še vedno opazno, bledi)

nodes.source: Lung twinges/pains
nodes.text: Zbadanje/bolečine v pljučih

nodes.source: (occasional)
nodes.text: (občasno)

nodes.source: Headaches
nodes.text: Glavoboli

nodes.source: (nothing out of the ordinary)
nodes.text: (nič neobičajnega)

nodes.source: Not much to moan about in the light of things and of course I have my life!
nodes.text: Glede na vse se nimam veliko pritoževati in seveda imam svoje življenje!

nodes.source: Financially it is still a huge struggle. I had my garage broken in to last month, lost two mountain bikes amongst other possessions. The insurance company dashed my hopes of them being covered so there's another dent in my ability to get fit again.
nodes.text: Finančno je še vedno hud boj. Prejšnji mesec so mi vlomili v garažo, poleg drugih stvari sem izgubil dve gorski kolesi. Zavarovalnica mi je razblinila upanje, da bi škodo krilo zavarovanje, zato je to še en udarec mojim možnostim, da spet pridem v dobro kondicijo.

nodes.source: August 2006
nodes.text: avgust 2006

nodes.source: 18th August 2006 - Friday
nodes.text: 18. avgusta 2006 - petek

nodes.source: Arrived promptly and got the routine blood tests out of the way. After speaking with my Consultant and complaining of some chest pains that were worrying me he recommended an X-Ray, although he was quite positive that there was nothing to worry about. So if I don't hear anything and there are no further updates on the subject then take that as good news... no news is good news!
nodes.text: Prispel sem pravočasno in opravil rutinske krvne teste. Ko sem govoril s specialistom in mu potožil o bolečinah v prsnem košu, ki so me skrbele, je priporočil rentgen, čeprav je bil precej prepričan, da ni razloga za skrb. Če torej ničesar ne slišim in ni nadaljnjih novic o tem, vzemite to kot dobro novico... če ni novic, je to dobra novica!

nodes.source: It seems these days that any little pains or niggles can sometimes worry me on a large scale. I tend to keep the worries locked up inside too, feeling that others around have probably had enough of me complaining!
nodes.text: Zdi se, da me dandanes vsaka majhna bolečina ali neprijeten občutek včasih zelo zaskrbi. Skrbi navadno tudi zapiram vase, ker se mi zdi, da imajo drugi okoli mene verjetno že dovolj mojega pritoževanja!

nodes.source: This test in particular I was almost "looking forward to" and for a long time I haven't felt as worried as I did preceding this test. My Consultant was very re-assuring and had pretty much laid my mind to rest by the time I left his room.
nodes.text: Prav te preiskave sem se skoraj 'veselil' in že dolgo nisem bil tako zaskrbljen kot pred njo. Moj specialist je bil zelo pomirjujoč in me je do odhoda iz njegove ordinacije že skoraj povsem pomiril.

nodes.source: Bumped into a lovely couple in the clinic waiting room who I hope I will see again one day. I was recognised from this website! They had sat up and read the entire diary the night before. I stayed and chatted for a while and hope I was of some encouragement to them both, especially Theo.
nodes.text: V čakalnici ambulante sem naletel na prijeten par, za katerega upam, da ga bom nekoč spet videl. Prepoznala sta me s tega spletnega mesta! Prejšnji večer sta ostala pokonci in prebrala celoten dnevnik. Še nekaj časa sem ostal in klepetal z njima. Upam, da sem bil obema v spodbudo, še posebej Theu.

nodes.source: Theo, I wish you all the very best in your continued treatment and recovery. Stay as positive as you can and keep in touch.
nodes.text: Theo, želim ti vse najboljše pri nadaljnjem zdravljenju in okrevanju. Ostani čim bolj pozitiven in ostani v stiku.

nodes.source: I chose not to look at the X-Ray today, it wasn't a routine one, normally I always try to sneak a peek at it. It was just how I felt.
nodes.text: Danes sem se odločil, da rentgenske slike ne bom pogledal. Ni šlo za rutinsko slikanje, navadno pa vedno skušam na skrivaj pokukati. Preprosto tako sem se počutil.

nodes.source: 31st August 2006 - Thursday
nodes.text: 31. avgusta 2006 - četrtek

nodes.source: No news at all from the Doc. So that must be good news!
nodes.text: Od zdravnika prav nobenih novic. Torej mora biti to dobra novica!

nodes.source: I'm abroad at the moment and awaiting Hurricane John to hit, just on the coast of San Jose Del Cabo, Mexico. Reports are that it is a Category 4 storm which can be life threatening. The eye of the storm is predicted to touch down very close indeed!
nodes.text: Trenutno sem v tujini in čakam, da udari orkan John, prav na obali pri San Jose Del Cabo v Mehiki. Poročajo, da gre za neurje 4. kategorije, ki je lahko smrtno nevarno. Napovedujejo, da bo oko nevihte doseglo kopno res zelo blizu!

nodes.source: Well I've dealt with a life threatening illness let's see how I cope with this, a different experience indeed, but I have a very positive outlook.
nodes.text: No, spopadel sem se že s smrtno nevarno boleznijo, pa poglejmo, kako se bom znašel s tem. Vsekakor drugačna izkušnja, vendar imam zelo pozitiven pogled na vse skupaj.

nodes.source: Back soon! I hope.
nodes.text: Kmalu se vrnem! Upam.

nodes.source: February 2007 9th February 2007 - Friday
nodes.text: Februar 2007 9. februar 2007 - petek

nodes.source: Today it was confirmed that I am officially 2 years clear of Cancer. Every year further away from it all, the better. What fantastic news for me.
nodes.text: Danes so potrdili, da sem uradno že 2 leti brez raka. Vsako leto, ki me oddalji od vsega tega, je boljše. Kako fantastična novica zame.

nodes.source: I feel my diary must come to an end now and I must move on with my life.
nodes.text: Čutim, da se mora moj dnevnik zdaj končati in da moram nadaljevati svoje življenje.

nodes.source: Has it changed me. Honestly? Yes and No! Life has not changed one bit, just the way I perceive things have. If anything life is a little harder but I now have a coping mechanism to help guide me through the bad times. I must say though when the good times are good, they are even more appreciated than before.
nodes.text: Me je to spremenilo? Iskreno? Da in ne! Življenje se ni niti malo spremenilo, spremenil se je samo moj pogled na stvari. Če že kaj, je življenje nekoliko težje, vendar imam zdaj način spopadanja, ki mi pomaga skozi slabe čase. Moram pa reči, da dobre čase, kadar so dobri, cenim še bolj kot prej.

nodes.source: There probably isn't a day that goes by that I don't see something in the world that lights up my day, mostly it is the person closest to me and other times it's something in the world that you have come to appreciate, more so since the illness.
nodes.text: Verjetno ne mine dan, ko ne bi v svetu videl nečesa, kar mi ga polepša. Največkrat je to oseba, ki mi je najbližje, drugič pa nekaj v svetu, kar sem se naučil ceniti, po bolezni še toliko bolj.

nodes.source: Every single day I think about the fact that I have had Cancer, the tinnitus I get reminds me of all of the chemicals pumped through my body and the twinges and occasional -normal- coughs remind me of the Cancer more so than anything else. The scars I have are fading, like memories fading in to the distance.
nodes.text: Prav vsak dan pomislim na to, da sem imel raka. Šumenje v ušesih me spominja na vse kemikalije, ki so jih načrpali skozi moje telo, zbadanje in občasni - normalni - napadi kašlja pa me na raka spomnijo bolj kot kar koli drugega. Moje brazgotine bledijo, tako kot spomini, ki se izgubljajo v daljavi.

nodes.source: The times I remember the most whilst in hospital are the days of my illness that will stick with me forever and are some of the most intimate in my life, those that I shared them with will certainly not forget.
nodes.text: Trenutki iz bolnišnice, ki se jih najbolj spominjam, so dnevi moje bolezni, ki bodo ostali z menoj za vedno in sodijo med najintimnejše v mojem življenju. Tisti, s katerimi sem jih delil, jih zagotovo ne bodo pozabili.

nodes.source: Something I never spoke about in my diary was the fact that the patients I met in the first male ward I was admitted to, either passed away around me or shortly after I had made their acquaintance. That was tough for me to deal with as at that stage I did not fully understand the likely outcome of my illness, so being surrounded by other people dying of a disease similar to mine was terrifying. I have come to understand Cancer is a very broad term!
nodes.text: Nekaj, o čemer v dnevniku nikoli nisem govoril, je dejstvo, da so bolniki, ki sem jih spoznal na prvem moškem oddelku, kamor so me sprejeli, umirali okoli mene ali pa so umrli kmalu po tem, ko sem jih spoznal. S tem sem se težko spoprijemal, saj takrat še nisem povsem razumel verjetnega izida svoje bolezni, zato je bilo strašljivo biti obdan z ljudmi, ki umirajo zaradi bolezni, podobne moji. Sčasoma sem spoznal, da je rak zelo širok pojem!

nodes.source: I think the night and morning before my operation were the most terrifying moments for me, I could not control my emotions and they were laid bare for all to see. The moment the lift doors closed to take me up to surgery was quite honestly one of the hardest things I have ever experienced as I thought I would never see anyone ever again.
nodes.text: Mislim, da sta bila noč in jutro pred operacijo zame najbolj grozljiva trenutka. Nisem mogel obvladovati čustev in bila so razgaljena pred vsemi. Trenutek, ko so se zaprla vrata dvigala, ki me je odpeljalo v operacijsko dvorano, je bil, čisto iskreno, ena najtežjih izkušenj v mojem življenju, saj sem mislil, da nikoli več ne bom nikogar videl.

nodes.source: I still get upset now if I think about it too much.
nodes.text: Še zdaj me stisne, če preveč razmišljam o tem.

nodes.source: Financially I still find things hard, scrambling back to financial health has been a battle in itself and has certainly pulled me down. Testosterone levels and low feelings at times also have affected the way I handle my life. In fact right now I am going through a sudden and difficult personal time and finding it very hard to deal with. Sometimes we just cannot understand what awaits us in life.
nodes.text: Finančno mi je še vedno težko. Prerivanje nazaj do finančnega zdravja je bilo že samo po sebi boj in me je vsekakor potrlo. Tudi raven testosterona in občasna potrtost sta vplivali na to, kako se spoprijemam z življenjem. Pravzaprav trenutno doživljam nenadno in težko osebno obdobje, s katerim se zelo težko soočam. Včasih preprosto ne moremo razumeti, kaj nas čaka v življenju.

nodes.source: Still, I'm a survivor, am thankful for it and you can be too!
nodes.text: Vseeno sem preživel, hvaležen sem za to in tudi vi lahko preživite!

nodes.text: 6 let brez raka!

nodes.source: February 2012
nodes.text: februar 2012

nodes.source: 7 years clear!
nodes.text: 7 let brez raka!

nodes.source: Personally it has been very hard to reach this point. I have been financially ruined by my illness, people and events surrounding it. Getting back on my feet has been quite a struggle, further compounded by events that continue to haunt me.
nodes.text: Na osebni ravni je bilo zelo težko priti do te točke. Bolezen ter ljudje in dogodki okoli nje so me finančno uničili. Spet se postaviti na noge je bil pravi boj, dodatno pa so ga otežili dogodki, ki me še vedno preganjajo.

nodes.source: It brings to mind a famous quote by William Shakespeare…
nodes.text: Ob tem se spomnim znanega citata Williama Shakespeara...

nodes.source: "Love all, trust a few, do wrong to none"
nodes.text: 'Ljubi vse, zaupaj redkim, nikomur ne stori krivice'

nodes.source: Despite this, I have soldiered on regardless and could never have imagined reaching this point in my life.
nodes.text: Kljub temu sem vztrajno korakal naprej in nikoli si ne bi mogel predstavljati, da bom v življenju prišel do te točke.

nodes.source: I have a beautiful partner and the miracle gift of a little baby, naturally conceived. It's so true when they say money cannot bring you happiness, it may solve a lot of 'problems' and make them go away, but for what
nodes.text: Imam čudovito partnerko in čudežno darilo, majhnega otroka, spočetega po naravni poti. Tako resnično je, ko pravijo, da ti denar ne more prinesti sreče. Lahko reši veliko 'težav' in jih odpravi, toda to, kar

nodes.source: I have now, is truly priceless.
nodes.text: imam zdaj, je resnično neprecenljivo.

nodes.source: Thoughts along the way
nodes.text: Misli ob poti

nodes.source:
This is where I post anything that I feel I need to say that doesn't fit within the
diary, some of it nonsense, some of it helpful...
nodes.text: Tukaj objavljam vse, kar čutim, da moram povedati, a ne spada v dnevnik. Nekaj je nesmislov, nekaj pa koristnega ...

nodes.source:
Over the past year and half
(mid 2003 - 2005) I've dealt with a great deal of personal upset and some stressful times (none of
which I will go in to as that is not what this site is about, those of you that know me well, will
know enough), so all in all I've had a pretty shitty couple of years just pass by, which in some
instances doctors suggest can bring on poor health especially if it's lying dormant there in the
first place ready to attack. It might be tough at times, but we must all remember to take stock of
life and try not to get too stressed or upset about situations that cannot be avoided or are
inevitable. Easy to say, much harder to do. Time is the greatest healer of all. I hope we can all
look forward to a brilliant New Year in 2005 with many more to follow.
nodes.text: V zadnjem letu in pol (od sredine leta 2003 do 2005) sem doživel veliko osebnih pretresov in nekaj stresnih obdobij (o katerih ne bom govoril, saj to ni tema tega spletnega mesta; tisti, ki me dobro poznate, veste dovolj). Za mano je torej nekaj precej usranih let, kar lahko po mnenju nekaterih zdravnikov v določenih primerih sproži zdravstvene težave, še posebno če te že prej tiho čakajo v nas in so pripravljene napasti. Včasih je težko, vendar se moramo vsi spomniti, da se je treba ustaviti in razmisliti o življenju ter se poskusiti ne vznemirjati preveč zaradi položajev, ki se jim ni mogoče izogniti ali so neizogibni. Lahko reči, veliko težje storiti. Čas je najboljši zdravilec. Upam, da se lahko vsi veselimo čudovitega novega leta 2005 in še mnogih za njim.

nodes.source:
I'm not ashamed, embarrassed or afraid of my Cancer, this web-site is for all to see from whatever
walk of life, gain strength from and be aware for themselves... pass the word around.
nodes.text: Svojega raka se ne sramujem, ni mi nerodno zaradi njega in ne bojim se ga. To spletno mesto je namenjeno vsem, ne glede na življenjsko pot, da si ga ogledajo, iz njega črpajo moč in so tudi sami bolj pozorni ... povejte naprej.

nodes.source:
Each and everyone of us is made different, so each and everyone of us has a different reaction
to everything. Chemotherapy reacts with everyone differently, my experience is here for all to see,
if you face it I hope you can stay positive about fighting your condition and not worry too much about
the possible side effects from any treatment or surgery. I really hope this site will not only
provide a link for all my friends to keep up to date with what's going on with me but also to
provide inspiration, positivity and drive to others who need that extra kick.
Just go for what you want.
nodes.text: Vsak od nas je drugačen, zato se tudi vsak na vse odziva drugače. Kemoterapija na vsakogar vpliva drugače. Moja izkušnja je tu na ogled vsem. Če vas to čaka, upam, da boste v boju s svojo boleznijo lahko ostali pozitivni in se ne boste preveč obremenjevali z možnimi stranskimi učinki zdravljenja ali operacije. Resnično upam, da to spletno mesto ne bo le povezava, prek katere bodo prijatelji spremljali, kaj se dogaja z mano, temveč bo tudi navdih, vir pozitivnosti in zagon drugim, ki potrebujejo dodaten potisk. Preprosto pojdite za tistim, kar si želite.

getting yourself checked out, insist on having an Ultrasound Scan, in
retrospect if I was offered one I would have known sooner and my Cancer spread would not have been
so bad, thus increasing my percentage of making a full recovery from 80 percent to 99 percent!! AND...
nodes.text: so vas že pregledali, vztrajajte pri ultrazvočni preiskavi. Če se ozrem nazaj, bi izvedel prej, če bi mi jo ponudili, moj rak pa se ne bi tako razširil, s čimer bi se moje možnosti popolnega okrevanja z 80 odstotkov povečale na 99 odstotkov!! IN ...

nodes.source: KEEP CHECKING YOURSELF AT LEAST ONCE EVERY OTHER MONTH.
nodes.text: ŠE NAPREJ SE PREGLEDUJTE VSAJ ENKRAT NA DVA MESECA.

nodes.source:
General advice for all of you... If YOU are unsure about a health issue EVEN AFTER getting
yourself checked out, insist on having it checked again, do some research on the internet.
nodes.text: Splošen nasvet za vse ... Če VI niste prepričani glede zdravstvene težave TUDI PO TEM, KO so vas že pregledali, vztrajajte pri ponovnem pregledu in sami nekaj raziščite na internetu.

nodes.source: DON'T LEAVE IT, IT MAY NOT GO AWAY.
nodes.text: NE ODLAŠAJTE, MORDA NE BO MINILO SAMO OD SEBE.

nodes.source:
Mortgages... Critical Illness Cover, do you have it, it might be worth your while
thinking about it!
nodes.text: Stanovanjski krediti ... Zavarovanje za težke bolezni, ga imate? Morda bi bilo vredno razmisliti o tem!

nodes.source: Medical Insurance... if you have it then good on you, but do you know how much it will
nodes.text: Zdravstveno zavarovanje ... če ga imate, lepo, toda ali veste, koliko vam bo

nodes.source: ACTUALLY
nodes.text: V RESNICI

nodes.source:
cover you in the event that something goes wrong? I pay a fair amount each month and will only get £50
a night for my hospital stays (up to a max of £2000) and NO private care or attention at all,
so long as the NHS can treat me within 6 weeks, which in this instance is guaranteed as my life is
on the line.
nodes.text: krilo, če gre kaj narobe? Vsak mesec plačujem kar precej, dobil pa bom le 50 £ na noč za bivanje v bolnišnici (do največ 2000 £) in NOBENE zasebne oskrbe ali obravnave, dokler me lahko NHS zdravi v šestih tednih. V tem primeru je to zagotovljeno, saj je na kocki moje življenje.

nodes.source:
Quite a few people have suggested that I read the Lance Armstrong story or Bob Champions story,
they have both suffered from Testicular Cancer and recovered. Of course it's a comfort to hear
that people survive and an inspiration that they live on to achieve many wonderful things,
but from my discussions with other patients who are fellow sufferers they would rather experience things
in their own way not through the eyes and thoughts of someone else. Perhaps after this whole
experience has ended I will invest in a copy and be able to relate to their stories, but right
now and for example I do not want to be reading about a particular side effect that I just don't
want to hear about or will simply not touch me.
nodes.text: Kar nekaj ljudi mi je predlagalo, naj preberem zgodbo Lancea Armstronga ali Boba Championa. Oba sta imela raka mod in okrevala. Seveda je tolažilno slišati, da ljudje preživijo, in navdihujoče, da nato v življenju dosežejo veliko čudovitih stvari. Toda iz pogovorov z drugimi bolniki, ki prestajajo podobno, vem, da bi stvari raje doživljali po svoje, ne skozi oči in misli nekoga drugega. Morda si bom, ko bo vsega tega konec, kupil knjigo in se lahko poistovetil z njunima zgodbama. Trenutno pa na primer ne želim brati o določenem stranskem učinku, o katerem preprosto nočem slišati ali pa me sploh ne bo doletel.

nodes.source:
Merry Christmas 2004, if Santa brings me anything for this coming year lets hope its my good
health and full recovery from this Cancer. I hope he's brought you just what you wished for.
Boredom strikes easily at Christmas in hospital, so along with Milton's superb musical talents, Milton,
Ken & I created a silly Christmas music video. The recording is no longer available to watch.
nodes.text: Vesel božič 2004. Če mi bo Božiček za prihodnje leto kaj prinesel, upajmo, da bosta to zdravje in popolno okrevanje od tega raka. Upam, da je vam prinesel natanko tisto, kar ste si želeli. V bolnišnici za božič hitro postane dolgčas, zato smo Milton, Ken in jaz ob Miltonovi izjemni glasbeni nadarjenosti ustvarili trapast božični glasbeni video. Posnetka si ni več mogoče ogledati.

nodes.source:
My friend Roger thinks a hot curry will cure anything, any one fancy a Chicken Tarka Masala?
If only it was that simple, I'd be straight down the nearest ruby house for some Kormatherapy
(sorry no link to this one!)
nodes.text: Moj prijatelj Roger meni, da pekoč kari pozdravi vse. Bi kdo piščanca Tarka Masala? Ko bi bilo vsaj tako preprosto, bi takoj zavil v najbližjo indijsko restavracijo na malo kormaterapije (žal za to ni povezave!)

nodes.source: Milton wondered if Cave children ate chicken shaped dinosaurs, do you think the drugs are effecting him?
nodes.text: Milton se je spraševal, ali so jamski otroci jedli dinozavre v obliki piščancev. Mislite, da zdravila vplivajo nanj?

nodes.source:
I hated needles during my treatment, believe me, I was fed up of having them stuck in me...
now I'm used to them and could probably do it myself!
nodes.text: Med zdravljenjem sem sovražil igle, verjemite mi, dovolj sem imel tega, da so jih zabadali vame ... zdaj sem jih vajen in bi to verjetno lahko počel kar sam!

nodes.source: The people who were there
nodes.text: Ljudje, ki so mi stali ob strani

nodes.source: Friends at a time like this are a gift greater than the finest things you could ever imagine having, don't ever forget who your friends are.
nodes.text: Prijatelji so v takšnih trenutkih darilo, večje od najlepših stvari, kar si jih sploh lahko zamislite. Nikoli ne pozabite, kdo so vaši prijatelji.

nodes.source: My thanks to all those that are out there supporting me throughout this rocky journey in my life, your cards, messages, emails and texts have been a great comfort.
nodes.text: Hvala vsem, ki me podpirate na tej razburkani poti mojega življenja. Vaše voščilnice, sporočila, e-pošta in SMS-i so mi v veliko tolažbo.

nodes.source: My Mum although fighting a debilitating disease herself ( Parkinson's Disease ) has been strong and continues her battle without me to support her, I'll be back Mum don't worry. She's already made it to see me in hospital on numerous occasions! I love you dearly Mum.
nodes.text: Moja mama se tudi sama bori z izčrpavajočo boleznijo (Parkinsonovo boleznijo), a ostaja močna in nadaljuje svoj boj brez moje podpore. Vrnil se bom, mami, ne skrbi. V bolnišnici me je že večkrat obiskala! Zelo te imam rad, mami.

nodes.source: My Dad for visiting so soon and all his support.
nodes.text: Moj oče, ker me je tako hitro obiskal, in za vso njegovo podporo.

nodes.source: My extended family although spread far and wide are all out there for me, their kind wishes, thoughts and prayers are with me all the time.
nodes.text: Moja širša družina, čeprav je raztresena daleč naokoli, mi vsa stoji ob strani. Njihove dobre želje, misli in molitve so ves čas z mano.

nodes.source: Special thanks to my life long friend Ken Clark who has been on hand and acting in my best interests from the start. There's nothing like having someone to shield you from the shit that can be thrown at you when you're at a low or frightening point in your life.
nodes.text: Posebna zahvala mojemu dolgoletnemu prijatelju Kenu Clarku, ki je bil od samega začetka na voljo in je ravnal v moje najboljše dobro. Ni ga čez to, da imaš nekoga, ki te zaščiti pred sranjem, s katerim te lahko zasujejo, ko si na najnižji ali najstrašnejši točki svojega življenja.

nodes.source: Milton Mermikides for just being there, unfortunately not in the best circumstances for himself but a shining light of pure positivity.
nodes.text: Miltonu Mermikidesu, ker je preprosto tu, žal v ne najlepših okoliščinah zanj, a je svetla luč čiste pozitivnosti.

nodes.source: My Consultant Dr. Savage and his team of Registrars (Dr. Tom Powles & Dr. Gairin Dancey) for my effective treatment & contending with my persistent questions! The Macmillan Nurses, Kara Blackwell and Rachel Sharkey for keeping me sane and more than well informed. My Surgeon Mr. Christmas for his superb handy-work and for extending my warranty! Mr. Christmas's team and 8 North for looking after me post op (including Dr. Rob Jeffs). Karen O'Donnell, amongst the many helpful people I have come across, some of whom I have already thanked. Luckily I met Karen who I came across on 8 North the day before being admitted to hospital for my operation. She is the Senior Sister on the Ward (no wonder). In an ideal world, people like Karen should be running hospitals!
nodes.text: Mojemu specialistu dr. Savageu in njegovi ekipi zdravnikov specializantov (dr. Tomu Powlesu in dr. Gairin Dancey) za učinkovito zdravljenje in prenašanje mojih nenehnih vprašanj! Medicinskima sestrama organizacije Macmillan, Kari Blackwell in Rachel Sharkey, ker sta skrbeli za mojo zdravo pamet in odlično obveščenost. Mojemu kirurgu g. Christmasu za njegovo odlično ročno delo in podaljšanje moje garancije! Ekipa g. Christmasa in oddelek 8 North so skrbeli zame po operaciji (tudi dr. Rob Jeffs). Karen O'Donnell je med številnimi ustrežljivimi ljudmi, ki sem jih srečal, nekaterim sem se že zahvalil. Na srečo sem Karen spoznal na oddelku 8 North dan pred sprejemom v bolnišnico zaradi operacije. Je glavna medicinska sestra oddelka (nič čudnega). V idealnem svetu bi morali ljudje, kot je Karen, voditi bolnišnice!

nodes.source: Andy Banks for setting up & Rory Choudhuri for coordinating the guestbook and forum I ran whilst in hospital.
nodes.text: Andyju Banksu za postavitev in Roryju Choudhuriju za usklajevanje knjige gostov in foruma, ki sem ju vodil med bivanjem v bolnišnici.

nodes.source: Antoine Rosset of OsiriX fame for assisting me with the rendering of the amazing CT imagery.
nodes.text: Antoinu Rossetu, znanemu po programu OsiriX, za pomoč pri izrisu neverjetnih CT-posnetkov.

nodes.source: Paul & Sue Wood for looking after me so well and always being such great hosts and friends whenever I visit them.
nodes.text: Paulu in Sue Wood, ker tako dobro skrbita zame in sta ob vsakem mojem obisku tako odlična gostitelja in prijatelja.

nodes.source: Blood donors, you're doing a fine job. Keep healthy and keep it up. I cannot ever give blood now after my treatment and never really relished the thought of doing it when I was healthy. I can certainly see the benefits now, thank you very much!
nodes.text: Krvodajalci, odlično delo opravljate. Ostanite zdravi in nadaljujte. Po zdravljenju nikoli več ne bom mogel darovati krvi, pa tudi ko sem bil zdrav, me misel na to ni prav navduševala. Zdaj vsekakor vidim koristi, najlepša hvala!

nodes.source: My many visitors, some of who have come time and time again … Ken C., Nimish S, Ronnie W., Fini, Michael & Sean T., Olga M., Milton & Bridget M., Leonard W., Martin W. & Hayley, Dean M., Roger R., Nick & Jill J., Martin D., Andy P., Tony C., Brett J., Rob C., Juanita TDE., Simon, Martin S. (brother) & Helen, Emma A., Hayley F., Tori M., Nikki T., Hiren P., Paul W., Khalid R., all at St. Clair Lodge, Arben, Giles (fellow patient) & Marian & John (his parents), Nani Qamar (fellow patient) & all her family/friends for their good wishes.
nodes.text: Moji številni obiskovalci, nekateri so prišli znova in znova ... Ken C., Nimish S, Ronnie W., Fini, Michael in Sean T., Olga M., Milton in Bridget M., Leonard W., Martin W. in Hayley, Dean M., Roger R., Nick in Jill J., Martin D., Andy P., Tony C., Brett J., Rob C., Juanita TDE., Simon, Martin S. (brat) in Helen, Emma A., Hayley F., Tori M., Nikki T., Hiren P., Paul W., Khalid R., vsi v St. Clair Lodge, Arben, Giles (sobolnik) in Marian in John (njegova starša), Nani Qamar (sobolnica) in vsa njena družina/prijatelji za dobre želje.

nodes.source: Others that I cannot mention publicly, or have simply chosen not to mention, I'm sure you know who you are! Thank you.
nodes.text: Drugi, ki jih ne morem javno omeniti ali sem se preprosto odločil, da jih ne bom omenil, zagotovo veste, kdo ste! Hvala.

nodes.source: Reading this website

nodes.source: The diary is divided into months. Use the contents page to choose a chapter, or the previous and next links at the bottom of each chapter to keep reading. The dates menu links directly to entries within a chapter.
nodes.text: Dnevnik je razdeljen po mesecih. Na strani z vsebino izberite poglavje ali pa za nadaljevanje branja uporabite povezavi do prejšnjega in naslednjega poglavja na dnu vsakega poglavja. Meni z datumi vodi neposredno do zapisov v poglavju.

nodes.source: Other languages

nodes.source: Choose a language from the language menu. Translated versions include the complete diary, photographs, scan descriptions and reading controls.
nodes.text: V jezikovnem meniju izberite jezik. Prevedene različice vključujejo celoten dnevnik, fotografije, opise medicinskih posnetkov in nastavitve branja.

nodes.source: Reading options
nodes.text: Možnosti branja

nodes.source: The reading-options button in the header lets you choose a larger text size, a light or dark colour scheme, high contrast, or a different reading font. These choices are remembered in this browser. You can also use your browser's zoom controls.
nodes.text: Gumb za možnosti branja v glavi omogoča izbiro večjega besedila, svetle ali temne barvne sheme, visokega kontrasta ali druge pisave za branje. Te izbire se shranijo v tem brskalniku. Uporabite lahko tudi povečavo v brskalniku.

nodes.source: Keyboard and screen readers
nodes.text: Tipkovnica in bralniki zaslona

nodes.source: If you use a keyboard, press Tab to move between links and controls. The skip link takes you straight to the main content. Press Escape to close an open photograph or settings window. Photographs include text descriptions.
nodes.text: Če uporabljate tipkovnico, s tipko Tab prehajate med povezavami in kontrolniki. Povezava za preskok vas popelje naravnost do glavne vsebine. S tipko Escape zaprete odprto fotografijo ali okno z nastavitvami. Fotografije imajo besedilne opise.

nodes.source: Photographs and films
nodes.text: Fotografije in filmi

nodes.source: Select a photograph to enlarge it, then use the previous and next buttons or the left and right arrow keys. The scan animations have written descriptions. The television clip has no captions and the magazine PDF is a scan of the printed page.
nodes.text: Izberite fotografijo, da jo povečate, nato uporabite gumba za prejšnjo in naslednjo fotografijo ali levo in desno puščico na tipkovnici. Animacije slikovnih preiskav imajo pisne opise. Televizijski prispevek nima podnapisov, revijalni PDF pa je sken tiskane strani.

nodes.source: Before the diagnosis
nodes.text: Pred diagnozo

nodes.source: I'm Tim Stollery. In December 2004, I was diagnosed with Stage IIIb testicular cancer. I started this diary to keep friends and family up to date. It became a way to share what life with cancer was really like.
nodes.text: Sem Tim Stollery. Decembra 2004 so mi diagnosticirali raka mod v stadiju IIIb. Ta dnevnik sem začel pisati, da bi prijatelje in družino obveščal, kako sem. Postal je način, da z drugimi delim, kakšno je bilo življenje z rakom v resnici.

nodes.source: Twenty years later. One last look back.
nodes.text: Dvajset let pozneje. Še zadnji pogled nazaj.

nodes.source: Two decades after treatment, I left Charing Cross Hospital for the final time. I stopped, looked back and took a photograph.
nodes.text: Dve desetletji po zdravljenju sem zadnjič odšel iz bolnišnice Charing Cross. Ustavil sem se, se ozrl nazaj in naredil fotografijo.

nodes.text: Iz mojega dnevnika, junij 2005

nodes.source: "My website lives on, as I do."
nodes.text: »Moje spletno mesto živi naprej, tako kot jaz.«

nodes.source: I wrote this account at the time. The words, the worries and the moments of relief are part of that story.
nodes.text: To pripoved sem pisal sproti. Besede, skrbi in trenutki olajšanja so del te zgodbe.

nodes.source: There is a life around every diagnosis.
nodes.text: Za vsako diagnozo je življenje.

nodes.source: Family, friends, fellow patients, a Mac that was rarely far away, and the people who helped me through. There is more here than the medical notes.
nodes.text: Družina, prijatelji, drugi bolniki, Mac, ki je bil le redko daleč stran, in ljudje, ki so mi pomagali prestati vse skupaj. Tu je več kot le zdravstvena dokumentacija.

nodes.source: Why I've left this here
nodes.text: Zakaj sem to pustil tukaj

nodes.source: I first wrote this diary and created this website in 2004, initially using Flash. I later redeveloped it in Apple's iWeb application when it was released, although iWeb has long since become obsolete. The website's purpose was to keep family & friends informed while I was having treatment for Stage IIIb Testicular Cancer - one resource for those who cared to find out how I was feeling and how treatment was progressing - leaving me more time to concentrate on getting better.
nodes.text: Ta dnevnik sem začel pisati in to spletno mesto ustvaril leta 2004, sprva s programom Flash. Pozneje sem ga prenovil z Applovo aplikacijo iWeb, ko je izšla, čeprav je iWeb že zdavnaj zastarel. Namen spletnega mesta je bil obveščati družino in prijatelje med mojim zdravljenjem raka mod v stadiju IIIb - enoten vir informacij za vse, ki jih je zanimalo, kako se počutim in kako zdravljenje napreduje - meni pa je ostalo več časa, da sem se lahko osredotočil na okrevanje.

nodes.source: For many years, this website has been available at my domain name timstollery.com, but a domain name needs renewing and a website needs maintaining. I can't know whether anyone will continue to look after either of them when I'm no longer able to, and I'm certain the internet will out live me for sure!
nodes.text: To spletno mesto je bilo dolga leta dostopno na moji domeni timstollery.com, vendar je domeno treba podaljševati in spletno mesto vzdrževati. Ne morem vedeti, ali bo kdo še skrbel za eno ali drugo, ko sam tega ne bom več zmogel, in prepričan sem, da me bo internet zagotovo preživel!

nodes.source: This is why I've chosen to preserve and host my story here on GitHub so it is also available at
nodes.text: Zato sem se odločil, da svojo zgodbo ohranim in gostim tukaj na GitHubu, da bo dostopna tudi na naslovu

nodes.source: https://timstollery.github.io
nodes.text: https://timstollery.github.io

nodes.source: , in the hope that it might remain accessible even if the domain timstollery.com eventually disappears. I have also archived it where I can.
nodes.text: , v upanju, da bo ostala dostopna, tudi če domena timstollery.com nekoč izgine. Arhiviral sem jo tudi povsod, kjer sem lahko.

nodes.source: Over the years, the website itself has evolved considerably too. What started as a fairly simple way of keeping family & friends informed has gradually developed into something much more accessible. I've redesigned it to work across different devices, introduced features to make it easier to read and navigate, and translated the account into a growing number of languages. My hope is that these improvements will allow more people, wherever they are in the world and whatever their individual needs, to access my story and perhaps find something helpful in it.
nodes.text: Z leti se je precej spremenilo tudi samo spletno mesto. Kar se je začelo kot razmeroma preprost način obveščanja družine in prijateljev, je postopoma postalo veliko bolj dostopno. Spletno mesto sem prenovil, da deluje na različnih napravah, dodal možnosti, ki olajšajo branje in uporabo, ter svojo zgodbo prevedel v vse več jezikov. Upam, da bodo te izboljšave omogočile več ljudem, ne glede na to, kje na svetu živijo in kakšne so njihove potrebe, da preberejo mojo zgodbo in v njej morda najdejo kaj koristnega.

nodes.source: If this diary website helps someone recognise a symptom, understand what treatment can be like, or feel less alone with a diagnosis, keeping it here will have been worthwhile.
nodes.text: Če to dnevniško spletno mesto komu pomaga prepoznati simptom, razumeti, kakšno je lahko zdravljenje, ali se ob diagnozi počutiti manj samega, ga je bilo vredno ohraniti tukaj.

nodes.source: All the very best wishes, Tim Stollery.
nodes.text: Vse najboljše vam želim, Tim Stollery.

nodes.source: In 2007 Cosmopolitan Magazine did a feature on Testicular Cancer, their twist was to show the seriousness but survivability of the disease.
nodes.text: Leta 2007 je revija Cosmopolitan objavila prispevek o raku mod. Njihov pristop je bil prikazati resnost bolezni, a tudi možnost preživetja.

nodes.source: The magazine article is available as a scanned PDF.
nodes.text: Revijalni članek je na voljo kot skenirani PDF.

nodes.source: Open the magazine page (PDF)
nodes.text: Odprite stran iz revije (PDF)

nodes.source: A 3D walk through my chest

nodes.source: This 3D virtual walk through my chest gradually reveals the metastases (secondary tumours) in my lungs after passing through my skin, muscles and chest wall. The CT colouring agent tube is initially visible at the top of the movie.
nodes.text: Ta tridimenzionalni virtualni sprehod skozi moj prsni koš po prehodu skozi kožo, mišice in prsno steno postopoma razkriva metastaze (sekundarne tumorje) v mojih pljučih. Na začetku posnetka je zgoraj vidna cevka za kontrastno sredstvo za CT.

nodes.source: A 3D rotation of my lungs

nodes.source: This short animation is a 3D rotation of my lungs. Using special colouring techniques it enables you to see the extent of the metastases (secondary tumours) that were in my lungs, in much more detail.
nodes.text: Ta kratka animacija prikazuje tridimenzionalno vrtenje mojih pljuč. S posebnimi tehnikami barvanja omogoča, da veliko podrobneje vidite obseg metastaz (sekundarnih tumorjev), ki so bile v mojih pljučih.

nodes.source: The four X-rays below were taken before and during my chemotherapy treatment. Subsequent X-rays have shown as clear apart from minute scarring where the metastatic (or secondary) tumours were.
nodes.text: Spodnji štirje rentgenski posnetki so nastali pred mojo kemoterapijo in med njo. Poznejši rentgenski posnetki so bili čisti, razen drobnih brazgotin na mestih, kjer so bili metastatski oziroma sekundarni tumorji.

nodes.source: 10 December 2004
nodes.text: 10. decembra 2004

nodes.source: Clearly visible are the multitude of lesions on each lung which were described as varying in size from golf balls to marbles. 2 of them were nearly the size of apples!
nodes.text: Jasno so vidne številne lezije v obeh pljučih, za katere so rekli, da so velike od žogic za golf do frnikol. Dve sta bili skoraj veliki kot jabolko!

nodes.source: 10 January 2005
nodes.text: 10. januarja 2005

nodes.source: After 3 weeks of treatment the lesions have dramatically reduced, they are still visible in places on close inspection.
nodes.text: Po treh tednih zdravljenja so se lezije močno zmanjšale, ob natančnem ogledu pa so ponekod še vedno vidne.

nodes.source: 31 January 2005
nodes.text: 31. januarja 2005

nodes.source: Lesions are shrinking but still remain as expected.
nodes.text: Lezije se manjšajo, vendar so po pričakovanjih še vedno prisotne.

nodes.source: β-hCG tumour marker results
nodes.text: Izvidi tumorskega označevalca β-hCG

nodes.source: During my treatment, β-hCG was an important blood marker because the cancer was producing this hormone. The results helped show how my body was responding to chemotherapy. I continued to have blood tests for many years afterwards.
nodes.text: Med mojim zdravljenjem je bil β-hCG pomemben krvni označevalec, saj je rak proizvajal ta hormon. Izvidi so pomagali pokazati, kako se moje telo odziva na kemoterapijo. Krvne preiskave sem opravljal še mnogo let pozneje.

nodes.source: The first 11 values fall from 5,307 to 7, then all remaining results are reported below 2. A logarithmic vertical axis is used; the horizontal axis shows tests in chronological order, not evenly spaced calendar intervals. Every test has a date and recorded result in the tables directly below.
nodes.text: Prvih 11 vrednosti pade s 5307 na 7, nato pa so vsi preostali izvidi navedeni kot manj kot 2. Navpična os je logaritemska; vodoravna os prikazuje preiskave v kronološkem vrstnem redu in ne enakomernih koledarskih razmikov. Vsaka preiskava ima datum in zabeležen izvid v tabelah neposredno spodaj.

nodes.source: My thanks to the family, friends, fellow patients and hospital staff who were there when I needed them.
nodes.text: Moja zahvala družini, prijateljem, drugim bolnikom in bolnišničnemu osebju, ki so bili tam, ko sem jih potreboval.

nodes.source: A personal thank you
nodes.text: Osebna zahvala

nodes.source: About 3 min read
nodes.text: Približno 3 min branja

nodes.source: Friends at a time like this are a gift greater than the finest things you could ever imagine having, don't ever forget who your friends are.
nodes.text: Prijatelji so v takšnih trenutkih darilo, večje od najlepših stvari, kar si jih sploh lahko zamislite. Nikoli ne pozabite, kdo so vaši prijatelji.

nodes.source: My thanks to all those that are out there supporting me throughout this rocky journey in my life, your cards, messages, emails and texts have been a great comfort.
nodes.text: Hvala vsem, ki me podpirate na tej razburkani poti mojega življenja. Vaše voščilnice, sporočila, e-pošta in SMS-i so mi v veliko tolažbo.

nodes.source: My Mum although fighting a debilitating disease herself ( Parkinson's Disease ) has been strong and continues her battle without me to support her, I'll be back Mum don't worry. She's already made it to see me in hospital on numerous occasions! I love you dearly Mum.
nodes.text: Moja mama se tudi sama bori z izčrpavajočo boleznijo (Parkinsonovo boleznijo), a ostaja močna in nadaljuje svoj boj brez moje podpore. Vrnil se bom, mami, ne skrbi. V bolnišnici me je že večkrat obiskala! Zelo te imam rad, mami.

nodes.source: My Dad for visiting so soon and all his support.
nodes.text: Moj oče, ker me je tako hitro obiskal, in za vso njegovo podporo.

nodes.source: My extended family although spread far and wide are all out there for me, their kind wishes, thoughts and prayers are with me all the time.
nodes.text: Moja širša družina, čeprav je raztresena daleč naokoli, mi vsa stoji ob strani. Njihove dobre želje, misli in molitve so ves čas z mano.

nodes.source: Special thanks to my life long friend Ken Clark who has been on hand and acting in my best interests from the start. There's nothing like having someone to shield you from the shit that can be thrown at you when you're at a low or frightening point in your life.
nodes.text: Posebna zahvala mojemu dolgoletnemu prijatelju Kenu Clarku, ki je bil od samega začetka na voljo in je ravnal v moje najboljše dobro. Ni ga čez to, da imaš nekoga, ki te zaščiti pred sranjem, s katerim te lahko zasujejo, ko si na najnižji ali najstrašnejši točki svojega življenja.

nodes.source: Milton Mermikides for just being there, unfortunately not in the best circumstances for himself but a shining light of pure positivity.
nodes.text: Miltonu Mermikidesu, ker je preprosto tu, žal v ne najlepših okoliščinah zanj, a je svetla luč čiste pozitivnosti.

nodes.source: My Consultant Dr. Savage and his team of Registrars (Dr. Tom Powles & Dr. Gairin Dancey) for my effective treatment & contending with my persistent questions! The Macmillan Nurses, Kara Blackwell and Rachel Sharkey for keeping me sane and more than well informed. My Surgeon Mr. Christmas for his superb handy-work and for extending my warranty! Mr. Christmas's team and 8 North for looking after me post op (including Dr. Rob Jeffs). Karen O'Donnell, amongst the many helpful people I have come across, some of whom I have already thanked. Luckily I met Karen who I came across on 8 North the day before being admitted to hospital for my operation. She is the Senior Sister on the Ward (no wonder). In an ideal world, people like Karen should be running hospitals!
nodes.text: Mojemu specialistu dr. Savageu in njegovi ekipi zdravnikov specializantov (dr. Tomu Powlesu in dr. Gairin Dancey) za učinkovito zdravljenje in prenašanje mojih nenehnih vprašanj! Medicinskima sestrama organizacije Macmillan, Kari Blackwell in Rachel Sharkey, ker sta skrbeli za mojo zdravo pamet in odlično obveščenost. Mojemu kirurgu g. Christmasu za njegovo odlično ročno delo in podaljšanje moje garancije! Ekipa g. Christmasa in oddelek 8 North so skrbeli zame po operaciji (tudi dr. Rob Jeffs). Karen O'Donnell je med številnimi ustrežljivimi ljudmi, ki sem jih srečal, nekaterim sem se že zahvalil. Na srečo sem Karen spoznal na oddelku 8 North dan pred sprejemom v bolnišnico zaradi operacije. Je glavna medicinska sestra oddelka (nič čudnega). V idealnem svetu bi morali ljudje, kot je Karen, voditi bolnišnice!

nodes.source: Andy Banks for setting up & Rory Choudhuri for coordinating the guestbook and forum I ran whilst in hospital.
nodes.text: Andyju Banksu za postavitev in Roryju Choudhuriju za usklajevanje knjige gostov in foruma, ki sem ju vodil med bivanjem v bolnišnici.

nodes.source: Antoine Rosset of OsiriX fame for assisting me with the rendering of the amazing CT imagery.
nodes.text: Antoinu Rossetu, znanemu po programu OsiriX, za pomoč pri izrisu neverjetnih CT-posnetkov.

nodes.source: Paul & Sue Wood for looking after me so well and always being such great hosts and friends whenever I visit them.
nodes.text: Paulu in Sue Wood, ker tako dobro skrbita zame in sta ob vsakem mojem obisku tako odlična gostitelja in prijatelja.

nodes.source: Blood donors, you're doing a fine job. Keep healthy and keep it up. I cannot ever give blood now after my treatment and never really relished the thought of doing it when I was healthy. I can certainly see the benefits now, thank you very much!
nodes.text: Krvodajalci, odlično delo opravljate. Ostanite zdravi in nadaljujte. Po zdravljenju nikoli več ne bom mogel darovati krvi, pa tudi ko sem bil zdrav, me misel na to ni prav navduševala. Zdaj vsekakor vidim koristi, najlepša hvala!

nodes.source: My many visitors, some of who have come time and time again … Ken C., Nimish S, Ronnie W., Fini, Michael & Sean T., Olga M., Milton & Bridget M., Leonard W., Martin W. & Hayley, Dean M., Roger R., Nick & Jill J., Martin D., Andy P., Tony C., Brett J., Rob C., Juanita TDE., Simon, Martin S. (brother) & Helen, Emma A., Hayley F., Tori M., Nikki T., Hiren P., Paul W., Khalid R., all at St. Clair Lodge, Arben, Giles (fellow patient) & Marian & John (his parents), Nani Qamar (fellow patient) & all her family/friends for their good wishes.
nodes.text: Moji številni obiskovalci, nekateri so prišli znova in znova ... Ken C., Nimish S, Ronnie W., Fini, Michael in Sean T., Olga M., Milton in Bridget M., Leonard W., Martin W. in Hayley, Dean M., Roger R., Nick in Jill J., Martin D., Andy P., Tony C., Brett J., Rob C., Juanita TDE., Simon, Martin S. (brat) in Helen, Emma A., Hayley F., Tori M., Nikki T., Hiren P., Paul W., Khalid R., vsi v St. Clair Lodge, Arben, Giles (sobolnik) in Marian in John (njegova starša), Nani Qamar (sobolnica) in vsa njena družina/prijatelji za dobre želje.

nodes.source: Others that I cannot mention publicly, or have simply chosen not to mention, I'm sure you know who you are! Thank you.
nodes.text: Drugi, ki jih ne morem javno omeniti ali sem se preprosto odločil, da jih ne bom omenil, zagotovo veste, kdo ste! Hvala.

nodes.source: About 4 min read
nodes.text: Približno 4 min branja

nodes.source:
This is where I post anything that I feel I need to say that doesn't fit within the
diary, some of it nonsense, some of it helpful...
nodes.text: Tukaj objavljam vse, kar čutim, da moram povedati, a ne spada v dnevnik. Nekaj je nesmislov, nekaj pa koristnega ...

nodes.source:
Over the past year and half
(mid 2003 - 2005) I've dealt with a great deal of personal upset and some stressful times (none of
which I will go in to as that is not what this site is about, those of you that know me well, will
know enough), so all in all I've had a pretty shitty couple of years just pass by, which in some
instances doctors suggest can bring on poor health especially if it's lying dormant there in the
first place ready to attack. It might be tough at times, but we must all remember to take stock of
life and try not to get too stressed or upset about situations that cannot be avoided or are
inevitable. Easy to say, much harder to do. Time is the greatest healer of all. I hope we can all
look forward to a brilliant New Year in 2005 with many more to follow.
nodes.text: V zadnjem letu in pol (od sredine leta 2003 do 2005) sem doživel veliko osebnih pretresov in nekaj stresnih obdobij (o katerih ne bom govoril, saj to ni tema tega spletnega mesta; tisti, ki me dobro poznate, veste dovolj). Za mano je torej nekaj precej usranih let, kar lahko po mnenju nekaterih zdravnikov v določenih primerih sproži zdravstvene težave, še posebno če te že prej tiho čakajo v nas in so pripravljene napasti. Včasih je težko, vendar se moramo vsi spomniti, da se je treba ustaviti in razmisliti o življenju ter se poskusiti ne vznemirjati preveč zaradi položajev, ki se jim ni mogoče izogniti ali so neizogibni. Lahko reči, veliko težje storiti. Čas je najboljši zdravilec. Upam, da se lahko vsi veselimo čudovitega novega leta 2005 in še mnogih za njim.

nodes.source:
I'm not ashamed, embarrassed or afraid of my Cancer, this web-site is for all to see from whatever
walk of life, gain strength from and be aware for themselves... pass the word around.
nodes.text: Svojega raka se ne sramujem, ni mi nerodno zaradi njega in ne bojim se ga. To spletno mesto je namenjeno vsem, ne glede na življenjsko pot, da si ga ogledajo, iz njega črpajo moč in so tudi sami bolj pozorni ... povejte naprej.

nodes.source:
Each and everyone of us is made different, so each and everyone of us has a different reaction
to everything. Chemotherapy reacts with everyone differently, my experience is here for all to see,
if you face it I hope you can stay positive about fighting your condition and not worry too much about
the possible side effects from any treatment or surgery. I really hope this site will not only
provide a link for all my friends to keep up to date with what's going on with me but also to
provide inspiration, positivity and drive to others who need that extra kick.
Just go for what you want.
nodes.text: Vsak od nas je drugačen, zato se tudi vsak na vse odziva drugače. Kemoterapija na vsakogar vpliva drugače. Moja izkušnja je tu na ogled vsem. Če vas to čaka, upam, da boste v boju s svojo boleznijo lahko ostali pozitivni in se ne boste preveč obremenjevali z možnimi stranskimi učinki zdravljenja ali operacije. Resnično upam, da to spletno mesto ne bo le povezava, prek katere bodo prijatelji spremljali, kaj se dogaja z mano, temveč bo tudi navdih, vir pozitivnosti in zagon drugim, ki potrebujejo dodaten potisk. Preprosto pojdite za tistim, kar si želite.

nodes.source:
getting yourself checked out, insist on having an Ultrasound Scan, in
retrospect if I was offered one I would have known sooner and my Cancer spread would not have been
so bad, thus increasing my percentage of making a full recovery from 80 percent to 99 percent!! AND...
nodes.text: so vas že pregledali, vztrajajte pri ultrazvočni preiskavi. Če se ozrem nazaj, bi izvedel prej, če bi mi jo ponudili, moj rak pa se ne bi tako razširil, s čimer bi se moje možnosti popolnega okrevanja z 80 odstotkov povečale na 99 odstotkov!! IN ...

nodes.source: KEEP CHECKING YOURSELF AT LEAST ONCE EVERY OTHER MONTH.
nodes.text: ŠE NAPREJ SE PREGLEDUJTE VSAJ ENKRAT NA DVA MESECA.

nodes.source:
General advice for all of you... If YOU are unsure about a health issue EVEN AFTER getting
yourself checked out, insist on having it checked again, do some research on the internet.
nodes.text: Splošen nasvet za vse ... Če VI niste prepričani glede zdravstvene težave TUDI PO TEM, KO so vas že pregledali, vztrajajte pri ponovnem pregledu in sami nekaj raziščite na internetu.

nodes.source: DON'T LEAVE IT, IT MAY NOT GO AWAY.
nodes.text: NE ODLAŠAJTE, MORDA NE BO MINILO SAMO OD SEBE.

nodes.source:
Mortgages... Critical Illness Cover, do you have it, it might be worth your while
thinking about it!
nodes.text: Stanovanjski krediti ... Zavarovanje za težke bolezni, ga imate? Morda bi bilo vredno razmisliti o tem!

nodes.source: Medical Insurance... if you have it then good on you, but do you know how much it will
nodes.text: Zdravstveno zavarovanje ... če ga imate, lepo, toda ali veste, koliko vam bo

nodes.source: ACTUALLY
nodes.text: V RESNICI

nodes.source:
cover you in the event that something goes wrong? I pay a fair amount each month and will only get £50
a night for my hospital stays (up to a max of £2000) and NO private care or attention at all,
so long as the NHS can treat me within 6 weeks, which in this instance is guaranteed as my life is
on the line.
nodes.text: krilo, če gre kaj narobe? Vsak mesec plačujem kar precej, dobil pa bom le 50 £ na noč za bivanje v bolnišnici (do največ 2000 £) in NOBENE zasebne oskrbe ali obravnave, dokler me lahko NHS zdravi v šestih tednih. V tem primeru je to zagotovljeno, saj je na kocki moje življenje.

nodes.source:
Quite a few people have suggested that I read the Lance Armstrong story or Bob Champions story,
they have both suffered from Testicular Cancer and recovered. Of course it's a comfort to hear
that people survive and an inspiration that they live on to achieve many wonderful things,
but from my discussions with other patients who are fellow sufferers they would rather experience things
in their own way not through the eyes and thoughts of someone else. Perhaps after this whole
experience has ended I will invest in a copy and be able to relate to their stories, but right
now and for example I do not want to be reading about a particular side effect that I just don't
want to hear about or will simply not touch me.
nodes.text: Kar nekaj ljudi mi je predlagalo, naj preberem zgodbo Lancea Armstronga ali Boba Championa. Oba sta imela raka mod in okrevala. Seveda je tolažilno slišati, da ljudje preživijo, in navdihujoče, da nato v življenju dosežejo veliko čudovitih stvari. Toda iz pogovorov z drugimi bolniki, ki prestajajo podobno, vem, da bi stvari raje doživljali po svoje, ne skozi oči in misli nekoga drugega. Morda si bom, ko bo vsega tega konec, kupil knjigo in se lahko poistovetil z njunima zgodbama. Trenutno pa na primer ne želim brati o določenem stranskem učinku, o katerem preprosto nočem slišati ali pa me sploh ne bo doletel.

nodes.source:
Merry Christmas 2004, if Santa brings me anything for this coming year lets hope its my good
health and full recovery from this Cancer. I hope he's brought you just what you wished for.
Boredom strikes easily at Christmas in hospital, so along with Milton's superb musical talents, Milton,
Ken & I created a silly Christmas music video. The recording is no longer available to watch.
nodes.text: Vesel božič 2004. Če mi bo Božiček za prihodnje leto kaj prinesel, upajmo, da bosta to zdravje in popolno okrevanje od tega raka. Upam, da je vam prinesel natanko tisto, kar ste si želeli. V bolnišnici za božič hitro postane dolgčas, zato smo Milton, Ken in jaz ob Miltonovi izjemni glasbeni nadarjenosti ustvarili trapast božični glasbeni video. Posnetka si ni več mogoče ogledati.

nodes.source:
My friend Roger thinks a hot curry will cure anything, any one fancy a Chicken Tarka Masala?
If only it was that simple, I'd be straight down the nearest ruby house for some Kormatherapy
(sorry no link to this one!)
nodes.text: Moj prijatelj Roger meni, da pekoč kari pozdravi vse. Bi kdo piščanca Tarka Masala? Ko bi bilo vsaj tako preprosto, bi takoj zavil v najbližjo indijsko restavracijo na malo kormaterapije (žal za to ni povezave!)

nodes.source: Milton wondered if Cave children ate chicken shaped dinosaurs, do you think the drugs are effecting him?
nodes.text: Milton se je spraševal, ali so jamski otroci jedli dinozavre v obliki piščancev. Mislite, da zdravila vplivajo nanj?

nodes.source:
I hated needles during my treatment, believe me, I was fed up of having them stuck in me...
now I'm used to them and could probably do it myself!
nodes.text: Med zdravljenjem sem sovražil igle, verjemite mi, dovolj sem imel tega, da so jih zabadali vame ... zdaj sem jih vajen in bi to verjetno lahko počel kar sam!

nodes.source: This is my personal experience, not medical advice.
nodes.text: To je moja osebna izkušnja, ne zdravstveni nasvet.

nodes.source: On the 9th of December 2004, I was diagnosed with Stage IIIb Testicular Cancer.
nodes.text: 9. decembra 2004 so mi diagnosticirali raka mod v stadiju IIIb.

nodes.source: On the 10th December 2004, amongst obvious discussions about my forthcoming and required treatment, I was told that if no treatment were to be given, then I would have...
nodes.text: 10. decembra 2004 so mi med samoumevnimi pogovori o prihajajočem in potrebnem zdravljenju povedali, da bi imel, če se ne bi zdravil, ...

nodes.source: "just less than a year to live, possibly only months"
nodes.text: »nekaj manj kot leto življenja, morda le nekaj mesecev«

nodes.source: This website covers my journey throughout the fight with my Cancer, not only my initial suspicions but my day to day battle both in hospital and out, it covers the complete story.
nodes.text: To spletno mesto spremlja mojo pot skozi boj z rakom, ne le mojih prvih sumov, temveč vsakdanji boj tako v bolnišnici kot zunaj nje; zajema celotno zgodbo.

nodes.source: If you're in doubt about anything that might be wrong with you, don't hang about, make sure you get seen to and seen to properly, not once but time and time again until you are happy with the result. As you will see from my experience, things can be easily missed in our busy lives...
nodes.text: Če dvomite glede česarkoli, kar bi lahko bilo narobe z vami, ne odlašajte. Poskrbite, da vas pregledajo in to temeljito, ne le enkrat, temveč znova in znova, dokler niste zadovoljni z odgovorom. Kot boste videli iz moje izkušnje, lahko v našem zaposlenem vsakdanu marsikaj zlahka spregledamo ...

nodes.source: The Chemotherapy treatment I am to receive will most likely drain my energy, so I'm using this as an outlet for you all to find out how I am and save me telling the story a hundred times, I hope you understand. Throughout the site I have links referencing particular sites to explain things further, these will be underlined.
nodes.text: Kemoterapija, ki jo bom prejemal, mi bo najverjetneje pobrala energijo, zato sem to spletno mesto namenil temu, da lahko vsi izveste, kako sem, meni pa iste zgodbe ne bo treba pripovedovati stokrat. Upam, da razumete. Po spletnem mestu so povezave do drugih strani, ki stvari podrobneje pojasnjujejo; te bodo podčrtane.

nodes.source: Thank you for all of your support and kind wishes, it is much appreciated.
nodes.text: Hvala za vso podporo in dobre želje, zelo jih cenim.

nodes.source: The story begins here...
nodes.text: Zgodba se začne tukaj ...

nodes.source: June 2003
nodes.text: junij 2003

nodes.source: After having my suspicions of a slight irregularity down in my nether regions I decided to pay a visit to my GP for a physical examination, my GP being quite dismissive claimed that a physical examination would not be necessary and instead lifted my arms and legs and asked if I had any pain anywhere???
nodes.text: Ko sem spodaj, v intimnem predelu, posumil na manjšo nepravilnost, sem se odločil obiskati osebnega zdravnika in prositi za telesni pregled. Moj precej odklonilni zdravnik je trdil, da tak pregled ni potreben, in mi namesto tega dvigoval roke in noge ter spraševal, ali me kje kaj boli???

nodes.source: I am not a doctor but surely after asking for a physical examination I should have at least been given one and after my peculiarly fashioned GP examination I was left with no answer to my original suspicions. So I pondered on this for 2 weeks and decided to go to my local walk in GUM Clinic (Genito-Urinary Medicine) to request a physical examination, which I was promptly given. The lady that examined me deliberated for a bit and finally said all felt fine and my initial fears were laid to rest and I worried no more.
nodes.text: Nisem zdravnik, vendar bi me, ko sem prosil za telesni pregled, najbrž morali vsaj pregledati. Po tem nenavadnem pregledu pri osebnem zdravniku sem tako ostal brez odgovora na svoje prvotne sume. Dva tedna sem razmišljal o tem, nato pa sem se odločil obiskati lokalno ambulanto za genitourinarno medicino, kamor lahko prideš brez naročila, in prositi za telesni pregled. Tega sem takoj tudi dobil. Gospa, ki me je pregledala, je nekaj časa premišljevala in nazadnje rekla, da je na otip vse v redu. Moji začetni strahovi so se pomirili in nisem se več obremenjeval.

nodes.source: January/February 2004
nodes.text: Januar/februar 2004

nodes.source: A slight swelling in the right hand side of my nether regions had occurred and I thought that I had simply knocked myself as it wasn't that painful or uncomfortable, after a week and a bit it had subsided and no difference in shape or size was noticed than from before. I did wonder if I should go for another checkup to be sure and either became too busy or I simply wasn't that concerned as my fears of a problem had previously been dispelled.
nodes.text: Na desni strani intimnega predela se je pojavila rahla oteklina in mislil sem, da sem se preprosto udaril, saj ni posebno bolelo niti bilo neprijetno. Po dobrem tednu je oteklina izginila in glede na prej nisem opazil nobene razlike v obliki ali velikosti. Spraševal sem se, ali bi moral na še en pregled, da bi bil prepričan, a sem bil bodisi prezaposlen bodisi me preprosto ni tako skrbelo, saj so mi prej razblinili strahove, da je kaj narobe.

nodes.source: October 18th - 22nd 2004
nodes.text: 18. do 22. oktober 2004

nodes.source: I had a weird pain in my back on the left had side around my rib cage, almost like I had pulled a muscle it went away after a couple of days and I really thought nothing of it.
nodes.text: Na levi strani hrbta okoli reber sem čutil nenavadno bolečino, skoraj tako, kot bi si nategnil mišico. Po nekaj dneh je izginila in ji res nisem pripisoval nobenega pomena.

nodes.source: Late October 2004 through to the end of November 2004
nodes.text: Od konca oktobra 2004 do konca novembra 2004

nodes.source: I slowly developed a cough, dry but irritable and producing no flem. A few more of the strange pulled muscle feelings popped up around the front and back of my ribcage both on the left and right which were a little painful at times in terms of general movement and coughing/breathing. Again they subsided but I certainly thought something was up. The most noticeable symptom of illness was an intense sweating at night, so much so that from the base of my head to the bottom of my back both front and back would literally leak like a tap and soak my sheets so much so I could not sleep on that side of the bed anymore.
nodes.text: Počasi sem začel kašljati. Kašelj je bil suh in dražeč, brez izmečka. Še nekaj takih nenavadnih občutkov nategnjene mišice se je pojavilo spredaj in zadaj okoli reber, tako levo kot desno. Včasih so nekoliko boleli pri običajnem gibanju in kašljanju oziroma dihanju. Tudi ti so minili, vendar sem zagotovo mislil, da se nekaj dogaja. Najopaznejši znak bolezni je bilo močno nočno potenje. Tako hudo, da je telo od zatilja do spodnjega dela hrbta, spredaj in zadaj, dobesedno puščalo kot pipa in tako premočilo rjuhe, da na tisti strani postelje nisem več mogel spati.

nodes.source: November 29th 2004 - Monday
nodes.text: 29. november 2004 - ponedeljek

nodes.source: I decided that a visit to the GP was needed for at least some antibiotics to attack what I thought was a nasty infection or flu that needed to be cleared. I was seen by the same dismissive GP and prescribed over 2000mg of antibiotics to take a day. I asked as I left that I thought perhaps a chest Xray would be needed if the antibiotics did not work and was told very quickly that it "might be considered" if there was no change. I went straight to the chemist that same afternoon.
nodes.text: Odločil sem se, da moram k osebnemu zdravniku, vsaj po antibiotike za to, kar sem imel za neprijetno okužbo ali gripo, ki se je moram znebiti. Sprejel me je isti odklonilni zdravnik in predpisal več kot 2000 mg antibiotikov na dan. Ob odhodu sem omenil, da bi bil morda potreben rentgenski posnetek prsnega koša, če antibiotiki ne bodo pomagali. Zelo hitro mi je odgovoril, da bi o tem »morda razmislili«, če ne bo spremembe. Še tisto popoldne sem šel naravnost v lekarno.

nodes.source: The following 7 days I took my antibiotics religiously, ate extra healthily and drank no alcohol to get over what I thought was a nasty flu.
nodes.text: Naslednjih sedem dni sem antibiotike jemal dosledno, jedel še posebno zdravo in nisem pil alkohola, da bi prebolel to, kar sem imel za hudo gripo.

nodes.source: That's everything leading up to my diagnosis. Continue with the diary to read about my treatment and recovery.
nodes.text: To je vse, kar se je zgodilo pred mojo diagnozo. Nadaljujte z dnevnikom in preberite o mojem zdravljenju ter okrevanju.

nodes.source: This is my personal experience, not medical advice.
nodes.text: To je moja osebna izkušnja, ne zdravstveni nasvet.

searchData.title: 14. februar 2025 / Moj zadnji obisk bolnišnice Charing Cross
searchData.text:
14. februarja 2025 Pogled nazaj na bolnišnico Charing Cross 
 
 Bolnišnica Charing Cross, 14. februar 2025. Moj zadnji obisk pred zaključkom kontrolnega spremljanja. 
 Nekateri se morda spomnite tega poglavja mojega življenja ... Pred 20 leti sem odšel iz te bolnišnice po koncu naporne kemoterapije za rak mod v stadiju IIIb. Nisem vedel, kaj me čaka v prihodnosti ali ali bom dočakal še 20 let - vendar sem upal. Pred kratkim, prav na valentinovo, sem skozi ista vrata odšel zadnjič. Obstojal sem, malo ganjen, se ozrl nazaj in posnel to fotografijo. Življenje je dar in včasih najtežje poti vodijo do najpomembnejših mejnikov. Na naslednjih 20 let in na vse, kar nas še čaka! x 
 14. februarja 2025 so me odpustili iz oskrbe bolnišnice Charing Cross, dvajset let po mojem prvotnem zdravljenju. Na letnih februarskih kontrolah so rezultati HCG še naprej ostajali pod 2 (normalno). 
 Oglejte si rezultate kontrolnih preiskav HCG

searchData.title: december 2004 / 6. decembra 2004 - ponedeljek
searchData.text: Zdravljenje z antibiotiki končano, opazil nisem nobene prave spremembe.

searchData.title: december 2004 / 8. decembra 2004 - sreda
searchData.text: Skrb je vse večja. Naročil sem se pri drugem zdravniku v svoji ambulanti za petek, 10., ob 17.00.

searchData.title: december 2004 / 9. decembra 2004 - četrtek
searchData.text: Po še eni prepoteni noči (v zadnjih tednih so postale že nekaj povsem običajnega) sem se zbudil z občutkom še ene nategnjene mišice okoli reber, tokrat na levi strani hrbta. Svojih simptomov sem imel vedno bolj dovolj in odločil sem se, da bi obisk osebnega zdravnika le podaljšal čakanje na morebitno nadaljnje zdravljenje, zato bi bil obisk urgence za rutinski pregled in rentgensko slikanje boljša izbira. Tako sem brez nadaljnjega odlašanja in ne da bi odpovedal termin pri osebnem zdravniku obiskal povsem nov urgentni oddelek bolnišnice West Middlesex. Na urgenci sem čakal nekaj manj kot uro, da me je kdo sprejel. Odlična čakalna doba za urgenco NHS. Opravili so nekaj rutinskih pregledov in takoj naročili previdnostno rentgensko slikanje, brez posebne zaskrbljenosti ali sumov. Kakšnih 20 minut pozneje so me poslali na rentgen. Radiološka inženirka me je po slikanju vprašala, ali sem že kdaj imel rentgen prsnega koša. Opazil sem, da jo je prešinila zaskrbljenost, in odkrito odgovoril: »Ne.« Po vrnitvi na urgenco so mi vzeli kri. Opazil sem več zdravnikov, ki so gledali v računalniški zaslon in nato začudeno pogledovali proti meni. Zdaj sem res začenjal čutiti, da nekaj ni prav, vendar sem ostal miren. Pristopil je zdravnik in me odpeljal v prostor, ločen z zavesami. Ko sva vstopila, je zagrnil zavese. Še preden je izgovoril eno besedo, mi je izraz na njegovem obrazu povedal, da ima slabo novico. »Na vašem rentgenskem posnetku smo našli nekaj temnih lis,« je previdno dejal. Prosil sem za neposredno razlago in po prvem šoku ter kozarcu vode so se mi dejstva začela počasi usedati v zavest. Pojasnili so mi, da imam v vsakem pljučnem krilu do osem ali devet lezij velikosti kovanca za 20 penijev in da je 20-odstotna možnost, da gre za okužbo, v primerjavi z 80-odstotno možnostjo, da gre za RAKA!!! Tisti večer so me sprejeli v bolnišnico West Middlesex za eno noč na enoto za internistično oceno (MAU), zjutraj pa sta bili načrtovani CT-preiskava in ultrazvok.

searchData.title: december 2004 / 10. decembra 2004 - petek
searchData.text: Prišlo je jutro in moji strahovi so se še okrepili, ko je v sobo vstopila množica zdravnikov. Prav vsak je bil videti enako zaskrbljen kot zdravnik prejšnji večer. Začenjalo se mi je svitati, da gre za nekaj precej resnega. Dobil sem še več slabih novic: če gre za raka, kot so zdaj sumili, potem tisto, kar kaže rentgenski posnetek prsnega koša, ni njegov prvotni izvor. Verjetno se je začel nekje nižje v telesu in sčasoma prišel v pljuča. Izvid CT-preiskave je potrdil, da je rak tudi v mojih paraaortnih bezgavkah ob trebušni votlini, in je veliko jasneje, globinsko ter natančno prikazal moja pljuča ter potrdil razširjenost bolezni. Dodatni ultrazvočni pregled mod je prav tako potrdil, da je najverjetnejši vzrok in prvotno mesto raka v mojem desnem modu. Nekaj, na kar sem posumil že pred kakšnimi 18 meseci! Kot nujni primer so me z reševalnim vozilom, v invalidskem vozičku, premestili v bolnišnico Charing Cross (vendar brez modrih luči!). Ves ta čas sem bil na zunaj še vedno videti enako zdrav kot prej. Mlad moški z neprijetnim kašljem in brez prav nobenih drugih simptomov kjerkoli v telesu. Poklical sem ambulanto osebnega zdravnika in jim povedal, da me ob 17.00 ne bo! Ko sem prispel v Charing Cross, so me na vozičku odpeljali v šesto nadstropje. Takoj je bilo opaziti razliko med novostjo bolnišnice West Mid in Charing Cross. Vendar me je pomirjalo dejstvo, da me bodo zdaj zdravili v bolnišnici z dolgoletnimi izkušnjami in strokovnim znanjem, boljšim kot v drugih bolnišnicah v okolici. Nekaj časa sem čakal na pregled pri specialistu. Če 40-minutni pogovor povzamem zelo na kratko: povedali so mi, da je moja prognoza dobra, štiri možnosti od petih za popolno okrevanje od raka mod. Čakajo me kakšni štirje meseci kemoterapije v bolnišnici in zunaj nje in najprej bom moral zboleti, da bom lahko ozdravel, vendar je to moja edina izbira. Moral sem postaviti še zadnje, a očitno hipotetično vprašanje ... »Ker se počutim dobro in bi lahko zdaj odšel od tod, kaj pa, če sploh ne bi želel nobenega zdravljenja?« »Živeli bi manj kot leto dni.« Mislim, da to res jasno postavi dejstva na svoje mesto. Kemoterapija ali smrt, ni težko izbrati!!! Torej, karkoli bo potrebno, kakorkoli dolgo bo trajalo in kakršnekoli stranske učinke bom moral prenašati, so ti povsem nepomembni v primerjavi z drugo možnostjo. Dodelili so mi sobo in odločil sem se ostati v bolnišnici, da bi jo poskusil obdržati, saj bi se kemoterapija začela naslednji teden. Čeprav se je specialist strinjal, da bi se do naslednjega tedna vrnil domov, sem se v tem okolju počutil varneje glede na novice, ki sem jih še vedno poskušal dojeti in jim verjeti.

searchData.title: december 2004 / 11. decembra 2004 - sobota
searchData.text: Moral sem se vrniti domov, da sem mami pripravil zdravila za Parkinsonovo bolezen po urniku za čas, ko bom v bolnišnici. Odhod iz bolnišnice so mi pristojni odobrili, zato sem se oprhal, se dobro osvežil in odšel v Hounslow, da bi bil ob 18.00 spet v bolnišnici na večerji. Biti zunaj bolnišnice po novicah, ki sem jih dobil, je bilo nenavadno, skoraj kot da ne bi smel zapustiti svojega varnega okolja, če bi se mi kaj zgodilo. Bil sem torej, milo rečeno, precej tesnoben. Čeprav je bila ureditev stvari za mamo prednostna naloga, sem moral zdaj skrbeti tudi za lastno dobrobit. Ko sem se ob 18.00 vrnil v bolnišnico, sem ugotovil, da je bila večerja ob 17.00.
